translations.source: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.reference: Ifilimu, eno-Ryan Gosling noEmma Stone, ikhethelwe ukuwina kuzo zonke izigaba ezinkulu.
translations.hypothesis: Фильм, со starring Ryan Gosling र Emma Stone, प्राप्त गर्‍यो номинации во सबै मुख्य श्रेणीहरू.

translations.source: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.reference: U-Gosling no-Stone bathole ukuqokwa kwe-Best Actor no-Actress ngokulandelana kwabo.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling र र Stone प्राप्त गरेका हुन् नामाकरणहरू, क्रमशः, सर्वश्रेष्ठ अभिनेता र सर्वश्रेष्ठ अभिनेत्री।

translations.source: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.reference: Abanye abakhethiwe bahlanganisa neSithombe Esihle Kakhulu, Umqondisi Webhayisikobho, Umklami Wezimpahla, Umhleli-wefilimu, Umculo, Umklamo Womkhiqizo, Ukuhlelwa Komsindo, Ukuhlanganiswa Komsindo kanye Nombhalo weFilimu Wangempela.
translations.hypothesis: अन्य नामाकरण समावेश् उत्कृष्ट फिल्म, निर्देशक, छायाचित्रण, डिजाइन वेशभूषा, संपादन फिल्म, मूल संगीत, डिजाइन उत्पादन, संपादन ध्वनि, मिश्रण ध्वनि, रिल स्क्रिप्ट.

translations.source: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.reference: Izingoma ezimbili ezivela kwifilimu, i-Audition (The Fools Who Dream) kanye ne-City of Stars, zithole ukuqokelwa kwengoma yangempela ehamba phambili. Isitudiyo se-Lionsgate sikhethwe izikhathi ezingu-26 — ukudlula noma esiphi Isitudiyo.
translations.hypothesis: दोन गीतहरू, एकबाट फिल्म "Audition (The Fools Who Dream)" र "City of Stars", प्राप्त गरेका उत्कृष्ट मूल गीत पुरस्कार। स्टुडियो Lionsgate प्राप्त गरेको 26 नामाकरण - धेरै भन्दा धेरै स्टुडियो।

translations.source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.reference: Ntambama ngeSonto, uMongameli waseMelika u-Donald Trump, esitatimendeni esikhishwe unobhala wephephandaba, umemezele ukuthi amasosha aseMelika azoshiya elaseSiriya.
translations.hypothesis: आइत, अध्यक्षสหรัฐ, डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प, मार्फत, मार्फत, घोषणा गरे, कि सेनाले सिरिया छोडे।

translations.source: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.reference: Isimemezelo senziwa ngemva kokuba u-Trump eshayele uMongameli waseTheki uRecep Tayyip Erdoğan ucingo.
translations.hypothesis: घोषणा गरिएको भएपछि, ट्रम्पले तुर्कीचे राष्ट्रपति रेसेप तैयिप् एर्दोगनसँग टेलिफोन सम्वाद गरेका थिए।

translations.source: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.reference: ITheki izophatha ukugada amasosha we-ISIS athunjiwe lawo, ngokwesitatimende, amazwe waseYurophu anqabe ukuwalanda.
translations.hypothesis: ตุर्कीले पनि ले, पहलाcaptured ISIS लडाकहरू, जे, भनिएको छ, राष्ट्रयुरोपेयले अस्वीकार गरेका, ќе ले।

translations.source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.reference: Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani amanye ama-dinosaur ayenezimpaphe, inkolelo-mbono ebanzi kakade, kepha inikezela imininingwane imivubukulo engayinikezi ngokujwayelekile, njengombala nokuhleleka kwezinhlangothi ezintathu.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यसले पुष्टि गर्दछ कि कम से कम केही डायनासोरहरूले पाइ, जे जुन एक सिद्धान्त, तर यसले थप जानकारी प्रदान गर्दछ, जस्तै रङ र त्रि-आयामी संरचना, जुन सामान्यतया जीवाश्महरूले प्रदान गर्न नसक्ने।

translations.source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.

translations.source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.

translations.source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.reference: Ngenxa yokuthi izimpaphe zama-dinosaur aziso isiqu esikhule kahle, osibizwa ngokuthi i-rachis, kodwa zinezinye izici zezimpaphe — izindlendla kanye nama-barbule — abacwaningi baphethe ngokuthi i-rachis cishe bekungukwakheka kokuziphendukela kunalezinye izici.
translations.hypothesis: ला कारणले, पिहोन्टोको पंखले, मार् उल्लेख्य "rachis" (एक प्रकारको नक्का), तर उनी अन्य पंख-विशेषताहरू — "barbs" र "barbules" — छन्, अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूले निष्कर्ष निकाले की "rachis" सायद यी अन्य विशेषताहरूको पछि विकसित भएको।

translations.source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.reference: Ukwakheka kwezimpaphe kusikisela ukuthi bezingasetshenziselwa ukundiza kodwa kunalokho ukulawula ukushisa kanye nokuzibonakalisa. Abacwaningi basikisela ukuthi, nakuba lona kungumsila we-dinosaur encane, isampula liveza izimpaphe zendala futhi hhayi isihluphe somntwanyana.

translations.source: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.reference: Ukukhanya nokuphenduka kusetshenziswa ndawonye ukuthola inombolo yeRossby yenkanyezi, ehlobene nokugeleza kwe-plasma.
translations.hypothesis: ल्यास्ट्रो रङ र घुमाव, प्रयोग गरिन्छ, ताकि निर्धारण गर्न सकिन्छ कि ताराको Rossby संख्या कति हो, र यसले प्लाज्माको सञ्चালনसँग सम्बन्धित छ।

translations.source: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.reference: Uma i-Rossby inenombolo encane, inkanyezi ayibi namandla ngokuphathelene nokuhlehla kazibuthe.
translations.hypothesis: तिमि, संख्या Rossby कम, ताले धेरै सक्रिय हुनु छ, जति सम्बन्धी चुम्बकिय परिवर्तन।

translations.source: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.reference: Phakathi naloluhambo, u-Iwasaki wahlangabezana nezinkinga kaningi.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि उन आन्द, Iwasaki भेट्टाव अनेक पटक समस्या।

translations.source: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.reference: Ubanjwe inkunzi yizigcwelegcwele zasolwandle, wahlaselwa yinja enesifo sobuhlanya e-Tibet, wabalekela umshado e-Nepal bese waboshwa eNdiya.
translations.hypothesis: "त्यो, ऊ समुद्री डाकूहरूकै, मा तिबेटमा एक व्याल, पछि नेपालमा विवाहबाट भागे, र भारतमा गिरफ्तार भयो।"

translations.source: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.reference: Isimiso se-802.11n sisebenza kuwo womabili amafrikhwensi angu-2.4Ghz no-5.0Ghz.
translations.hypothesis: मान्डार्ड 802.11n कामेय कय प्रयोग 2.4Ghz र 5.0Ghz फ्रिक्वेन्सी।

translations.source: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.reference: Lokhu kuzoyivumela ukuthi ihambisane nezinhlelo zakudala ze-802.11a, i-802.11b kanye ne-802.11g, uma nje isikhungo sesiteshi sinemisakazo emibili.
translations.hypothesis: यदी स्टेशनले दुई रेडियो, योले 802.11a, 802.11b र 802.11g संग अनुकूलता, र यसले काम गर्छ।

translations.source: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: Ijubane lika-802.11n liphezulu kakhulu kunelangaphambili elaligcina ejubaneni elingu-600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: गतीहरू 802.11n छन् निक फन्दा भन्दा पहिलेका, र अधिकतम सैद्धांतिक गती 600Mbit/s।

translations.source: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.reference: UDuvall, oshadile nonezingane ezimbili ezindalaa, akazange ahlabe u-Miller umxhwele, lowo otshelwe indaba.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, जो बिपत र र दुई वयस्क नसल, ले मिलरलाई, ज्या कसै कथा, खास प्रभाव छोडएन।

translations.source: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.reference: Lapho ecelwa ukuthi aphawule, u-Miller uthe, “U-Mike ukhuluma kakhulu phakathi nokuthethwa kwecala...bengizilungiselela ngakho angikuzwanga ayekusho.”
translations.hypothesis: जेव्हा सोधिएको, मिलरले भन्यो, "माइकले धेरै कुरा बोल्यो во во присуство... म तयार हुँदा, त्यसैले म वास्तवमा सुनें जे ऊ भोल."

translations.source: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.reference: Sizophumelela ukunciphisa inani lomoya ongcolile ngesikali se-GDP ngezinga eliphawulekayo ngo-2020 ukusuka esilinganisweni sango-2005, kusho u-Hu.
translations.hypothesis: "हा, हामी चाहन्छौ घटाउन उत्सर्जन कार्बन डाइअक्साइड प्रति एकाई उत्पादन, मार्गी महत्त्वपूर्ण,यसको २०२०,यसको २००५ स्तर," भन्यो हा।

translations.source: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.reference: Akazange abeke izibalo zokuncishiswa, ethi zizokwenziwa ngokomphumela womnotho waseShayina.
translations.hypothesis: هغهले निश्चित रकम निर्धारण नगरे, भन्दें कि कटौतीहरू ќा गरिने छन्, र यो ќा आधारित हुनेछ चीनको आर्थिक उत्पादन।

translations.source: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."

translations.source: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.reference: Wanezela ukuthi “akumelwe, nokho, bacelwe bathathe ukuzibophezela okungaphezu kwesigaba sabo sentuthuko, imithwalo yemfanelo kanye namakhono.”
translations.hypothesis: असा, "यद्यपि, तिनीमाथि न पर्दा, अपेक्षाएँ जुन तिनीको विकास स्तर, जिम्मेवारी र क्षमताहरूले ओला,।"

translations.source: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.reference: IQembu Locwaningo lase-Iraq lethule umbiko walo ngo-12,00 GMT namuhla.
translations.hypothesis: समूह अध्ययन इराकले आफ्नो रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत गरेको आज, 12:00 GMT.

translations.source: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.reference: Iyaxwayisa Akekho ongaqinisekisa ukuthi nanoma iyiphi inkambo e-Iraq okwamanje izoqeda impi yamahlelo, ubudlova obukhulayo, noma ukuthambekela ebuxakalaleni.
translations.hypothesis: यसलेले, यसले चेतावनी दिन्छ: कसैले पनि निश्चित गर्न रれない, कतिपय कार्ययोजना मा इराकमा, यस समय, यसले धार्मिक युद्ध, जोसो वृद्धि, वा अराजकतातिर उन्मुख हुनु रोकिने।

translations.source: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.reference: UMbiko uvula ngesicelo senkulumo-mpikiswano evulekile kanye nokwenziwa kokuvumelana eMelika ngesimiso saseNingizimu ePhakathi.
translations.hypothesis: रिपोर्ट सुरु हुन्छयसहित, एक आह्वानको लागि खुला बहसमा र संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिकामा मध्य पूर्वको नीतिमा आमसहमति निर्माण।

translations.source: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.reference: Umbiko ugxeka kakhulu cishe zonke izici zesimiso samanje sesiGungu sase-Iraq futhi ucela ukuba kube noshintsho olusheshayo lwenkambo.
translations.hypothesis: रिपोर्टले, लगभग सबै पक्षको वर्तमान नीति, विशेषतः कार्यकारीको नीति कडा, र यसले तत्काल परिवर्तनमा आह्वान गरेको छ।

translations.source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.reference: Okokuqala phakathi kokutusa kwayo okungu-78 ukuthi isinyathelo sokuxhumana kumelwe sithathe ngaphambi kokuphela kwalonyaka ukuvikela imingcele yase-Iraq ekungeneleni konya kanye nasekumiseni kabusha ubuhlobo bokuxhumana nomakhelwane bayo.
translations.hypothesis: पहला, मध्ये 78 सिफारिस, होय कि नया राजनीतिक पहल पर्ने, ताकि सुरक्षित गर सकू Iraq सीमा विरुद्ध शत्रुतापूर्ण हस्तक्षेप, र पुनर्स्थापित गरि कतिपय देशहरूसँग राजनीतिक सम्बन्ध।

translations.source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Ilungu lesigele lamanje kanye noNkosikazi kaMongameli wase-Argentina uCristina Fernandez de Kirchner umemezele ukungenela kwakhe ukhetho lokuba umongameli izolo ntambama eLa Plata, idolobha elingamakhilomitha angu-50 (amamayela angu-31) kusuka eBuenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: सेनेटर हालको र अर्जेन्टिनाकी प्रथम श्रीमती क्रिस्टिना फेर्नेन्डेज डी किर्चर, घोषणा गरेका छन् कि उनी ќै अध्यक्षको पद ќе नाघे, गएको साँदमा, मा ला प्लाटा, शहर, जे 50 किलोमिटर (31 माइल) देखि दूर, र Buenos Aires।

translations.source: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.reference: UNkk. Kirchner umemezelo inhloso yakhe yokukhankasela ukuba umongameli eThiyetheni yase-Argentina, indawo efanayo ayisebenzisele ukuqala umkhankaso wakhe wokuba ilunga leSigele njengelunga lamanxusa esifunda sase-Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: גברת किर्चर घोษณา आफ्नोIntention मा अध्यक्षको पदका लागि चुनाव, यसले एर्जेन्टिना थिएटर, एउटा स्थान जसमा उनले आफ्नो 2005 चुनाव अभियान सुरु गरे, जस्तै, सदस्यको रूपमा ब्यूनोस आइर्स प्रान्त प्रतिनिधि।

translations.source: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.reference: Inkulumo-mpikiswano idalwe ukuphikisana ngokuchitha imali eningi yokusiza kanye nokwakha kabusha ngemva kokudlula kweSiphepho iKatrina; leyo abesikhwama sezwe abadla ngoludala abayibize sakudlala ngokuthi "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.hypothesis: वादले उत्पन्न भयो, र यसले सम्बन्ध छ कसरी खर्च गर्ने राहत र पुनर्निर्माण पछि, पछि "हर्ricane Katrina"; धेरै वित्तीय محافظवादीहरूले यसलाई हास्यपूर्ण रूपमा "बशको नयाँ ओरेन्स डिल" भने।

translations.source: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.reference: Ukugxekwa okukhulu komzamo wokwakha kabusha kugxile ekuklomeliseni ukuvuselelwa kwezinkontileka ukuze baqonde ezangaphakathi zase-Washington.
translations.hypothesis: आलोचनाजनक प्रतिक्रिया कडाको पुनर्निर्माण प्रयासले, केन्द्रित छमा, दिइएका पुनर्निर्माण सम्धनाहरू, कडाले, "वाशिंगटन" मा परिचित व्यक्तिहरूलाई।

translations.source: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.reference: Abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezine baya eRoma enkonzweni yomngcwabo eRoma.
translations.hypothesis: ल्याम्भर daripada चार मिलियन मानिस गए ते Rome כדי హాजिमा।

translations.source: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.reference: Inani labantu ababekhona lalilikhulu kangangokuba kwakungenzeki ukuba wonke umuntu angene enkonzweni yomngcwabo eSt. Peter's Square.
translations.hypothesis: సంఖ్య मान्छेहरू आउनको थियो, धेरै धेरै, र यो सम्भव नथाय कि सबै मान्छेहरू पहुँच गर्न स्ट. पेटर स्क्वायरमा।

translations.source: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.reference: Izikrini ezinkulu eziningana zethelevishini zifakiwe ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene eRoma ukwenzela ukuthi abantu babukele umcimbi.
translations.hypothesis: अंकुरित ठूला टिभी स्क्रीनहरू स्थापना गरिएका छन् विभिन्न स्थानहरूमा मा रोम, ताकि मानिसहरूले सो आयोजना हेर्न सकुन्।

translations.source: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.reference: Kwamanye amazwe amaningi waseNtaliyane nasemhlabeni wonke, ngokukhethekile ePoland, ukumiswa okufanayo kwenziwe, okubukwe abantu abaningi kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: यस, र्यय अन्य शहरहरू र सम्पूर्ण जहान, विशेष गरी पोल्यान्ड, समान संरचनाहरू पनि निर्माण गरिए, र यी संरचनाहरूले धेरै मानिसहरूले हेला।

translations.source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.reference: Abezomlando bagxeke imithetho edlule yeFBI ngokugxila emacaleni alula ukuwaxazulula, ikakhulukazi amacala okuntshontshwa kwezimoto, ngenjongo yokukhuphula izinga lokuphumelela le nkampani.

translations.source: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.

translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa ने, 70 रन, मार् 41 बल, 11 फोर र र 2 सिक्स, बनाएको।

translations.source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.reference: Amadoda ashayayo adlalela phakathi, u-Sachin Tendulkar no-Rahul Dravid, bedlale kahle futhi benza umsebenzisano wokugijima ka-100.

translations.source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.reference: Kodwa, ngemva kokuba kukhiswhe ukaputeni wayo, iNdiya yenze amaphuzu angu-36 kuphela ilahlekelwa amawikhethi angu-7 kuze kube sekugcineni kwengxenye yomdlalo.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, पछि कप्तानको विकेट खोए, भारतले मात्र 36 रन बनाउन सफल भयो, तथापि 7 विकेट खोए र खेल सक्यो।

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.reference: UMongameli waseMelika uGeorge W. Bush wafika eSingapore ekuseni ngoLwezi 16, eqalisa uhambo lwakhe lweviki lokuvakashela i-Asia.
translations.hypothesis: राष्ट्रपतिสหรัฐ, ज्यार्ज बुश, पुग्लि, 16 नोभेम्बर, सुरु, एक यात्रा तर्फ एशिया, जो दुई दिन चल्ने.

translations.source: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.reference: Wabingelelwa yiPhini likaNdunankulu wase-Singapore u-Wong Kan Seng futhi baxoxa ngezohwebo kanye nezokuvakasha noNdunankulu waseSingapore uLee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: असमले, उपप्रधान मन्त्री Wong Kan Seng, ले स्वागत गरे, र उनले सिंगापुरका प्रधान मन्त्री Lee Hsien Loong संग व्यापार र आतंकवादका विषयहरूमा छलफल गरेका थिए।

translations.source: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.

translations.hypothesis: न सिर्का क्षति वा चोटहरू, तर मा Tonga, ले रिपोर्ट भयो, तर बिजुली क्षणिक रूपमा हट, र यसले कथित रूपमा Tongan अधिकारीहरूलाई PTWC द्वारा जारी गरिएको सुनामीचे चेतावनी प्राप्त गर्नबाट रोके।

translations.source: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.reference: Izikole eziyishumi nanye eHawaii ezisendaweni noma eziseduze nogu bezivaliwe ngoLwesithathu wonke nangaphezu kokususwa kwesixwayiso.
translations.hypothesis: तेइस विद्यालयहरू, जुन अवस्थित मा या नजिक, मा हवाई, बन्द भए, धेरै चेतावनी हटाउन गरिए तापनि।

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.reference: Umongameli waseMelika uGeorge W Bush wasamukela isimemezelo.
translations.hypothesis: राष्ट्रपतिสหรัฐ, ज्यार्ज बुश, स्वागतलाई।

translations.source: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.reference: Umkhulumeli kaBush uGordon Johndroe ubize isithembiso seNyakatho Korea "ngesinyathelo esiyinhloko emgomweni wokususwa kwezikhali zenuzi okungafakazelwa enhlonhlweni yaseKorea."
translations.hypothesis: अधिकारी गुर्डन जोन्ड्रोयले, प्रतिनिधि, भोगेले, "प्रतिज्ञा" बाट, "एक महत्त्वपूर्ण चाल मापन, ताकि कोरियाली प्रायद्वीपको विश्वसनीय परमाणु हतियार हटाउन हासिल गर्न।"

translations.source: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.reference: Isiphepho seshumi esinikwe igama senkathi yeziPhepho zase-Atlantic, iSiphepho Sendawo Efudumele uJerry, saqala oLwandlekazini i-Atlantic namuhla.
translations.hypothesis: असा, दशौम नाम, "Subtropical Storm Jerry", जो छिटपुट क्षेत्र, गठन भयो।

translations.source: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.reference: INational Hurricane Center (NHC) ithi kulenkathi uJerry ingaba nosongo ezweni.
translations.hypothesis: மைய केन्द्र (NHC) ले भन्छ, कि यस समय, जेरीले भूमिलाई खतरा प्रस्तुत गर्दैन।

translations.source: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
translations.reference: I-U.S. Corps of Engineers lilinganise ukuthi ukuna kwemvula engama-intshi angu-6 angafohla uhide lwezindundumela ezimoshekile esikhathini esidlule.
translations.hypothesis: अमेरिकी सेनाले प्रक्षेपित कि 6 इन्चको वर्षाले, लेभेज जुन पहिले क्षतिग्रस्त भअको, सकलन।

translations.source: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.reference: I-Ninth Ward, elabonakala likhukhuleka ngamagxathu angu-20 phakathi Nesiphepho uKatrina, okwamanje linamanzi asokhalweni njengoba amanzi elweqe ngaphezulu udonga lokuvimba amanzi oluseduze.
translations.hypothesis: दितीय Ward, मार्तिनाले, जतातमा पानी 20 అడుగుसम्म, अहिलेमा पानी छ, किनकि नजिकको बाँध भयंकर।

translations.source: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.reference: Amanzi ayachitheka ngaphezu kohide lwezindundumela engxenyeni engamafidi angu-100 ububanzi.
translations.hypothesis: यस, पानी भयंकर, मापन 100 అడుగులు चौड़ा, लेभीमा।

translations.source: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.reference: Umqondisi weCommons u-Adam Cuerden uzwakalise ukukhungatheka kwakhe ngokusulwa ngemva kokukhuluma ne-Wikinews ngenyanga edlule.
translations.hypothesis: प्रशासक Adam Cuerden व्यक्त गरे निराशा שלהको कति लेखहरू हटाइ भए, जब उनले Wikinews मा माथिको महिना बोल।

translations.source: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.reference: "Yena [uWales] ngokuyisisekelo ukhulume amanga kusuka ekuqaleni. Okokuqala, ngokushaya sengathi lokhu bekungenxa yezizathu ezingokomthetho. Okwesibili, ngokuzishaya sengathi wayesilalele, kuze kube sekususweni kobuciko bakhe."
translations.hypothesis: "य [वेल्स] अनिवार्य रूपमा हामीलाई फसाउन। पहिलो, भन्दै यो लेग्ली कारणहरूका लागि हो। दोस्रो, भन्दै कि ऊ हामीलाई सुन्छ, सम्मसम्म कि ऊ आफ्नो कला हटाउन।"

translations.source: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.

translations.source: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.

translations.source: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.

translations.source: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.

translations.source: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
translations.reference: Isichasiselo sithi okumnyama okuzungeze umthala kuzungeze umthala njengendingilizi yokukhanya yohlobo oluthile, futhi kwenziwe ngezinto ezincane eziningi.
translations.hypothesis: यसै सिद्धाँत भन्छ कि अधिकांश डार्क म्याटरround a galaxy अवस्थित छ, र अवस्थित छ round a galaxy in a विशेष प्रकारको "halo", र यसले बनेको छ।

translations.source: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
translations.reference: Imibiko kamabonakude ibonisa intuthu emhlophe iphuma esitshalweni.
translations.hypothesis: रिपोर्टहरूले देखाउँछन् कि धુवाँ कालो र आउँछबाट।

translations.source: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
translations.reference: Iziphathimandla zasendaweni zixwayisa abahlali abaseduze nendawo yemboni ukuba bahlale ezindlini, bacime izipholisa-moya futhi bangaphuzi amanzi ompompi.
translations.hypothesis: अधिकारीहरूले, स्थानीय,ले निजहरू जो नजिकPlant,ले, भित्र रहने, एयर-कन्डेसनरहरू बन्द गर्न, र नलगा, पानी नดื่ม, चेतावनी दिन्छन्।

translations.source: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
translations.reference: Ngokwenkampani yenuzi yaseJapan, imisebe yenuzi ye-caesium ne-iodine itholakale endaweni yokusebenzela.
translations.hypothesis: भेल अनुसार, मन्त्रालयले बताएको छ, रेडियोधर्मी सेसियम र आयोडीन फेला परिसं।

translations.source: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.reference: Iziphathimandla zicabangela ukuthi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iziqukathi ebeziqukethe amafutha e-uranium endaweni yokusebenzela kungenzeka ukuthi ziqhumile futhi ziyavuza.
translations.hypothesis: अधिकारीले भविष्यवाणी गरेका छन् कि यसले संकेत गर्छ कि कन्टेनरहरू, जुन साइटमा युरेनियम इग्नेसन समातिएको छन्, मलबे हुन सक्छन् र लीक भइरहेको छ।

translations.source: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.reference: UDkt. Tony Moll wathola i-Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) esifundeni saseNingizimu Afrika KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.hypothesis: डा. टोनी मोलले, रोग प्रतिरोधी क्षयरोग (XDR-TB) मा, विशेष गरी ज्याले, मार्मिक, मार्, मा भेटे, जुन दक्षिण अफ्रिकाको KwaZulu-Natal क्षेत्रमा।

translations.source: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
translations.reference: Engxoxweni, uthe okuhlukile okusha "kukhathaza kakhulu futhi kuyethusa ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lokufa kwabantu."
translations.hypothesis: यस साक्षात्कारमा, उनु भर्टी, नयाँ प्रकार "अति चिंतातना र डरालो, कारण यसको मृत्यु दर एकदमै उच्च।"

translations.source: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.reference: Ezinye iziguli zithole igciwane esibhedlela, kucabanga uDkt. Moll, futhi okungenani ababili bekuyizisebenzi zempilo zasesibhedlela.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, डा. मोल विश्वास, केही रोगीले संक्रमण क्रयित गरेका हुन, र कम से कम दुई जना थिए स्वास्थ्यकर्मी अस्पताल।

translations.source: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.reference: Ngesikhathi sonyaka owodwa, umuntu othelelekile angathelela abantu asondelene nabo abangu-10 kuya ku-15.
translations.hypothesis: यस, एउगो व्यक्ति, 10 देखि 15 नजिकका व्यक्ति, हुर्क।

translations.source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.reference: Nokho, iphesenti le-XDR-TB eningini labantu abaphila nesifo sofuba kubukeka siphansi; u-6,000 wabantu abangu-330,000 abathintekayo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi eNingizimu Afrika.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, प्रतिशतता ले XDR-TB मा सम्पूर्ण समूह मानिस, जेले क्षय, अद्याप जतात, लगभग नगणীয়; 6,000 मध्ये, कूल 330,000 मानिस जे दक्षिण अफ्रिकमा कतिपय समयमा संक्रमित हुनु।

translations.source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.reference: Amasathelayithi, womabili anesisindo esingaphezu  kwamaphawundi angu-1,000, futhi zihamba cishe ngamamayela angu-17,500 ngehora, zishayisene amamayela angu-491 ngaphezu koMhlaba.
translations.hypothesis: उपग्रहहरू, दुवै तिनी तौल 1,000 पाउन्ड, र गति लगभग 17,500 माइल प्रति שעה, दुर्घटनाग्रस्त भइन् 491 माइल माथि, धेरै मा पृथ्वी।

translations.source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.reference: Ososayensi bathi ukuqhuma okudalwe ukushayisana kwakukukhulu.
translations.hypothesis: वैज्ञानिकहरू भन्छन्, स्फोटाले निम्त्याएको, थियो धेरै ठूल।

translations.source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.reference: Basazama ukuthola ukuthi kube kukhulu kangakanani ukugqubuzana nokuthi uMhlaba uzothinteka kanjani.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, उला अझेल प्रयास गरिरहेका छन्, ताकि निर्धारण गर्न, के क्र्यास धेरै ठूल थियो र पृथ्वी कति प्रभावित हुने।

translations.source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.reference: I-United States Strategic Command yehhovisi loMnyango Wezokuvikela e-U.S. ilandelela le mfucumfucu.
translations.hypothesis: कार्यालय डिफेन्स डिपार्टमेन्ट, विभागय Strategic Command, ले, संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका, ले, फ्याक्टेहरूलाई हेर्नु।

translations.source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.reference: Imiphumela yokuhlaziya udaba izobhalwa kuyiwebhusayithi.
translations.hypothesis: परिणामको विश्लेषणले, ќैले प्रकाशित हुनेमा सार्वजनिक वेबसाइट।

translations.source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.reference: Udokotela owayesebenza eSibhedlela seziNgane sasePittsburgh, ePennsylvania uzobekwa icala lokubulala ngesisihluku ngemva kokuba unina etholakale eshonile endaweni yokubeka izimpahla ngemuva kwemoto yakhe ngoLwesithathu, kusho iziphathimandla e-Ohio.
translations.hypothesis: एक चिकित्सक, जो काम गरे कय Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, ќै, ќै आโทษ गरिने ले, पछि उनको आमा भेट्टाउन ग्या कय ज्या, Wednesday, कय Ohio मधील अधिकारीहरूले बताए।

translations.source: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.reference: UDkt. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, utholwe eBlue Ash,  e-Ohio, idolobha elicishe libe amamayela angu-15 enyakatho yeCincinnati elele phansi eceleni komgwaqo ngesikibha kanye nezingubo zangaphansi ebonakala sengathi unikwe imithi eminingi yezinhlungu.
translations.hypothesis: डा. मलर बालासुब्रामानियन, 29, फेला भन्दा, ओहायो, एक उपशहरी क्षेत्र, लगभग 15 माइल उत्तरमा सिन्सिनाटी, लेग्ड मा, डाक्टर, एउटा टी-शर्ट र अंडरवियर, र स्पष्ट रूपमा औषध प्रयोग गरिएको अवस्थामा।

translations.source: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.reference: Uqondise izikhulu kuyi-Oldsmobile Intrigue yakhe eyayikude ngamafidi angu- 500.
translations.hypothesis: ธอले निर्देशन अधिकारीहरूलाई पुग्नु क्यै उनको काला Oldsmobile Intrigue, मार् 500 అడుగు।

translations.source: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
translations.reference: Lapho, bathola umzimba kaSaroja Balasubramanian, oneminyaka engu-53, wembozwe ngezingubo zokulala ezinindwe yigazi.
translations.hypothesis: त्यहाँ, तिनीन्พบ शवको सरोजा बालासुब्रामानियन, उ อายุ 53, रंगेर रक्ताले।

translations.source: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
translations.reference: Amaphoyisa athe umzimba ububonakala sengathi ubulapho izinsuku eziningi.
translations.hypothesis: पोलिसले बताए की शवको देखिए लगभग एक दिन।

translations.source: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
translations.reference: Ukuba khona kwesifo kulenkathi kwaqala ukubikwa ekupheleni uNtulikazi.
translations.hypothesis: पहला случаи यो रोग यस सिजन पहिलीसँग, लगभग जुलाईको अन्तमा रिपोर्ट गरिए।

translations.source: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.reference: Lesi sifo sitholakala ezingulubeni, bese sidlulela ebantwini ngominyane.
translations.hypothesis: रोग प्रसारित गरिन्छ लेकु, र लेकु त्यसपछि फैलन्छ मानिसहरूमा, मार्फत डासहरू.

translations.source: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.reference: Lolu bhubhane lushukumise uhulumeni waseNdiya ukuba athathe izinyathelo ezinjengokuthumela ababamba izingulube ezindaweni ezithinteke kakhulu, ukusakaza izigidi zamakhethini womiyane kanye nokufutha imithi ebulala izinambuzane.
translations.hypothesis: लाग्नाले, ממשलतले भारतले उठाएका उपायहरू, जस्तै, पसलहरूलाई क्षेत्रहरू जसमा प्रकोपले निक बेर, वितरणको हजारौं मच्छर पर्दा, र कीटनाशक छாய,

translations.source: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.reference: Izigidi ezimbalwa zamabhodlela womjovo wesifo sobuchopho zithenjiswe uhulumeni, azosiza ukulungiselela izinhlangano zezempilo unyaka ozayo.
translations.hypothesis: ल्या, सरकारले पनि केही मिलियन मात्रा एन्सेफलाइटिस खोरासान, मार्को, र यसले स्वास्थ्य संस्थाहरूलाई अर्को वर्षको लागि तयारी गर्न मद्दत गर्ने।

translations.source: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
translations.reference: Izinhlelo zemijovo okumelwe ithunyelwe ezindaweni ezithinteke kakhulu ngokomlando kulonyaka zilibazisiwe ngenxa yokungabi nemali nokungathathwa njengokubalulekile uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifo.
translations.hypothesis: योजनाहरूले, вакциनाहरूले यस वर्ष ऐतिहासिक रूपमा धेरै प्रभावित क्षेत्रहरूमा वितरण गरिने,ले स्थगित भयो, किनकि त्यहाँ अभावको कारण र अन्य रोगहरूको तुलनामा, यसले कम प्राथमिकता दिइएको।

translations.source: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
translations.reference: Ngo-1956 u-Słania wathuthela e-Sweden, lapho iminyaka emithathu kamuva waqala ukusebenzela iHhovisi lePosi lase-Sweden futhi waba umqophi wabo omkhulu.
translations.hypothesis: यस 1956, Słaniarel,

translations.source: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
translations.reference: Wenzele iSweden izitembu ezingaphezu kuka-1,000 kanye nezingu-28 zamanye amazwe.
translations.hypothesis: هغه तयार गरि 1,000 स्ट्याम्पहरू र 28 अन्य देशहरू।

translations.source: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
translations.reference: Umsebenzi wakhe ungowekhwalithi eyaziwayo nemininingwane kangangokuthi ungelinye “lamagama aziwayo” phakathi kwabafundi bezitembu. Abanye bangochwepheshe bokuqoqa umsebenzi wakhe wodwa.
translations.hypothesis: कार्य यसको उच्च गुणवत्ता र विवरणले, यसले उहाँलाई फिलटेलिस्टहरूमा केही मात्र "प्रसिद्ध व्यक्ति" बनास। केही विशेषज्ञतामा मात्र यसको कार्य सङ्कलनमा।

translations.source: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
translations.reference: Isitembu sakhe se-1,000 “bekuyiZenzo eZinkulu zamaKhosi waseSweden” ezibabazekayo ezenzwe nguDavid Klöcker Ehrenstrahl ngo-2000, esibhalwe ku-Guinness Book of World Record.
translations.hypothesis: stamp नम्बर 1,000 थियो "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" ले, लेखक David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl, प्रकाशित भेल, र यसले 2000 मा प्रकाशित भयो। यो stamp समावेश छ मा Guinness Book of World Records.

translations.source: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
translations.reference: Wayetholakele nasekudwebeni imali eyiphepha yamazwe amaningi, izibonelo zakamuva zomsebenzi wakhe zihlanganisa imifanekiso yoNdunankulu phambi kwemali yephepha yaseCanada engu-$5 kanye no-$100.
translations.hypothesis: তেওलेले पनि संलग्न रहेको छ, सिर्प धेरै देशहरूका नोटहरू डिजाइन गर्ने, हालका उदाहरणहरू मध्ये, नयाँ क्यानेडियन $5 र $100 नोटहरूमा प्रधानमन्त्रीका चित्रहरू समावेश छन्।

translations.source: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
translations.reference: Ngemva kokuba kwenzeke ingozi, uGibson wayiswa esibhedlela kodwa washona ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि दुर्घटना भित्र, Gibson फौँड, तर उला भित्र, र त्यसपछि उमे

translations.source: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
translations.reference: Umshayeli weloli, oneminyaka engu-64, akalimalanga ekunqubuzaneni.
translations.hypothesis: चालक ट्रक,  जो berusia 64, אינוได้รับ चोटहरू во вок.

translations.source: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
translations.reference: Imoto ngokwayo yasuswa endaweni ingozi eyenzeke kuyo cishe ngo-1200 GMT ngosuku olufanayo.
translations.hypothesis: वाहनले स्वतः हटाइ dikeluarkan गयो, लगभग 1200 GMT, तेश्रो दिन, स्थल दुर्घटना।

translations.source: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
translations.reference: Umuntu osebenza egalaji eduze nalapho okwenzeke khona inhlekelele uthe: "Bekunezingane ezilinde ukuwela umgwaqo futhi zonke bezimemeza futhi zikhala."
translations.hypothesis: एक व्यक्ति जो कामकोमा, नजिक जताततै दुर्घटना भएन, भन्नु: "थिए केहिले, जो बाले बाले, र उनी सबैला रोन् र च्यान्।"

translations.source: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.
translations.reference: Bonke bagijima babuyela lapho ingozi yenzeke khona.
translations.hypothesis: सबै दौ दौ फर्बाट, जहाँ दुर्घटना भयो।

translations.source: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.
translations.reference: Ezinye izindaba okuzoxoxwa ngazo emhlanganweni eBali zihlanganisa ukuvikela amahlathi womhlaba asele, nokwabelana ngezobuchwepheshe ukusiza amazwe athuthukayo ukuba akhule ngezindlela ezingangcolisi kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: अन्य विषय जुन बालीको कार्यक्रममा समावेश छन्, मध्ये समावेश छन्, बचत गर्ने बाँकी वनोंचो, र विकासशील देशहरूले कम प्रदूषणकारी तरिकाले विकसित हुन मद्दत गर्ने, प्रविधि साझा गर्ने.

translations.source: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
translations.reference: I-U.N ifuna ukuqedela isikhwama sokusiza amazwe athintwe ukufudumala kwembulunga yonke ukuba abhekane namathonya.
translations.hypothesis: यूनियनलेले, पनि आशा छ कि ќैले कोष ќै तयार पार्ने, ताकि मुलुकहरू, जे प्रभावित भएयस्यानें, ќै जलवायु परिवर्तन ќै सामना गर्न मद्दत पुगे.

translations.source: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
translations.reference: Imali ingasetshenziselwa izindlu ezingakhukhuleki, indlela yokuphatha amanzi engcono, kanye nezinhlobonhlobo zezitshalo.
translations.hypothesis: यस धनสามารถ उपयोग गर्न सकिन्छ, ताकि घरहरू सुरक्षित हुन, पानीको व्यवस्थापन सुधारित हुन, र बाली विविधतालाई प्रोत्साहन गर्न सकू।

translations.source: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
translations.reference: UFluke ubhale ukuthi imizamo yabanye yokuvimba abesifazane ukuthi bakhulume ngempilo yabesifazane ayiphumelelanga.

translations.source: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."

translations.source: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.

translations.hypothesis: "मध्ये, उ cooler भन्दा सतह, र साँदमा warmer।

translations.source: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.reference: Ukuziphatha kwayo kokushisa akuzinzanga njengemigede emikhulu eMhlabeni leyo egcina izinga lokushisa cishe elifanayo kaningi, kodwa iyafana nalena ngokuba imigodi ejulile enhlabathini, kwasho uGlen Cushing we-United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team kanye neNorthern Arizona University eseFlagstaff, e-Arizona.
translations.hypothesis: व्यवहार שלהם איसँको स्थिर जत्था, जत्था ठूला गुफा कडा जसमा, जुन सामान्यतया स्थिर तापमान कायम राख्न, तर यो मेल खाले, "भर्यासले,Glen Cushing, सदस्यको United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team र Northern Arizona University, जो स्थित छ Flagstaff, Arizona, भन्न्यो।

translations.source: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.reference: E-France, ukuvota kwakuyisiko lobuchwepheshe obuphansi: abavoti bazihlukanisa bodwa ebhokisini, babeka iphepha eliphrintiwe ekuqaleni elibonisa ukhetho lwabo ngaphakathi kwemvilophi.
translations.hypothesis: युरोप, मतदान ऐतिहासिक रूपमा अनुभव सरल: मतदाता छिटपुट, र लेखेको कागजात, मार्केन्ट उम्मेद्वार, भित्र एक पुंज।

translations.source: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.reference: Ngemva kokuba iziphathimandla ziqinisekise ubuqu bomuntu ovotayo, abavotayo balahlela izimvilophu ebhokisini lamaphepha okuvota futhi basayine uhlu lwabavotayo.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि अधिकारी पुष्टि पहिचान, मतदातालेEnvelope मा भित्र थिरे र हस्ताक्षरमा मतदान सूची।

translations.source: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.reference: Umthetho wokhetho waseFrance kunalokho uhlanganisa ngokuqinile ukuqulwa kwamacala.
translations.hypothesis: कानूनको नियम, विशेषतः, कडाकान।

translations.source: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.reference: Kusukela ngo-1988, amabhokisi amaphepha okuvota kumelwe kube abonisayo ukuze abavoti kanye nezibukeli bafakazele ukuthi azikho izimvilophu ezikhona lapho kuqala ukuvota nokuthi azikho izimvilophu ezifakwayo ngaphandle kwalezo zabavoti ababalwe ngokufanelekile nabagunyaziwe.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि देखिल, बक्सहरू अवश्य लिन पारदर्शी भइन्, ताकि मतदाता र पर्यवेक्षक देखून् कि אין कति बक्सहरू पछि मतदान, र केवल सही गणना गरिएको र अधिकृत मतदाताहरूले प्रयोग गरेका बक्सहरू मात्र थिम।

translations.source: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.reference: Amakhandidethi angathumela abameli ukuze babone zonke izingxenye zenqubo. Kusihlwa, amavoti abalwa amavolontiya abekwe iso elibukhali, alandela izinqubo ezithile.
translations.hypothesis: कandidatहरूสามารถ पठाउन प्रतिनिधि כדי हेर्न सबै पक्ष। साँद, मतहरू गणना गरिन्छ ले स्वयंसेवका, तथा कडा नियन्त्रण, र विशिष्ट प्रक्रियाहरू।

translations.source: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.reference: I-ASUS Eee PC, ngaphambili iqalise ukusebenza emhlabeni jikelele ngenxa yezizathu zokonga izindleko nezokusebenza, okwaba wundabamlonyeni ngonyaka ka-2007 ngenyanga yeTaipei IT.
translations.hypothesis: ASUS Eee PC, जे पहिले विश्वव्यापी रूपमा அறிமுகित भयो, र यसले लागत बचत र कार्यक्षमता प्रदान गर्दछ, भर्खरै 2007 मा, Taipei IT Month मा, चर्चाको विषय बनेको।

translations.source: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
translations.reference: Kepha abathengi bekhompuyutha ephathekayo bazohluka kakhulu futhi baguquke ngemva kokuba i-ASUS iklomeliswe Eklomelweni Wokulondoloza wase-Taiwan ngo-2007 ilungu lesiGungu uYuan waseRiphabhulikini yaseShayina.
translations.hypothesis: तर, बजारको मागको लागि लपटप कम्प्युटर, बद्लाव हुने र परिवर्तनशील हुनुपर्छ, र यो पछि, कम्पनी ASUS, ले 2007 मा, "Taiwan Sustainable Award" बाट पुरस्कार, प्राप्त गरेको छ, र यसले "Executive Yuan" ले, चीनको गणराज्य, दिन्छ।

translations.source: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
translations.reference: Iwebhusayithi yesiteshi ichaza uhlelo "njengomdlalo womsakazo odla ngoludala onokwaziswa okusha kwezobuchwepheshe!"
translations.hypothesis: वेबसाइट स्टेशन्सले कार्यक्रमलाई "एक क्लासिक रेडियो थिएटर, रिलै, र पूर्ण रूपान्तरित!"

translations.source: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
translations.reference: Ngesikhathi lusaqala, lolu hlelo lwalufaka lodwa isikhathi eside emsakazweni we-inthanethi i-TogiNet, lengosi yayigxile emisakazweni ekhulumayo.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, कार्यक्रमको सुरु, यसले मुख्य रूपमा TogiNet Radio, एक इन्टरनेट रेडियो साइट, मार्फत प्रसारित भयो, जे होय एक साइट जे मुख्य रूपमा च्याट रेडियोमा केन्द्रित।

translations.source: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
translations.reference: Ekupheleni kuka-2015, iTogiNet yamisa i-AstroNet Radio njengesiteshi njengesiteshi esingaphansi kwayo
translations.hypothesis: यस 2015, TogiNet स्थापना AstroNet Radio, जस्तो एक सहायक स्टेशन।

translations.source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
translations.reference: Umdlalo ekuqaleni wawunabalingisi bezwi abangafundile, endaweni yase-East Texas.
translations.hypothesis: प्रारम्भिक रूपमा, कार्यक्रमले स्थानीय प्रतिभा, जो छिमेटी क्षेत्रमा बसन्, समावेश गर्दथ।

translations.source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
translations.reference: Ukugqekeza okugcwele konke kubikwa ukuthi kwaqhubeka ubusuku bonke, njengoba amaphoyisa ayengekho emigwaqweni yaseBishkek.
translations.hypothesis: looting, reportedly, जारी रह्यो,बिना प्रहरी अधिकारीहरू Bishkek सडकहरूमा उपस्थित नहुँदा।

translations.source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.reference: IBishkek beyichazwa njengecwila esimweni seziyaluyalu” ngomunye wababukeli, njengoba amaqembu wabantu ayezulazula emigwaqweni futhi bephanga izitolo zezimpahla zabathengi. "
translations.hypothesis: Bishkek, ले एक पर्यवेक्षकले, वर्णन गरेको छ जस्तो छ, "अराजक" अवस्था। समूह-समूह मानिसहरू सडकहरूमा विचरण गरेका थिए, र उपभोक्ता सामानहरूले দোকানहरू लुटिरहेका थिए।

translations.source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.reference: Abahlali abaningana baseBishkek bathwese ababhikishi abasuka eningizimu icala lokwephulwa komthetho.
translations.hypothesis: खुलि, धेरै बासिन्कवासी आरोप्यान्ले, प्रदर्शनकारीहरू, विशेषतः ती देखिको दक्षिण, ले गैरकानूनीताको जिमेदारी.

translations.source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.reference: INingizimu Afrika ihlule ama-All Blacks (iNyuzilandi) emdlalweni we-ragbhi wenyunyoni we-Tri Nations eRoyal Bafokeng Stadium, eRustenburg, eNingizimu Afrika.
translations.hypothesis: दक्षिण अफ्रिकाले "All Blacks" (न्यूजिल्यान्ड) स्तभयित भएस, मा एक रग्बी युनियन त्रि-नations खेल, जुन "Royal Bafokeng Stadium" मा, रस्टenburg, दक्षिण अफ्रिका।

translations.source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.reference: Imiphumela yokugcina bekuwukuphumelela kwephuzu elilodwa, u-21 ku-20, okwaqeda ukuwina njalo kwama-All Blacks kwemidlalo engu-15.
translations.hypothesis: स्कोरअन्तमा, टोलीले जिते 21-20, र यसले "All Blacks" को 15 खेल लगतको क्रम समाप्त पारे.

translations.source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.reference: KumaBhokobhoko, lokhu kunqamule ukungaphumeleli emidlalweni emihlanu elandelanayo.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यसले Springboks समाप्त पार्ला, र यसले पाँचौ खेलमा हार।

translations.source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.reference: Bekuwumdlalo wokugcina wama-All Blacks, asephumelele kakade indebe emavikini ambalwa adlule.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यो थियो थियोअन्तर्गतकोअंतिम खेल, र "All Blacks" ले पहिले दुई हप्पुययस।

translations.source: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.reference: Umdlalo wokugcina womqhudelwano uzokwenzeka e-Ellis Park eGoli ngeviki elizayo, lapho ama-Springbok edlala ne-Australia.
translations.hypothesis: משחקअंतिम शृङ्खला हुनेको छ, र ќајќа, Springboks ќа игра против Австралија, ќа се आयोजना मा Ellis Park, Johannesburg, अर्को हप्ता.

translations.source: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
translations.reference: Ukuzamazama komhlaba okuncane kwanyakazisa intshonalanga ye-Montana ngo-10: 08 p.m. ngoMsombuluko.
translations.hypothesis: भूकम्प, औसत, हिलायो bahagian पश्चिम मा Montana, साँ 10:08 त बिहीरा.

translations.source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.reference: Ayikho imibiko esheshayo yomonakalo etholwe yi-United States Geological Survey (USGS) kanye ne-National Earthquake Information Center yayo.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि,สำนักงานสำรวจ भूभाग (USGS) र यसको राष्ट्रिय केन्द्र जानकारी बारेभेलquakes, अझैसम्म, चिन्हित क्षतिहरू फेला न gekommen।

translations.source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
translations.reference: Ukuzamazama komhlaba kwakugxile endaweni cishe engama-20 km (amamayela angu-15) enyakatho esempumalanga esenyakatho yeDillon, futhi cishe nama-65 km (amamayela angu-40) eningizimu neButte.
translations.hypothesis: भूकम्पको केन्द्र थियो लगभग 20 किलोमिटर (15 माइल) उत्तर-पूर्व, नजिक Dillon, र लगभग 65 किलोमिटर (40 माइल) दक्षिण, नजिक Butte।

translations.source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.reference: Uhlobo lomkhuhlane wezinyoni olubulalayo ebantwini, i-H5N1, kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi luhlasele idada lasendle, elatholakala ngoMsombuluko, endaweni yamaxhaphozi eduze naseLyon empumalanga neFulansi.
translations.hypothesis: संसर्गजनक प्रकारको इन्फ्लुएन्जा, H5N1, मार्ने मानिस, पुष्टि भयो, ले एक मृत जंगली पोपट, फेलाउन भयो सोमबार, मा, मा, नजिकै लेओन, फ्रान्सको पूर्व,।

translations.source: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.reference: IFulansi yizwe lesikhombisa esiGungwini saseYurophu lokuthola leligciwane; ngemva kwe-Austria, iJalimane, iSlovenia, iBulgria, iGrisi kanye neNtaliyane.
translations.hypothesis: Франција हो देश नम्बर सातयौय मा युरोपियन संघ, र यसको अनुभव। पछि, Австри, जर्मनी, स्लोभेनिया, बुल्गारिया, ग्रीस र इटالیا।

translations.source: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.reference: Ubantu okusolakala ukuthi baphethwe i-H5N1 eCroatia naseDenmark abakaqinisekiswa.
translations.hypothesis: मामलाहरू जुन H5N1 मा संदेहास्पद हुन्, तिनहरू त Croatia र Denmark मा अڃै पुष्टि भएनन्।

translations.source: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.reference: I-Chambers yayimangalele uNkulunkulu“ngokwanda kakhulu kokufa, izinhlekelele kanye nokuphekulwa kwezigidi zezigidi zabahlali boMhlaba.”
translations.hypothesis: चेंबर्स लेगी "व्यापक मृत्यु, विनाश र भयङ्गारन" मा भगवानलाई अदालती सम्वाद।

translations.source: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.reference: UChambers, ongakholelwa kunkulunkulu, uphikisa ngokuthi ukumangalelwa kwakhe "akunanjongo" futhi "noma ubani angahlawulisa noma ubani."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers, जो गैर-धर्मी, दलीलायटी छ, भन्छ कि मुक उसका केस "बिना औचित्य" र "कु有人ले कुनहीको सामना गर्न सक्छ".

translations.source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.reference: Indaba evezwe ku-opera yaseFrance, ngu-Camille Saint-Saens, iciko “elikuphila kwalo kwathathwa uthando lwezidakamizwa kanye ne-Japani.”
translations.hypothesis: कथा प्रस्तुतित भित्र फ्रान्सीसी ओपेरा, द्वारा कामील सेंट-सान्स, हो कथाको एक कलाकार "यस जीवन निर्धारण गरिन्छ द्वारा प्रेम मा नशीकरण र जपान।"

translations.source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.reference: Njengomphumela, abaculi babhema amajoyinynti insangu ye-cannabis esiteji, futhi nethiyetha ngokwayo igqugquzela izilaleli ukuba zihlanganyele.
translations.hypothesis: यसैले, कलाकारहरू धूम्रपान गर्छन्, र थिएटरले दर्शकहरूलाई पनि यसमा सहभागी हुन प्रोत्साहित गरिरहेको छ।

translations.source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.reference: Umkhulumeli Wendlu uNewt Gingrich, umbusi waseTexas uRick Perry, kanye nelungu lesishaya-mthetho lowesifazane uMichele Bachmann baqede endaweni yesine, yesihlanu, kanye neyesithupha, ngokulandelana.
translations.hypothesis: पूर्व अध्यक्ष सदन, न्यूट गिङ्गरिच, गभर्नर टेक्सास, रिक पेरी, र सदस्य कांग्रेस, मिशेल बाचमान, क्रमशः, आन्न्न्चौ, पाँचौ र छौथ स्थान.

translations.source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.reference: Ngemva kokuba kufike imiphumela, uGingrich ubabaze uSantorum, kodwa wayenamazwi anzima kuRomney, lowo owenzelwa umkhankaso wezikhangiso ezimbi e-Iowa ngokumelene noGingrich.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि नतिजा आउन, Gingrichले Santorumलाई बधाई, तर Romney ले कडा प्रतिक्रिया, किनभने Romney को पक्षमा नकारात्मक अभियान विज्ञापनहरू Iowa मा Gingrich विरुद्ध प्रसारण गरिएको थियो।

translations.source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.reference: U-Perry wathi waye "zobuyela e-Texas ukuyohlola imiphumela yekhokhasi yanamuhla ebusuku, nginqume ukuthi ingabe ikhona yini indlela ephambili yami kulo mjaho", kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wathi uzohlala emncintiswaneni futhi ancintisane ngoMasingana 21 e-South Carolina primary.
translations.hypothesis: पेरीले बताए की उन "जाने फर्मा टेक्सास, ताकि मूल्याङ्गो परिणामहरू, र निर्धारण गनु छ के केही मार्ग छ मलाई यस चुनावमा", तर पछि उनले बताए की उनले चुनावमा रहनु छ र जनवरी २१ मा दक्षिण क्यारोलिनाको प्राथमिक चुनावमा प्रतिस्पर्धा गर्ने।

translations.source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.reference: UBachmann, owanqoba i-Ames Straw Poll  ngoNcwaba, wanquma ukuqeda umkhankaso.
translations.hypothesis: Bachmann, जो अगस्टमा Ames Straw Poll जिते, निर्णयले आफ्नो अभियान समाप्त गर्न।

translations.source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.reference: Umthwebuli wezithombe wayiswa esiKhungweni sezoKwelapha sikaRonald Reagan UCLA, lapho eshone khona ngokushesha.
translations.hypothesis: Фотографको लेक लेकRonald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, जताततै, र त्यहाँ पछि मरेको।

translations.source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.reference: Kuthiwa wayeseminyakeni yawo-20. Esitatimendeni, uBieber uthe "nakuba ngangingekho futhi ngingahilelekile ngokuqondile kulengozi ebuhlungu, imicabango kanye nemikhuleko yami inomndeni wesisulu."
translations.hypothesis: रिपोर्टले, उ थियो धेरै युवा, लगभग 20 वर्ष। मा एक वक्तव्य, Bieber भन्यो "[यद्यपि म प्रत्यक्ष रूपमा यस दुःखद दुर्घटनामा आउन थपे, तर मले पीडित परिवारलाई हार्दिक sympathies र प्रार्थना।"

translations.source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.reference: Iwebhusayithi yezindaba zokuzijabulisa i-TMZ iqonda ukuthi umthathi wezithombe wamisa imoto yakhe kolunye uhlangothi lweSepulveda Boulevard futhi wazama ukuthatha izithombe zamaphoyisa ayevimbezele ngaphambi kokuwela umgwaqo futhi aqhubeke, okwashukumisa iphoyisa leCalifornia Highway Patrol elalivimebezele izimoto ukuba limyalele ukuthi a welele emuva, kabili.

translations.source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.

translations.source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.reference: Ngaphambi kokufika kwamabutho, iHaiti beyingakahlangabezani nezinkinga ezihlobene nesifo kusukela ngawo-1800.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि सेनाले नआगमन, ह्युटीले 1800-कयस आन्द, समस्याहरू जुन रोगसँग सम्बन्धित छन्, अनुभव गरेको थिएन।

translations.source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.reference: Inhlangano yaseHaiti yoKulunga Nombuso Wentando Yeningi icaphune ucwaningo oluzimele olusikisela ukuthi iqembu lamabutho ayinkulungwane le-UN laseNephali lokugcina ukuthula lilethe isifo eHaiti lingazi.
translations.hypothesis: संस्थाले, "Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy",ले उल्लेख गरेको छ, आउनको स्वतन्त्र अध्ययनले देखाउँछ, कि युएन-को शान्दाजी बटालियन, जेने, अनजानेमा, ले रोगलाई पठाउन हaiti.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.reference: UDanielle Lantagne, isazi se-UN ngisifo, uthe kunamathuba okuthi ukuqubuka kwesifo kubangelwe abagcini bokuthula.
translations.hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, विशेषज्ञयित्‌का युएन मा विषयवस्तु, बताए की प्रकोप सम्भवतः भित्राले।

translations.source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.reference: UHamilton uqinisekise ukuthi Isibhedlela saseNyuvesi yaseHoward samukele isiguli sisesimweni esizinzile.
translations.hypothesis: Hamiltonले पुष्टि गरे कि अस्पतालले रोगीलाई स्थिर अवस्थामा स्वीकारे.

translations.source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.reference: Isiguli ebesiye eNigeria, lapho kwenzeke khona ezinye izigameko zegciwane le-Ebola.
translations.hypothesis: मरीजले नाइजीरिया गए, जताततै अवस्थाएँ अफिसल्या।

translations.source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.reference: Izibhedlela zilandele imithetho yokulawula ukutheleleka, okuhlanganisa ukuhlukanisa iziguli kwezinye ukuze kugwenywe ukutheleleka.
translations.hypothesis: स्पेशलले, अस्पतालले नियमावलीको पालना, समावेश गरी, रोगीलाई अरु व्यक्तिहरूबाट अलग गर्न, ताकि अरु व्यक्तिहरूमा संक्रमण नहोस्।

translations.source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.reference: Ngaphambi kweThe Simpsons uSimon wayesebenze ezinhlelweni eziningana ezikhundleni ezihlukahlukene.
translations.hypothesis: हेर The Simpsons, Simon ले काम गरेको छ, र यसले विभिन्न भूमिकाहरूमा काम गरेको छ।

translations.source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.reference: Ngeminyaka yama-1980 wasebenza emibukisweni efana neTaxi, i-Cheers, noMboniso we-Tracy Ullman.
translations.hypothesis: यस, во время 1980-ौ, उन काम गरिन् मा शो जस्तै Taxi, Cheers, र The Tracy Ullman Show.

translations.source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.reference: Ngo-1989 wasiza ukwakha i-The Simpsons no-Brooks kanye no-Groening, futhi wayenomthwalo wemfanelo wokuqasha iqembu lohlelo lokubhala lokuqala.
translations.hypothesis: यस 1989, उन सहयोगिरेयस साथ जेBrooks र Groening, र उन जिम्मेवारी लेली भर्ती गर्ने शोको पहिलो लेखन टोली।

translations.source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.reference: Ngaphezu kokuyeka uhlelo ngo-1993 ugcine isiqu somdidiyeli wohlelo, futhi waqhubeka nokuthola amashumi wezigidi zamadola isizini ngayinye wemivuzo.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि उन छोडि शो मा 1993, तर उन कायम रह्यो कार्यकारी निर्माता, र उन लगातार प्राप्त गर्द tens of millions of dollars प्रत्येक सिजनमा।

translations.source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.reference: Ngaphambili, inhlangano yezindaba yaseShayina i-Xinhua yabika ukuthi kunendiza ethunjiwe.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, एजेन्सीमा Xinhua, एक विमानถูก लुटिएको,報道.

translations.hypothesis: प्रतिबिन्कारी सान्кцииले अर्थ्याले, नयाँ विमानहरू किन्न सकँदैन।

translations.source: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.reference: Ekuqaleni kwaleli viki, ukuphahlazeka kwendiza yamaphoyisa enophephela emhlane kubulale abantu abathathu futhi kwalimaza abanye abathathu.
translations.hypothesis: यसבוע, दुर्घटनाकोibatkan एक विमान, तीन व्यक्तिको ज्यान गए, र तीन जना घायतन भए।

translations.source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.reference: Ngenyanga edlule i-Iran yavelelwa inhlekelele enkulu yezindiza ngemva kweminyaka lapho indiza eyayiphokophele e-Armenia yaphahlazeka khona, yabulala abangu-168 ababekuyo.
translations.hypothesis: महीनेयय, इरान अनुभव ग्या, सबैभन्दा खराब विमान दुर्घटना तिनै, जतिले एउटा विमान, जो क्युमानियातिर गन्तव्यमा थियो, दुर्घटना भयो, र 168 जो विमानमा थिए, मरे.

translations.source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.reference: Ngenyanga efanayo indiza idlule lapho umgwaqo wezindiza uphelela khona eMashhad futhi yashayisa udonga, ibulala abayishumi nesikhombisa.
translations.hypothesis: यही महिना, एक अन्य विमानलेMashhad मा रनवेमा ठोक्कि, र त्यसले पर्खेत, र १७ व्यक्ति मारिन।

translations.source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.reference: I-Aerosmith ikhansele amakhonsathi ayo asele ohambweni lwayo.
translations.hypothesis: Aerosmith स्थगिते बाकीको प्रदर्शनहरू अन्तर्गतको यात्रा।

translations.source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.reference: Iqembu lomculo we-rock bekufanele livakashele eMelika naseKhanada kuze kube nguMandulo 16.
translations.hypothesis: ग kumpulan संगीतले भवेलाले आयू, र क्यानाडा, सम्मते 16,

translations.source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.reference: Bakhansele uhambo ngemva kokuba umculi oyinhloko u-Steven Tyler elimele ngemva kokuwa esiteji ngenkathi ecula ngoNcwaba
translations.hypothesis: तिनीले रद्द गरेका छन्, र मुख्य गायक स्टिभन टायलर घाइते भएपछि, किनकि उनले 5अगस्टको प्रदर्शनमा स्टेजबाट प fallen.

translations.source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.reference: UMurray ulahlekelwe ingxenye yakhe yomdlalo emdlalweni wokubona ukuthi kuwina bani kwabalinganayo ngamaphuzu ngemva kokuthi womabili amadoda ayelingana ezinyeni zawo zomdlalo.
translations.hypothesis: Murray गुमाउन पहिलो सेट, रयस, किनजे दुईजनाले सेटमा प्रत्येक सेवा सफलतापूर्वक पूर्ण गरेका थिए।

translations.source: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
translations.reference: UDel Potro wayesesimweni esiyinzuzo ekuqaleni engxenyeni yesibili yomdlalo, kodwa lona nawo ubudinga umdlalo wokubona ukuthi kuphumelela bani kwabalinganayo ngemva kokufika ku-6-6.
translations.hypothesis: Del Potro има अग्रिम फाईदा во ते सम्, तर यसले पनि आवश्यक थियो, र पछि 6-6 पुगेपछि, आवश्यक थियो।

translations.source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.reference: UPotro uthole ukwelashwa ehlombe ngaleso sikhathi kodwa wakwazi ukubuyela emdlalweni .
translations.hypothesis: पोत्रो फुकमे प्राप्त उपचार, रर, तर उ सफल भாய्यो फर्кать खेल।

translations.source: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.reference: Uhlelo lwaqala ngo-8:30 p.m. ngesikhathi sendawo (15.00 UTC).
translations.hypothesis: कार्यक्रम शुरू भन्दा 8:30pm, स्थानीय समय (15.00 UTC).

translations.source: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
translations.reference: Abaculi abadumile ezweni lonke banikela ngama-bhajan, noma izingoma zokuzinikela, ezinyaweni zikaShri Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: गायक प्रसिद्ध, नभरू, प्रस्तुतन् भजन, जुन गीतहरूले উৎসर्पित हुन्, कय Shri Shyam.

translations.source: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Umculi uSanju Sharma bekunguye oqalile kusihlwa, elandelwa uJai Shankar Choudhary. Unikele nge-chhappan bhog bhajan ngokufanayo. Umculi, uRaju Khandelwala wayehamba naye.
translations.hypothesis: गायक Sanju Sharma सुरु, र त्यसपछि Jai Shankar Choudhary। उनी ले "चहपान भोघ Bhajan" ले पनि प्रस्तुतीकरण। गायक, Raju Khandelwal ले पनि साथ दिन्दें।

translations.source: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
translations.reference: Ngakho, uLakkha Singh uholile ekuculeni i-bhajans.
translations.hypothesis: त्यसैले, लाक्खा सिंहले भजनहरू गायनमा नेतृत्व लिन थाल्यो।

translations.source: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
translations.reference: Izitsha ezingu-108 zeChhappan Bhog (ngenkolelo yobuHindu, izinto ezidliwayo ezihlukile ezingu-56, njengamaswidi, izithelo, amantongomane, ukudla njll. Okunikelwa esithixweni) zanikezelwa kuBaba Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: 108 प्लेट्स פון चप्पान भोग (यसले, 56 विभिन्न खाने योग्य वस्तुहरू, जस्तै, मिठाई, फल, नट, थाल आदि, जुन देवतालाई दिन्छन्) बुबा श्यामलाई बुझाइयो।

translations.source: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: U-Lakkha Singh wanikezela ngange-Chhappan bhog bhajan. Umculi, uRaju Khandelwal bekahamba naye.
translations.hypothesis: लक्खा सिंहले पनि "चहपान भोघ Bhajan" प्रस्तुत गरे। गायक, राजु खंडेल्वाल, साथमा थिए।

translations.source: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.reference: EsethulwenisangoLwesine esasingumongo se-Tokyo Game Show, umongameli we-Nintendo u-Satoru Iwata wadalula isakhiwo sesilawuli se-Nintendo Revolution sesilawuli esisha senkampani.

translations.source: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.reference: Isilawuli esifana ne-remote yethelevishini, sisebenzisa izinzwa ezimbili ezibekwe duzane nethelevishini ukwenza indawo yayo ibe nezingxenye ezintathu endaweni enezinhlangothi ezintathu.
translations.hypothesis: समान जस्तो कि रिमोट, नियन्त्रक प्रयोग गरिन्छ, र यसले दुई सेन्सरहरू समावेश गर्दछ, जुन प्रयोगकर्ताको टेलिभिजन नजिक राखिएको छ, ताकि यसले तीन-आयामी स्थानमा आफ्नो स्थान निर्धारण गर्न सकू।

translations.source: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.reference: Lokhu kuzovumela abadlali ukuba balawule izenzo nokunyakaza emdlalweni wevidiyo ngokunyakazisa isisetshenziswa emoyeni.
translations.hypothesis: यदी, खेलाडीहरूले उपकरणलाई हवामा लेवाएर, आन्द्रेज र गਤੀहरू नियन्त्रण गर्न सक्षम हुनुला।

translations.source: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.reference: UGiancarlo Fisichella wangakwazi ukuqondisa imoto yakhe futhi waqeda umjaho ngokushesha ngomva kokuba uqale.
translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella गुमा नियन्त्रण врखर, र दौडान धेरै छिटो समाप्त भयो।

translations.source: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.reference: Abeqembu lakhe u-Fernando Alonso bebephuma phambili cishe kuwoo wonke umjaho, kodwa kuphele ngokushesha nje ngemva kokupaka endaweni yokulungisa imoto, kungenzeka kungenxa yesondo langaphambili elifakwe kabi.
translations.hypothesis: सहयोगीको, Fernando Alonso, थियो नेतृत्वको अधिकांश समय, तर अन्तमा, सायद कारण खराब रूपमा व्यवस्थित दाहिने अग्रभागको टायर, पछि।

translations.source: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.reference: UMichael Schumacher waqeda umjaho wakhe kungekudala ngemva kuka-Alonso, ngenxa yokulimala kwesimo esigcina imoto iphakeme emishikashikeni eminingi phakathi nomjaho.
translations.hypothesis: Michael Schumacher समाप्त उतिस, नजिक-नजिक पछि, कारण क्षतिमा, र दौडान भएका धेरै लडाईहरू।

translations.source: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.reference: "Muhle kakhulu futhi ucula kahle kakhulu, futhi," washo kuya ngamakhophi okukhulunyiwe wenkomfa yabezindaba.
translations.hypothesis: "हा एकदम मनमोहक र, र पनि निकै रामेनै गा, " भन्यो, अनुसार प्रतिलेख, सम्वाद।

translations.source: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.reference: Ngangithinteka ekujuleni kwenhliziyo yami, njalo lapho silungiselela lokhu.
translations.hypothesis: "मेला हरे, कहिले हामी अभ्यास गराउँदा, म महसूस गर्थे, र यो भावना आउँथय।"

translations.source: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.reference: Cishe emizuzwini emithathu ngaphambi kokuqalisa, ikhamera esemkhumbini yaveza izingcezu eziningi zogwebu olufudumazayo luphuma ethangini lamafutha.
translations.hypothesis: लगभग 3 मिनेटयूसँग प्रक्षेपण, एक क्यामेरा जो म pesawat मा स्थापित थियो, देखा के धेरै फोम इन्सुलेशन टुन्टा अलग भए।

translations.source: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.reference: Nokho, akucatshangwa ukuthi zenze noma imuphi umonakalo enqoleni.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, मानिएको छ कि तिनीहरूले नेन्जाहलाई कुनै क्षति भएन।

translations.source: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.reference: Isikhulu sohlelo lwemikhumbi-mkhathi luka-NASA u-N. Wayne Hale Jr. uthe igwebu lase liwile "ngemuva kwesikhathi esikhathazekile ngazo."
translations.hypothesis: अध्यक्ष कार्यक्रम "शटल" NASA, एन. वेन हेले जुर, भन्नु, "फोमले प fallen "यति बेला, जुन हामी चिन्ता गरेका छौ।"

translations.source: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.reference: Imizuzu emihlanu umbukiso uqalile umoya uqala ukungena, cishe ngemva komzuzu, umoya ufinyelela u-70km/h… bese imvula iyeza, kodwa enzima nenkulu kangangokuba ihlaba isikhumba sakho njengenaliti, bese isichotho sawa emkhathini, abantu bayaxhamazela futhi bayamemeza futhi bayagxobana.
translations.hypothesis: दुकानको पाँच मिनेट, एक वाลมला सुरु, लगभग एक मिनेटपछि, वाลมला 70किमी/घ достиग्ला... त्यसपछि, वर्षा आउनु, तर यो धेरै तीव्र र धेरै लामो, जस्तो कि यसले आफ्नो शरीर हान्नु, त्यसपछि, हिमले आउनु, मानिसहरू डराएर, रोउदै, र एक-निर्माण।

translations.source: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.reference: Ngilahlekelwe ngudadewethu kanye nomngane wakhe, futhi endleleni ngilibangise lapho bekunabantu ababili abakhubazekile ababehlezi ezihlalweni ezinamasondo, abantu bebeqa ngaphezulu futhi bebasunduza,” kusho u-Armand Versace.
translations.hypothesis: मिस, मैले खोसें, साथै उसको साथी, र मार्गमा, म दुई व्यक्ति बि Disabilities, जो प्रयोगन् wheelchair, मानिस बस उनी माथि उफ्रन र थलाउन," भने Armand Versace.

translations.source: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.reference: I-NHK ibike nokuthi isifunda sesikhungo samandla wenuzi iKashiwazaki Karawa eNiigata besisebenza ngokuvamile.
translations.hypothesis: NHK ले पनि रिपोर्ट गरेको छ, की Kashiwazaki Kariwa परमाणु ऊर्जा आयलत, जो Niigata प्रिफेक्चरमा, सामान्य रूपमा काम भइरहेको थियो।

translations.source: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.reference: IHokuriku Electric Power Co. ayibikanga ukuthinteka okuvela ekuzamazameni komhlaba nokuthi isiphehli Nombolo 1 no-2 esikhungweni sayo samandla enuzi zivaliwe.
translations.hypothesis: Hokuriku Electric Power Co.ले बताएको छ, कि त्यहाँ कुनै प्रभाव देखिनस, र कि संख्या 1 र 2 रिएक्टरहरू, जो Shika परमाणु ऊर्जा आयोजनामा छन्, बन्द भइन्।

translations.source: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.reference: Kubikwe ukuthi amakhaya angaba ngu-9400 endaweni awanawo amanzi futhi cishe angu-100 awanawo ugesi.
translations.hypothesis: रिपोर्ट भायर, लगभग 9400 घरहरूमा אין पानी, र लगभग 100 घरहरूमा אין बिजुली।

translations.source: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.reference: Eminye imigwaqo ibe nomonakalo, imisebenzi yesitimela iphazamisekile ezindaweni ezithintekile, futhi neSikhumulo Sezindiza saseNoto sasesifundazweni sase-Ishikawa sisavaliwe.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, केहीถนนहरू क्षतिग्रस्त भइन्, सेवा रेलमार्गमा अवरुद्ध भइन्, र विमानस्थल Noto मा, प्रान्त Ishikawa, ले अद्यावौ खुला।

translations.source: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.reference: Ibhomu eyodwa iqhume ngaphandle kwehhovisi likandunankulu.
translations.hypothesis: यस एक बम फुक, बाहेक कार्यालयको।

translations.source: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.reference: Amabhomu amanye amathathu aqhumile eduze nezakhiwo zikahulumeni esikhathini samahora amabili.
translations.hypothesis: तीनवटा थप explosions exploded नजिक सरकारी भवन, मधील दुई घण्टाको समय।

translations.source: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.reference: Eminye imibiko ithi inani labafile elisemthethweni isishiyagalombili, futhi umbiko osemthethweni uqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abangaba ngu-30 balimele; kepha izinombolo zokugcina azikaziwa.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि केही रिपोर्टले आधिकारिक हसेलेको संख्या छ, जुन आठ, र आधिकारिक रिपोर्टले पुष्टि गरेका छन् कि 30 व्यक्ति घायतन; तर, अचूक संख्या अद्यान ज्ञात छैन।

translations.source: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.reference: Kokubili i-cynuric acid kanye ne-melamine zitholakele kumasampula omchamo ovela ezilwaneni ezifuywayo ezishne ngemva kokudla ukudla kwezilwane okungcolile.
translations.hypothesis: यौ cyanuric acid र melamine फेला भए, र यसले भेट्टाए गभयमा, कतिले मरेको, र उनीहरूले दूषित पिसा खाए।

translations.source: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.reference: Izakhi ezimbili ziyaxubana ukuze zenze amakristalu angavimba ukusebenza kwezinso, kwasho abacwabingi basenyuvesi.
translations.hypothesis: दोन रसायन реагиराए एकअर्को, सिर्जना गर्दै क्रिस्टलहरू, जेले सान्दर्भिक कार्य रोक्न सक्छन, विश्वविद्यालयका अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरूले बताए.

translations.source: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
