translations.source: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.reference: Engikushoyo nje kubantu ngukuthi siphathe ngendlela esikuphatha ngayo.
translations.hypothesis: सब जे मलाई भन्छन्, हो, मलाई भन, "मलाई व्यवहार गर्नुहोस् जस्तै म मलाई व्यवहार गर्छु।"

translations.source: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.reference: UMbusi waseCalifornia u-Arnorld Schwarzenegger ugunyaze umthetho ovivinywayo ovimbela ukudayisela noma ukuqashisela izingane imidlalo yevidiyo enodleme ukuba ube umthetho.
translations.hypothesis: गवर्नर् Arnold Schwarzenegger, ले, तिने बिल जो अनुमति, ले, बिक्री वा भाडाвање हिंसक भिडियो खेलहरू, ले, अल्पवयस्कहरू, ले, हस्ताक्षर गरेको।

translations.source: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.reference: Irisidi ebonisa ukudayiswa kwemidlalo yevidiyo embusweni wase-California ephawulwe ngokuthi “18”okwenza umthengisi wayo ahlawuliswe imali engu-$1000 icala ngalinye.
translations.hypothesis: कानूनले, भिडियो खेलहरू जुन विकलस्थित बेचेको, अनिवार्य रूपमा "18" लेखनु, र यदिMinor (अल्प वयस्क) तिनीहरूलाई बेचे, तिनको बेचले सजाय हुनु, जुन $1000 प्रति उल्लंघन।

translations.source: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.reference: UMqondisi wezoKubekwa Kwamacala koMphakathi, uKier Starmer QC, unikeze isitatimende namuhla ekuseni ememezela ukubekwa kwecala kukaHuhne kanye noPryce bobabili.
translations.hypothesis: अडिक्टर सामान्य अभियोजन, कियर स्टारमर, QC, दि उज, घोषणा गरे कि अभियोजन विरुद्ध हुनेमा Huhne र Pryce।

translations.source: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.reference: UHuhne ushiye phansi futhi isikhundla sakhe kuKhabhinethi sizothathwa ngu-Ed Davey MP. UNorman Lamb MP kulindeleke ukuthi athathe umsebenzi wobuNgqongqoshe Wezamabhizinisi lo oyekwe uDavey.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne ले राजीनामा दिएको छ, र उनलाई मन्त्री मण्डलमा एड डेभी എം.पी. ले प्रतिस्थापन गर्ने। अपेक्षा गरिएको छ कि नर्मन लम्ब, എം.पी. ले, व्यवसाय मन्त्रीको पद लेगी। डेभीले उक्त पद खाली गर्ने।

translations.source: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.reference: UHhne kanye noPryce bahlelelwe ukuvela eNkantolo kaMatshi yaseWestminster ngoNhlolanja 16,
translations.hypothesis: Huhne र र Pryce निर्धारण गरिएका छन्, र उनीहरूले 16 फेब्रुअरी मा Westminster Magistrates Court मा उपस्थित हुने।

translations.source: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.reference: Ukufa kukaNicholas Alden, ona-25, kanye noZachary Cuddeback, ona-21. UCuddeback wayengumshayeli.
translations.hypothesis: व्यक्तियों मारिएको मध्ये थिए: निकोलस एल्डन, 25, र जॅकेरी क्युडेबाक, 21. क्युडेबाक थियो ज्यानले मारिएको।

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.reference: U-Edga Veguilla wathola amanxeba wasengalweni nasemhlathini kuyilapho u-Kristoffer Schneider wasala edinga ukuhlizwa kokwakha kabusha ebusweni.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguillaได้รับบาดแผล मा আৰু जब, जबकि Kristoffer Schneider परे, र आवश्यक छ хирурजिकल शल्यक्रिया भइन्

translations.source: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.reference: Isikhali sika-Uka sahluleka lapho wayekhombe indoda yesihlanu ekhanda. U-Schneider wayenobuhlungu obungapheli, ukungaboni esweni elilodwa, ingxenye yogebhezi engekho kanye nobuso obakhiwe kabusha nge-titanium.
translations.hypothesis: हथियारको यूका निकमा कति, जबकि यसले पाँचौ व्यक्तिको टाउकोमा निर्देशन भइरहेको थियो। श्नाइडरले लगातार दुखे, एक नzul, एक भागको खोप, र एक अनुहार जे, जेले सेरेमिक प्रयोग गरिएको।

translations.source: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.reference: U-Schneider wanikeza ubufakazi ngevidiyo kusuka esikhungweni se-USAF ezweni lakubo.
translations.hypothesis: Schneiderले गवाही दिएको हो, मार्फत भिडियोलिंक, देखबाट एउटा USAF आधारमा, आफ्नो देशमा।

translations.source: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.reference: Ngale kwesehlakalo sangolwesithathu, uCarpanedo uncintisane emijahweni emibili ngayinye yobuShampeni.
translations.hypothesis: प্ৰयोग, Carpanedo, ले च्याम्पियनशिपमा दुई व्यक्तिगत दौडान भाग लिन।

translations.source: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.reference: Umncintiswano wakhe wokuqala bekuyi-Slalom, lapho Engaqedanga khona umncintiswano wakhe wokuqala. Abancintisanayo abangu-36 kwabangu-116 bathole imiphumela efanayo kulowo mncintiswano.
translations.hypothesis: पहला प्रतिस्पर्धा थियो स्लोम, जसमा उनी आफ्नो पहिलो प्रयासमा "न पूर्ण" स्कोर हासिल गरे। 36 मध्ये 116 प्रतिस्पर्धाकर्ताहरूले उक्त प्रतिस्पर्धामा समान परिणाम हासिल गरे।

translations.source: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.reference: Omunye umjaho wakhe, i-Giant Slalom, waqeda engoweshumi eqenjini labesifazane elalihlezi nesikhathi esihlanganisiwe esingu-4:41.30, wayesemuva ngo-2:11.60 ku-Austrian Claudia Loesch owathatha indawo yokuqala futhi wayesemuva ngo- 1:09.02 k-uGyöngyi Dani wase-Hungary owaqeda ekwindawo yesishiyagalolunye.
translations.hypothesis: यस प्रतियोगिता, "Giant Slalom", ले देखा की उला समाप्त भवितो दशम् स्थानमा, महिला सिटिंग समूहमा, जसमा कुल समय 4:41.30, 2:11.60 मिनेट, फयर्ट स्थानमा रहेका ऑस्ट्रियाली क्लाउडिया लोesch भन्दा 1:09.02 मिनेट, र नवम् स्थानमा रहेका हंगेरियाली Gyöngyi Dani भन्दा।

translations.source: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.reference: Abashushuluza eqhweni abane eqenjini labesifazane abahlezi bahluleke ukuqeda imijaho yabo, futhi abangu-45 kwabangu-117 abashushuluza eqhweni eSlalom eNkulu bahluleke ukuthola izikhundla emjahweni.
translations.hypothesis: चार्या स्कीयरinnen समूहले, चार्याले सकेन्, र 45 मध्ये 117 कुल स्कीयरinnenले, ज्यान्ट स्लोलम रेस मा, सकेन्।

translations.source: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.reference: Amaphoyisa aseMadhya Pradesh amukele ikhompyutha ephathwayo kanye nomakhalekhukhwini.
translations.hypothesis: पोलिस विभाग अन्तर्गत, प्रहरीले चोरी भएको ल्यापटप र मोबাইল फोन फेला पो.

translations.source: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.reference: Iphini loMphenyi oMkhulu uD K Arya uthe, "Sibophe abantu abahlanu abanukubeze ngokocansi owesifazane waseSwitzerland futhi simbuyisele ucingo lwakhe kanye ne-laptop".
translations.hypothesis: अडिशनल इन्स्पेक्टर जनरल डी के अर्याले भने, "हामीले पाँच व्यक्तिहरूलाई पक्रास, जो स्विस महिलालाई यौन दुर्व्यवहार गरेका छन्, र उनीको मोबाइल र लपटप खोन्डल".

translations.source: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: Abasolwa babizwa ngoBaba Kanjar, uBhutha Kanjar, uRampro Kanjar, uGaza Kanjar kanye noVishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: व्यक्तीहरू अभियोगित हुन्, ती हुन्: बाबा खानjar, भुथा खानjar, रामप्रो खानjar, गाजा खानjar, र विष्णू खानjar.

translations.source: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.reference: Umphathi wamaphoyisa uChandra Solanki uthe abasolwa bavele enkantolo bazifihle ubuso.
translations.hypothesis: सुपरिटेंडेंट पुलिस, चन्дра शेकर सोलांकी, भन्न्यो, आरोपितहरू आए अदालतमा, र उनीहरूले अनुहारहरू छोपे।

translations.source: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.reference: Nakuba bekunabantu abathathu phakathi kwendlu ngenkathi imoto iyishayisa, akekho kubo olimele.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि तीन व्यक्तिले बसको टक्कर, तर कसै पनि घायतन भएन।

translations.source: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.reference: Noma kunjalo, umshayeli uthole izingozi ezimbi ekhanda.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, चालकमाได้รับ गम्भीर चोटहरू, विशेष गरी मा頭।

translations.source: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.reference: Umgwaqo lapho inhlekelele yenzeka khona wavalwa okwesikhashana ngesikhathi izisebenzi zezimo eziphuthumayo zikhulula umshayeli kuyi-Audi TT ebomvu.
translations.hypothesis: ถนนที่ दुर्घटना भित्र, भन्दै अस्थायी रूपमा बन्द भयो, जबकि सेवाहरूले ड्राइभरलाई सेतो Audi TT बाट छुडाउन।

translations.source: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: Uqale wangeniswa esibhedlela sase-James Paget e–Yarmouth eNkulu.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, उन आছিল सुरुначально अस्पतालित मा James Paget Hospital मा, मा Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.reference: Ngokulandelayo uye watholakala eSibhedlela i-Addenbrooke e-Cambridge.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, उเกถูกRelocate (स्थानान्तरण) कय Addenbrooke's Hospital मा, मा Cambridge.

translations.source: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.reference: uAdekoya selokhu eseNkantolo ka-Sheriff yas-Edinburgh etheswe icala lokubulala indodana yakhe.
translations.hypothesis: एडेकोया अहिलेसला, लेถูก आरोपितिरि, ले आफ्नो छोरा मार्नु।

translations.source: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.reference: Uboshiwe njengoba esalinde ukubekwa nokuthethwa kwecala, kodwa noma ibuphi ubufakazi bofakazi bokuzibonela bungonakaliswa njengoba isithombe sakhe sishicilelwe kabanzi.
translations.hypothesis: असा छिटा, र इन्डिक्टमेन्ट र परीक्षणको प्रतीक्षा, तर, यदि त्यहाँ प्रत्यक्षदर्शीले दिलेले साक्ष्य, तर, यसको कारण, तिनको तस्बिर व्यापक रूपमा प्रकाशित भयो।

translations.source: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.reference: Lena inqubo evamile kwezinye izindawo e-UK kodwa umthetho waseScotland usebenza ngokuhlukile futhi izinkantolo zibone ukushicilelwa kwezithombe njengokungonakalisa.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि यस सामान्य अभ्यास अन्यत्र, मा यूके, तर न्याय स्कटल्याण्ड फरक, र अदालतीले तस्बिरहरू प्रकाशनलाई हानिकारक मानिरहेको छ.

translations.source: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.reference: Usolwazi Pamela Ferguson wase Nyuvesi yase-Dundee uyabhala “izintantheli zizibizela amathonsi abanzi ngokushicilela izithombe nokunye kwabasolwa.”
translations.hypothesis: प्रोफेसर पेमला फर्गीसन, विश्वविद्यालय अफ डंडी, उल्लेखे: "पत्रकारहरू, यदि उनी संदिग्धहरूको तस्बिरहरू, आदि प्रकाशन,  adunay जोखिम।"

translations.source: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.reference: I-Crown Office, okuyiyo ephethe uphenyo, itshele izintatheli ukuthi ngeke iphawule okungenani kuze kube ukuthethwa kwecala.

translations.source: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.reference: Lo mbhalo, ngokwalokho okuputshukile, uzobhekisa embangweni wemingcele, iPalestine ewufunayo ngokusekelwe emingceleni ngaphambi kweMpi YaseMpumalanga yango-1967.
translations.hypothesis: यस कागजात, जस्तो कि जानकारीले देखा, ќेलले सन्दर्भित हुनेछ, iaitu विवादको सीमा, मार्द, र यसले प्यालेस्टिनीहरूले 1967 मा मध्यपूर्वेली युद्ध भन्दा पहिलेको सीमामा आधारित।

translations.source: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.reference: Ezinye izihloko ezikhona zihlanganisa ikusasa leJerusalema eligcwele kuzo zombili izizwe kanye nenkinga Yesigodi saseJordani.
translations.hypothesis: अन्य विषयवस्तुहरू, जसमा रिपोर्टले समावेश, हुन् भविष्य अवस्थाको जेरुसलेम, जो पवित्र छ दुवै राष्ट्रहरू, र जोर्डन भेलीको मुद्दा।

translations.source: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.reference: I-Israyeli ifuna ukuba amasosha aqhubeke ekhona esigodini iminyaka eyishumi uma nje isivumelwano sisayinilwe nakuba i-PA ivuma ukuba amasosha abe khona iminyaka eyisihlanu kuphela.
translations.hypothesis: इजरायलमाग्, एकपत्ति हस्ताक्षर भएपछि, सेनाले दश वर्षसम्म долиनालामा लगातार उपस्थिति आवश्यक छ, जबकि पीए सहमतिको अनुसार, सेनाले त्यहाँ मात्र पाँच वर्षसम्म उपस्थिति रहने।

translations.source: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
translations.reference: Abadubuli esivivinyweni esingeziwe sokulawula izinambuzane kwakufanele bagadwe eduze abaqaphi, njengoba uhlolo lwaluqashwe futhi ukusebenza kwalo kwahlolwa.
translations.hypothesis: व्यक्तियों मार्फत प्रयोग, सुरक्षाकर्मीले सावधानीपूर्वक निगरानी, किनभने प्रयोग निगरानी गरिएको थियो र यसको प्रभाव मूल्याङ्कन गरिएको थियो।

translations.source: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.reference: Ngokubambisana neNPWS kanye neSporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, amavolontiya afanelekayo abuthwa, ngaphansi kohlelo lokuzingela lweSporting Shooters Association.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि NPWS र्य र Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc. को साझेदारी, योग्य स्वयंसेवक भर्ത്തി, अन्तर्गत Sporting Shooters Association को शिकार कार्यक्रम।

translations.source: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.reference: NgokukaMick O’Flynn, Umqondisi Obambele wePaki Lokonga Nefa kanye neNPWS, abadubuli abane abakhethwe ohlelweni lokudubula bathola ukuqeqeshwa okujulile kokuphepha nokuqeqesha.
translations.hypothesis: भेर अनुसार, मिर्क ओ'फ्लिन्, जो अस्थायी निर्देशक, पार्क संरक्षण र विरासत, मा NPWS, चार व्यक्तिहरू, जो छनौच भए, ले विस्तृत सुरक्षा र तालिम प्राप्त गरेका छन्।

translations.source: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.reference: UMartelly ufungiise i-Provisional Electora Council (CEP) entsha enamalunga ayisishiyagalolunye izolo.
translations.hypothesis: Martellyले, जे दिन, नौ सदस्यीय नयाँ अस्थायीlectoral Council (CEP) ले शपथ लान।

translations.source: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.reference: I-CEP yesihlanu eminyakeni emine ka-Martelly.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यो हो पाँचौ पटक CEP (Conseil Electoral Provisional) मार्तেলিले चार वर्ष मा।

translations.source: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.reference: Ngenyanga edlule ikhomishani yobumongameli ituse ukuyeka isikhundla kwe-CEP kwangaphambili njengengxenye yezinyathelo zokwenza izwe ukuba livote.
translations.hypothesis: महीनेयय, आयोग presidensियलले सिफारिस गरे कि CEP पछि हट्नु, भित्रै, जतिन देशलाई नयाँ चुनावतिर ले लैजान।

translations.source: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.

translations.hypothesis: министрство अर्थशास्त्र, व्यापार र उद्योग (METI) जापानले बताए की, उनी छना 27 घटनाहरू जुन सँगान्स्यो।

translations.source: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.reference: Ngeviki elidlule, iMETI imemezele ukuthi i-Apple iyazise ngezigamego zokushisa ngokweqile ezengeziwe ezingu-34, lezo inkampani ezibize ngokuthi "into engeyona enkulu."
translations.hypothesis: अहि, METIले घोषणा गरेको छ कि Appleले 34 थप घटनाहरूमा, जुन कम्पनीले "गंभीर" नभएको बताए, जानकारी दिले।

translations.source: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.reference: Umnyango uphendule ngokubiza ukuhlehlisa kwe-Apple lo mbiko "kuyadabukisa ngempela."
translations.hypothesis: ministerioले प्रतिक्रिया दिएको हो, भन्नयसः "विलम्ब" रिपोर्टको, "हाउ वास्तवमे खेदजनक".

translations.source: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.reference: I-Xinhua yabika ukuthi abaphenyi bakahulumeni bathola ama-“black box” amabilii okurekhoda izindiza ngoLwesithathu.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua報道ले, अधिकारीहरूले बुधबार दुई "ब्ल्याक बாக்" रेकर्डर्स, जुन रेकर्ड गरिरहेको उडान, भेट्टाउन सफल भइन्।

translations.source: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.reference: Umdlali we-wrestling naye washo amazwi okuhlonipha uLuna.
translations.hypothesis: यस अन्य जो Wrestlers ले पनि लुनालाई श्रद्धांजली अर्पित गरे।

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.reference: UTommy Dreamer wathi “uLuna bekuyiNdlovukazi Yokwedlulele yokuqala. Umphathi wami wokuqala. ULuna washona ngobusuku bezinyanga ezimbili. Kuyingqayizivele njengaye. Owesifazane Onamandla.”
translations.hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer भन्नु, "Luna थियो पहिलो रानी। मेरा पहिलो व्यवस्थापक। Luna मरेको हो, साँझमा, जब दुई चन्द्रमा देखेको थियो। एउटा अनूठा व्यक्ति, जस्तै उनी। एक शक्तिशाली महिला।"

translations.source: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.reference: U-Dustin “Thulilwegolide” Runnels waphawula ngokuthi “uLuna wayehlanya njengami...mhlawumbe ukungidlula...ngiyamthanda futhi ngizomkhumbula...ngiyethemba usendaweni engcono.”
translations.hypothesis: Dustin "Goldust" Runnelsले टिप्पणी गरे: "Luna थियो जत्तिकै असाधारण... शायद थप... मलाई मन, र म उसको याद गर्ने... म आशा म, उ आउ छ।"

translations.source: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.reference: Phakathi kwabantu abangu-1,400 abavote ngaphambi kokhetho lukahulumeni 2010, labo ababengavumelani nokuthi i-Australia ibe iriphabhuliki banda ngamaphesenti angu-8 kusukela ngo-2008.
translations.hypothesis: मध्ये 1,400 व्यक्तिहरूका ज्यासमाय भन्दा अगाडि, ती जो विपक्षमा छन् कि 2010 संघीय चुनावमा, 8 प्रतिशतले वृद्धि भइको छ, चränयसके 2008।

translations.source: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.reference: UNdunankulu Wokunakekela uJulia Gillard wathi phakathi nomkhankaso wokhetho lwango-2010 wayekholelwa ukuthi i-Astralia kumelwe ibe izwe elibuswa ngentando yeningi ngemva kokubusa kweNdlovukazi uElizabeth II.
translations.hypothesis: प्रधानमन्त्री जेलीला गिल्ार्ड, во время अभियान चुनाव 2010, दावीले कि विश्वास佢, एउटा राष्ट्र, अर्थात्, एउटा गणतन्त्र, पर्ने, पछि रानी एलिजाबेथ द्वितीयको शासन समाप्त हुनुपर्छ।

translations.source: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.reference: Amaphesenti angu-34 walabo abavotayo unalombono, ufuna Indlovukazi u-Elizabeth II ukuba abe umbusi wokugcina wase-Australia.
translations.hypothesis: 34 प्रतिशत मध्ये, ती जो सहभागी भए, साझा यो मत, र चाहन्छ कि रानी एलिजाबेथ II, हो एउटाअस्ट्रेलियाकोअंतिम राजा।

translations.source: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.reference: Emananini adlulele wokuvota, amaphesentu angu-29 walabo ababuzwe imibuzo bakholelwa ukuthi i-Australia kumelwe ibe yiriphabhuliki ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka, kuyilapho amaphesenti angu-31 akholelwa ukuthi i-Australia akumelwe ibe yiriphabhuliki.
translations.hypothesis: यस सर्वेक्षण, 29 प्रतिशत कडा, विश्वास छ छ Australia यथाशीघ्र एक गणराज्य बन्नुपर्छ, जबकि 31 प्रतिशत विश्वास छ छ Australia कहिल्यै एक गणराज्य नहुनुपर्छ।

translations.source: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.reference: Lowo owathola indondo yegolide kuma-Olimpiki kwakumelwe ahlanganyele emcintiswaneni wokubhukude we-100m kanye ne-200m wokubhukuda nganoma iyiphi indlela futhi kunemidlalo yokunikezelana eMidlalweni yama-Commonwealth, kodwa ngenxa yokukhalaza kwakhe kuyasolwa ukuthi unamandla ngokomzimba.
translations.hypothesis: विजेता, जो Olympic, अपेक्षा थियोिमध्ये 100 मिटर र 200 मिटर फ्रीस्टाइल, तथा तीन रिलेमा प्रतिस्पर्धा गर्ने, तर, कारण, तिनीको फिटनेस अब छ।

translations.source: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.reference: Akakwazanga ukuthatha imithi edingekayo yokulwisana nobuhlungu bakhe njengoba ingavunyelwe eMidlalweni.
translations.hypothesis: असा सक्षम छ, ले औषधहरू लिन, जसले आवश्यक छ, ताकि उनले आफ्नो दुखेलास हटाउन सकू, किनकि यी औषधहरू निषिद्ध हुन्।

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.reference: U-Curtis Cooper, usozibalo nophinde abe ngusolwazi wesayensi yamakhompuyutha eNyuvesi yaseCentral Missouri, uthole inombolo enkulu kunazo zonke kuze kube manje ongakwazi ukuyidivayida ngayo ngokwayo ngoMasingina 25.
translations.hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, एक गणितज्ञ र कम्प्युटर विज्ञान प्राध्यापक कय युनिव्हर्सिटी अफ सेन्ट्रल मिसौरी, ले 25 जनवरीన, अहिलेससम्म ज्ञात भएको लरै अभाज्य संख्या भेट्टाउन।

translations.source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.reference: Abantu abaningana baqinisekise okutholakele ngokusebenzisa imishini kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zamakhompyutha ngasekuqaleni kukaNhlolanja futhi kumenyezelwe ngoLwesibili.
translations.hypothesis: खुलि व्यक्तिको प्रयोग गरे, विभिन्न हार्डवेयर र सफ्टवेयर, सुरुको फरबरी, र यो जानकारी सार्वजनिक गरिएको थियो।

translations.source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.reference: Amatshe awayo esuka emkhathini kungenzeka ukuthi ayengumthombo wamanzi athunyelwe emhlabeni kanye nezinsalela zezinto eziphilayo ezingakha amaphrotheni futhi zisekele ukuphila.
translations.hypothesis: Возможно, धूमकेतुहरूले सप्लाय पानी कडे पृथ्वी, साथै संगे जैविक सामग्री, जेले प्रोटिन बनाउन र जीवनलाई समर्थन गर्न, हुर्दा भूमिका खेले.

translations.source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.reference: Ososayensi banethemba lokuqonda indlela amapulanethi akheka ngayo, ikakhulukazi indlela uMhlaba owakheke ngayo, njengoba amatshe asuka emkhathini eshayisene noMhlaba kudala.
translations.hypothesis: वैज्ञानिकहरूले आशा छन्, כדי आफूले बुझोन् कसरी ग्रहहरू तयार हुन्, विशेष रूपमा कसरी पृथ्वी तयार भयो, किनकि धूमकेतुहरूले धेरै समययूसँग ठोक्न पृथ्वी।

translations.source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.reference: UCuomo, oneminyaka engu-53, waqala ukubusa ekuqaleni kulo nyaka futhi wasayina umthetho ovivinywayo ngenyanga edlule ogunyaza ukushada kwabantu bobulili obufanayo.
translations.hypothesis: Cuomo, उ 53, सुरुवातीको यस वर्षले आफ्नो कार्यभार, र माथिको, र हस्ताक्षर गरेको विधान, जे होय, ले समलिंगी विवाहलाई कायदेशीर बनाउन।

translations.source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.reference: Ubhekisele emahlebezini ngokuthi "ingevu yepolotiki kanye nobuthutha".
translations.hypothesis: هغهले यसलाई "राजनीतिक कुटाई र मूर्खता" भनिन्।

translations.source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.reference: Kufuniselwa ukuthi uzokhankasela ukuba umongameli ngo-2016.
translations.hypothesis: अथाह, कति मान्छे विश्वास छ कि ऊ 2016 मा राष्ट्रपति पदको चुनाव igeri.

translations.source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.reference: I-NextGen indlela i-FAA ethi izovumela indiza ukuba indize imizila emifishane futhi yonge izigidi zamagalani wamafutha unyaka ngamunye futhi inciphise i-carbon ekhishwa emkhathini.
translations.hypothesis: NextGen ले एक प्रणाली हो जुन FAA भन्छ, यसले विमानहरू छोटो मार्गहरू उडान गर्न र हरेक वर्ष मिलियन गालनहरू नदवा बचत गर्न, साथै कार्बन उत्सर्जन घटाउन मद्दत गर्ने।

translations.source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.reference: Isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusekelwe esiphuphuthekini kunobuchwepheshe bakudala obusekelwe kuyi-radar yaphansi ukuvumela abalawuli bezinto ezihamba emoyeni ukuthola indawo indiza ekuyo ngokunemba okukhulu nokunika abashayeli bezindiza ukwaziswa okunembe kakhudlwana.
translations.hypothesis: यसले उपग्रह-आधारित प्रविधि प्रयोग, बरु पुरानो, माटो-आधारित रडार प्रविधि, ताकि हवाइज्ड यातायात नियन्त्रकहरूले उड्डयन साधनहरूलाई थप सटीमा पहिचान गर्न, र पाइलन्टहरूलाई थप सही जानकारी प्रदान गर्न मद्दत गर्छ।

translations.source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.reference: Azikho izinto zokuthutha ezibekwayo futhi izitimela ezihamba phezulu ngeke zime eWembli, futhi ukupaka izimoto kanye nezindawo zokupaka nokugibela azitholakali enkundleni.
translations.hypothesis: नयाँ साधनहरू छैनन्, र रेलहरूले स्टेसियनमा स्टिल, र पार्किंग र "पार्क-अन्ड-राइड" सुविधाहरूले उपलब्ध छैनन्।

translations.source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.reference: Ukwesaba kokungabi khona kwezinto zokuthutha kwenze ukuthi kube nokwenzeka ukuthi umdlalo uphoqelelwe ukudlalwa ngasese ngaphandle kwabathandi beqembu.
translations.hypothesis: चिंताले कि אין साधन, ले यो सम्भावना उत्पन्न भयो कि खेलले बाध्य हुन सक्छ, बिना समर्थक।

translations.source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.reference: Ucwaningo olushicilelwe ngoLwesine kumagazini weSayensi lubike ngokwakhiwa kwezinhlobo ezintsha zezinyoni eZiqhingini zase-Ecuadore eGalápagos.
translations.hypothesis: एक अध्ययन, जुन च्यारदा प्रकाशित भयो, मा Science जर्नलमा, लेखेको छ कि नयाँ प्रजाति पक्षी देखिएको हो, यसले Ecuadorean Galápagos टापुहरूमा।

translations.source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.reference: Abacwaningi abavela eNyuvesi yasePrinceton eMelika kanye naseNyuvesi yase-Uppsala eSweden babike ukuthi izidalwa ezintsha ziziphendukele ngezizukulwane ezimbili kuphela, nakuba lenqubo bekukholelwa ukuthi ithatha isikhathi eside, ngenxa yokuzalela phakathi kwezintaka zika-Darwin ezitholakala kuleyo ndawo kuphela, ama-Geospiza fortes, kanye nezintaka ze-cactus ezithuthele lapho, ama-Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: अनुसन्धानकर्ताहरू, एक जना विश्वविद्यालय मा प्रिसनटन (संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका) र अर्को विश्वविद्यालय मा अप्सला (स्वीडन), रिपोर्ट गरिन् कि नयाँ प्रजाति विकसित भयो मात्र दुई पुस्ता, तथापि, यो प्रक्रिया विश्वास गरिएको थियो, ले धेरै समय लिन्छ, किनकि यो स्थानीय प्रजा, Geospiza fortes, र आप्रवासी प्रजा, Geospiza conirostris, बीचमा प्रजननको परिणाम हो।

translations.source: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.reference: Igolide lingenziwa libe noma isiphi isibumbeko. Lingagingqwa libe yizibumbeko ezincane..
translations.hypothesis: सुवर्णสามารถ प्रशोधन र विभिन्न आकार।  สามารถ रोल र सानसानै आकार।

translations.source: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
translations.reference: Ingadonswa ibe ucingo oluncinyanyane, olungasontwa noma lulukwe. Lungabethelwa noma lugoqwe lube amashidi.
translations.hypothesis: Puede थिन तारमा, која सक्छ घुमाउन र बुना.  Puede पनि थप्न वा रोल गर्न।

translations.source: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.reference: Ingenziwa ibe ncane kalula, bese inamathiselwa kwenye insimbi. Ingenziwa ibe ncane kangangokuthi kwesinye isikhathi yayisetshenziselwa ukuhlobisa izithombe ezidwetshwe ngesandla ezincwadini ezibizwa ngokuthi "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.hypothesis: आसमा, यसले निकै पातलो हुन सक्छ, र यसलाई अन्य धातुमा फिक्स गर्न सकिन्छ। यसले धेरै पातलो हुन सक्छ, र यसलाई कहिलेकाहीँ "प्रकाशित हस्तलिखित" पुस्तकहरूमा चित्रित चित्रहरू सुशोभन गर्न प्रयोग गरिएको थियो।

translations.source: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.reference: Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-pH yekhemikhali. Ungenza inkomba ngokusebenzisa ujusi weklabishi ebomvu.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि यसलाई भन भ्याले "pH" रसायन। तपाईंสามารถ बनाउन एक संकेतक प्रयोग गरेर सेतो गोभीको रस।

translations.source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.reference: Ijusi yeklabishi ishintsha umbala kuye ngokuthi ikhemikhali ino-asidi noma i-alikhali engakanani.
translations.hypothesis: ज്യൂक लेपन परिवर्तन रंग, जसमा निर्भर गर्छ कति अम्लीय वा क्षारीय (अल्कलाइन) रसायन छ.

translations.source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.reference: Izinga le-pH likhonjwa inani lama-ion weHydrogen (i-H ku-pH) kuyikhemikhali elihlolwayo.
translations.hypothesis: स्तर pH సూचिएको होय ले मात्रा हाइड्रोजन (H मा pH) आयनहरू मा परीक्षण रसायन।

translations.source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.reference: Ama-ion e-hydrogen amaphrothoni lawo ekususwe ama-elektroni wawo kuwo (njengoba ama-athomu weHydrogen enziwa iphrothoni elilodwa kanye ne-elektroni elilodwa).
translations.hypothesis: आयनहर हुबहू प्रोटोन हुन्, लेकन तिनीकाले इलेक्ट्रन हटाइएको (हान्स्येन अणूमध्ये एक प्रोटोन र एक इलेक्ट्रन समावेश हुन्छ)।

translations.source: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.

translations.source: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.reference: Umswakamo osezandleni zakho uzohlangana nongqimba olungaphandle, okuzoba nomuzwa oxakayo futhi kwenze uhlobo lwegobongo.
translations.hypothesis: साद्रता (влажность) మీ हातमा प्रतिक्रियाशील हुनेछ, र यसले अजीब अनुभूति दिन्छ, र एक प्रकारको खोल (कपाल) तयार गर्नेछ.

translations.source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.reference: Amadolobha waseHarappa kanye naseMohenjo-daro ayenedlu yangasese eshaywayo cishe kuzo zonke izindlu, ehlanganiswe nendlela eyinkimbinkimbi yokuthutha indle.
translations.hypothesis: शहरहरू Harappa र Mohenjo-daroले लगभग प्रत्येक घरमा, र एक परिष्कृत सीवेज प्रणालीमा, फ्लश टয়लेट।

translations.source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.reference: Insalela yamapayipi athutha indle itholakele ezindlini zamadolobha wase-Minoan waseKhrithi nase-Santorini eGreece.
translations.hypothesis: अवशेष प्रणाली अपशिष्ट भेष इन घरहरूमा भेट्टाउन सकिन्छ, जुन ग्रीस मा मिनोअन शहरहरू क्रेट र सान्टोरिनी मा स्थित छन्।

translations.source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.reference: Zazikhona izindlu zangasese eGibhithe, e, kanye naseShayina yamandulo. Empucukweni yaseRoma, izindlu zangasese kwesinye isikhathi kwakuyingxenye yezindlu zokugezela zomphakathi lapho abasilisa nabesifazana babehlangana ndawonye.
translations.hypothesis: थय पनि थिए शौचालय, जस्तै प्राचीन मिस्र, पर्शिया र चीन। मा रोमन सभ्यता, शौचालय सधैँ थिए অংশ, जताततै मानिस र महिलाहरू एकत्रित थिए।

translations.source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.reference: Uma ushayela ucingo umuntu othile okude ngamamayela ayinkulungwane, usebenzisa isiphuphutheki.
translations.hypothesis: जब तपैमा सम्पर्क गराउन तपैमा कसै जो हजारौ किलोमिटर टाला, तपैले उपग्रह प्रयोग गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ।

translations.source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.reference: Isiphuphutheki esisemkhathini sithola ucingo bese siluthumela emuva ezansi, cishe ngaleso sikhathi.
translations.hypothesis: उपग्रह तान्, प्राप्त्या सन्देश, र त्यसपछि, लगभग तत्काल, फर्कवा।

translations.source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.reference: Isethilayithi ithunyelwe emkhathini kusentshenziswa irokhethi. Ososayensi basebenzise izibona kude ezisemkhathini ngoba umkhathi uphazamisa okunye kokukhanya kwethu kanye nokubona.
translations.hypothesis: उपग्रह पठाइतिएको थियो, प्रयोग गरिन्छ। वैज्ञानिकहरू प्रयोग गर्छन्, उपग्रहमा, किनकि पृथ्वीको वातावरण, केही देख्ने र प्रकाशमा सान्दर्भिक।

translations.source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.reference: Kudingeka irokhethi enkulu engaphezu kwamafidiangu-100 ukuphakama ukubeka isiphuphutheki noma ithelisikobho emkhathini.
translations.hypothesis: लाग्ने एक विशाल उप-कक्षीय यान, उचाइ 100 అడుగు, आवश्यक छ ताकि उपग्रह वा दूरबीन अन्तरिक्षमा स्थापित हुन सकू।

translations.source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.reference: Isondo seliguqule umhlaba ngezindlela ezimangalisayo. Into enkulu ukuthi isondo elisenzele yona ukusinika indlela yokuthutha elula neshesha kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: पहिरोले संसारलाई असाधारण तरिकामा परिवर्तन गरेको छ। एउटा मुख्य कुरा जुन पहिरोले हामीलाई दिनको छ, हो, यसले हामीलाई धेरै सजिलो र छिटो आवागमन प्रदान गरेको छ।

translations.source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.reference: Isilethele isitimela, imoto, kanye nezinye izisetshenziswa zokuthutha.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यसले ल्याले रेल, ज्या, र धेरै अन्य साधनहरू।

translations.source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.reference: Ngaphansi kwazo kukhona amakati amancanyana ngobukhulu adla inyama ebanjelwa ukudliwakusuka kunogwaja kuya ezinyamazaneni.
translations.hypothesis: तलर्गत,erdapat बिल्लियाँ जुन मध्यम आकारका छन्, र तिनीहरू मध्यम आकारका शिकारहरू खान, जस्तै खरगोश, व्याल र हिरण।

translations.source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.reference: Ekugcineni, kunamakati amaningi amancane (kuhlanganise namakati afuywayo azizulelayo) adla izilwanyane ezizingelwayo eziningi kakhulu njengezinambuzane, izilwane eziququdayo, izibankwa, kanye nezinyoni.
translations.hypothesis: अन्ततः, त्यहाँ धेरै सानो बिल्ली (मध्ये, बिशेषमा, पालका बिल्ली) जे खाल्डो धेरै धेरै सानो प्राणी जस्तै कीट, सस्तन प्राणी, छिप्या, र पक्षी।

translations.source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.reference: Imfihlo yempumelelo yabo umcabango wesikhundla, umsebenzi okhethekile ikati ngalinye elinawo olenza lingancintisani namanye.
translations.hypothesis: मुख्य कारण उलब्धता, एउटा विशेष भूमिका जे हरेक बिल्लीले हासिल गरेको, र यसले उनीहरूलाई अरूसँग प्रतिस्पर्धा नहुन मद्दत गर्छ।

translations.source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.reference: Amabhubesi angamakati anobudlelwane kakhulu, aphila ngamaqembu amakhulu abizwa ngokuthi umhlambi.
translations.hypothesis: सिपा हुन् प्रतिनिधि जना, रलৈ, रलৈ समूहमा, जसलाई "प्राइड" भनिन्छ।

translations.source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.reference: Imihlambi yakhiwa iduna elilodwa noma amathathu ahlobene, ngokufanayo nezinsikazi ezintathu kanye namawundlu.
translations.hypothesis: गuruhन्ो bestaan बाट एक देखि तीन वयस्क नर, साथै तीस वा धेरै मादी र पुष्टाहार।

translations.source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.reference: Abesifazane ngokuvamile bahlobene, okuwumndeni omkhulu wodadewabo noma amadodakazi.
translations.hypothesis: सामान्यतया, मादीहरू छन् निकट सम्बन्धी, र हुन् एक लामो परिवार,समाविष्टमा बहिनीहरू र छोरीहरू।

translations.source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.reference: Ivuyo lamabhubesi liziphatha njengomhlambi wamanketshane, izilwane ezifana namabhubesi ngokumangalisayo (kodwa hhayi amanye amakati amakhulu) ngokuziphatha, kanye futhi nokuba yingozi ezilwaneni ezizizingelayo.
translations.hypothesis: गuruhों समूह कार्य गर्दी जस्तै, जस्तै च्याब्या वा कुकुर, र प्राणी मार्मिक, र विशेष रूपमा खतरनाक।

translations.source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.reference: Umgadli ophelele, ihlosi lingakhuphuka (yize lingakwazi kahle), libhukude, ligxume amabanga amade futhi lidonse ngamandla womuntu onamandla aphindwe kasihlanu.
translations.hypothesis: एक योग्य एथलीट, बाघสามารถ चढ़े (यद्यपि रमाइश), नहला, छलांग लगाउने लामो दूरी, र पाँच गुणा शक्ति भन्दा धेरै बल प्रयोग गर्न सक्छ।

translations.source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.reference: Ithayiga lisesigabeni esifanayo (Genus Panthera) njengamabhubesi, izingwe, kanye nama-jaguar. Lawa makati amane yiwo kuphela akwazi ukubhonga.
translations.hypothesis: टाइगर समावेशेय क यसै समूह (प्रजाति Panthera) जस्तै च्या, च्या, र जगुआर। यी चार प्रकारका फelines हुन् जुन मात्र रोइ सक्छन्।

translations.source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.reference: Ukubhonga kwehlosi akufani ncamashi nokubhonga kwengonyama, kodwa kucishe kufane nomusho wamagama entukuthelo, amenyezwayo.
translations.hypothesis: वासाको आवाज אינו وەकाले आवाजको, तर धेरै जत्था, कडा आवाज।

translations.source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.reference: Ama-ocelots athanda ukudla izilwane ezincane. Azobamba izimfene, izinyoka, izilwane eziququdayo kanye nezinyoni uma angakwazi. Cishe zonke izilwane ezizingelwa yilawa makati zincane kakhulu kunawo.
translations.hypothesis: ओसेलहरू रुच्छेली खाने. यदि उनी सक्छ, उनीले मांज, सर्पहरु, ससाना प्राणी र पक्षी समात्न गट्स। लगभग सबै जनावरहरू जुन ओसेल शिकार गर्छन्, हुन् धेरै सानिका भन्दा।

translations.source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.reference: Ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi ama-ocelots alandelela futhi athola izilwane zokuzidla (izilwane ezizingelwayo) ngokunuka, efufuza lapho bezikhona phansi.
translations.hypothesis: वैज्ञानिकहरू विश्वास गर्छन् कि ओसेलहरू पछ्याउँ र भेट्टाउन जनावरहरू (शिकार) मार्फत, प्रयोग गरेर, र मार् मार्फत, जसमा तिनीहरूले माटोमा गए।

translations.source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.reference: Ayakwazi ukubona kahle kakhulu ebumnyameni ngekhono lokubona ebusuku, abuye ahambe ngesinyenyela esikhulu, futhi. Ama-ocelot azingela izisulu zawo ngokuzifanisa nendawo akuyo bese agxumela izisulu zawo.

translations.source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.reference: Lapho iqembu elincane lezinto eziphilayo (inani elincane) lihlukana eqenjini elikhulu elisuka kulo (cishe lapho liya ngaphesheya kokhahlamba lwentaba noma umfula, noma uma liya esiqhingini esisha kangangokuba lingakwazi ukubuyela emuva kalula) ngokuvamile lizozithola endaweni ehlukile kunaleyo ebezikuyo ngaphambili.
translations.hypothesis: जब एक सान समूह (एक सान जनसंख्या) अलग भन्दा मुख्य जनसंख्या (जुनै तिम, जस्तै यदि तिमले डाँडा वा नदी पार गनु, वा यदि तिमले नयाँ टापुमा जानु ताकि तिमले सजिलै फर्किनु नद सकु) बाट अलग हुन्छ, तिमले अक्सर आफ्नो पूर्व वातावरण भन्दा भिन्न वातावरणमा भेट्टाउनु पर्छ.

translations.source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.reference: Le ndawo entsha inezinsizakusebenza ezihlukile nabancintisani abahlukene, ngakho-ke umphakathi omusha uzodinga izici ezihlukile noma ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ukuze ube ngabancintisani abaqinile kunalokho ababekudinga ngaphambilini.
translations.hypothesis: यस वातावरणले विभिन्न स्रोतहरू र विभिन्न प्रतिस्पर्धीहरू, र यो नयाँ जनसंख्याले बलशाली प्रतिस्पर्धी बन्न, विभिन्न विशेषताहरू वा अनुकूलनहरू आवश्यक पर्ने, जस्तै पहिले आवश्यक थियो।

translations.source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.reference: Izidalwa ezazikhona zasekuqaleni azikashintshi, zisadinga indlela yokuphila efana neyangaphambili.
translations.hypothesis: जनसंख्याले बिल्कुल फेरबदल भएन, उनीले अघोलगा जस्तै, समान अनुकूलन आवश्यकता।

translations.source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.

translations.source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.

translations.hypothesis: Mosasaurus थियो आफ्नो समयको शक्तिशाली शिकारी, र त्यसैले, यसले, सिवाय अन्य मोसासाउरस, केही पनि डराएन।

translations.source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.reference: Imihlathi yayo emide eyayihlome ngamazinyo acijise okwensingo angaphezu kuka-70, kanye namanye engeziwe phezu komlomo wayo, okusho ukuthi kwakungekho lutho esondela eduze kwayo eyayingaphunyuka.
translations.hypothesis: दाँत्य यसले, ले धेरै 70 तीक्ष्ण दाँत, साथै थप दाँत माथिको, र यसको अर्थ हो, कि केही पनि यसको मार्ग पार गरेको अवस्थामा, कहिलै पनि पन्जाल।

translations.source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.

translations.source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.reference: AbaseBhabhiloni bakhela izithixo zabo ngazinye ithempeli eliyinhloko elalibhekwa njengekhaya lesithixo.

translations.source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.reference: Abantu abaletha imihlatshelo konkulunkulu nakubaphristi bazozama ukunika onkulunkulu izidingo zabo ngemigidi nemikhosi.
translations.hypothesis: व्यक्तीहरूले बलिदानहरूले आउनुका साथ, पुजारीहरूले आगोमार्फत र उत्सवहरू मार्फत, आगोको आवश्यकताहरू धान्न कोशेचा।

translations.source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.reference: Ithempeli ngalinye lalinegceke elivulekile lethempeli kanye nendawo engcwele ephakathi lapho kwakungena khona umphristi kuphela.
translations.hypothesis: प्रत्येक मन्दिरले थियो एक खुला प्रांगण, र त्यसपछि एक आन्तरिक स्थान, जे केवल पुजारीहरूले प्रवेश गर्न पाउँथे।

translations.source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.reference: Ngezinye izikhathi imibhoshongo ekhethekile engunxa-ntathu, ebizwa ngokuthi ama-ziggurat, yayakhiwe ukuze ibe ingxenye yamathempeli.
translations.hypothesis: अदावत, विशेष प्यारामिड-आकारका टावरहरू, जसले "जिगुरैट्स" भनिन्छ, बनेका थिए र उनीहरूले मन्दिरहरूका हिस्सा बने.

translations.source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.

translations.source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.

translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, во время Войны за Независимость, ते सत्रнадцать राज्यले सर्वप्रथम तयार गरेका थिए—एक कमजोर केन्द्रीय सरकार—जसमा कांग्रेस मात्र समावेश थियो—यसको आधार "Articles of Confederation" थियो।

translations.source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.

translations.hypothesis: खेलहरू जुन लोकप्रिय हुन्मध्ये समावेश छन्: फुटबल, बास्केटबल, व्यालेबॉल, जल-पोलो, फेंसिंग, रग्बी, साइकल, आइस हकी, रोलर हकी, र एफ1 मोटर रेसिंग।

translations.source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.reference: Imidlalo yasebusika ithandwa kakhulu ezindaweni eziseNyakatho, lapho amaNtaliyane encintisana khona emidlalweni yamazwe onke kanye nasemidlalweni yama-Olimpiki.
translations.hypothesis: खेल शीतकालीन हुन्, र सबैभन्दा लोकप्रिय तमा क्षेत्रहरू, र इटालियनहरूले अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय खेल र ओलम्पिक कार्यक्रमहरूमा प्रतिस्पर्धा।

translations.source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.reference: IJapani ineziqhingi ezicishe zibe ngu-7000 (esikhulu kunazo zonke iHonshu), okwenza iJapani isiqhingi sesi-7 esikhulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni!
translations.hypothesis: जापानले लगभग 7,000 टापुहरू (मध्ये सबैभन्दा ठूलो हो Honshu), र यसले जापानलाई संसारको 7-औं ठूलो टापु बनाउँछ!

translations.source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.reference: Ngenxa yenqwaba/iqembu leziqhingi iJapani enazo, iJapani ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi, ngenxa yendawo ekuyo, njenge-"archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: भल्यार, जापानले छ, जापान धेरैपटक, कतिभौतिक दृष्टिकोत्, भन्ने गरिन्छ, "एक समूह टापुहरू"।

translations.source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.reference: Ukusungulwa kweTaiwan kuqala kudala ngekhulu lama-15 leminyaka lapho amatilosi aseYurophu edlula ebhala igama lesiqhingi ngokuthi i-Ilha formosa, noma isiqhingi esihle.
translations.hypothesis: तावान, पहिलो पटक, लगभग 15औं शताब्दी, जहाँ युरोपेय नाविकहरूले यस टापुलाई "Ilha Formosa" (सुन्दर टापु) नाम दिन्, जबकि उनीहरूले यसको नाम रेकर्ड गरेका थिए।

translations.source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.reference: Ngo-1624, i-Dutch East India Company yamisa isikhungo eningizimu ntshonalanga Taiwan, iqalisa ukushintshwa kokukhiqizwa kokusanhlamvu komdabu futhi iqasha izisebenzi zaseShayina ukuba zisebenze emasimini welayisi noshukela.
translations.hypothesis: यस 1624, कम्पनी "Dutch East India" स्थापना आधारबिन्दु ताइवानको दक्षिणपश्चिम, र यसले स्थानीय किसान उत्पादन पद्धतीहरू परिवर्तन, तथा चीनी मजदुरहरूलाई आफ्नो धान र शर्करा फार्महरूमा काम गर्न प्रयोग।

translations.source: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.reference: Ngo-1683, amabutho obukhosi buka-Qing (1644-1912) athatha izindawo ezingasogwini ezisentshonalanga nasenyakatho ne-Taiwan futhi amisa i-Taiwan njengesifundazwe sombuso ka-Qing ngo-1885.
translations.hypothesis: यस 1683, सङ्घर्षकारी शासन (1644-1912) ले ताइवानको पश्चिमी र उत्तरी तट क्षेत्रहरूलाई नियन्त्रण, र 1885 मा ताइवानलाई सङ्घर्षकारी साम्राज्यको एक भाग घोषित।

translations.source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.reference: Ngo-1895, ngemva kokuhlulwa eMpini Yokuqala yamaJapani yase—ino (1894-1895), uhulumeni wase-Qing usayina Isivumelwano se-Simonoseki, ngaso edlulisela iTaiwan eJapani, ebusa isiqhingi kuze kube ngu-1945.
translations.hypothesis: यस 1895, पछि हार मा पहिलो सिना-जापानी युद्ध (1894-1895), सरकारले शिमोनोसेकीको समझौना, मार्फत, तिनीले ताइवानको सार्वभौमत्वलाई जपानलाई प्रत्याभू, जेले यो टापुलाई 1945 सम्म नियन्त्रण।

translations.source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.reference: IMachu Picchu yenziwa izakhiwo ezintathu eziyinhloko, okungukuthi i-Intihuatana, i-Temple of the Sun, kanye ne-Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: Machu Picchu समावेशे तीन मुख्य संरचना, अर्थात् Intihuatana, मन्दिर सूर्य, र कमरा तीन खिडियाँ।

translations.source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.reference: Izakhiwo eziningi onqenqemeni lwendawo yokuhlala zakhiwe kabusha ukuzi zinikeze izivakashi umqondo ongcono wendlela ezazibukeka ngayo ekuqaleni.
translations.hypothesis: जतात, अधिकांश भवनहरू, जुन परिसरको सीमामा, पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको भए ताकि पर्यटकहरूले मूल रूपमा कसै देखिएको अवस्थामा स्पष्ट जानकारी प्राप्त गर्न सकुन्।

translations.source: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.reference: Ngo-1976, amaphesenti angamashumi amathathu weMachu Picchu ayebuyiselwe esimweni sasekuqaleni futhi ukubuyiselwa kusaqhubeka kuze kube namuhla.
translations.hypothesis: यस 1976, तीस प्रतिशतको भागको Machu Picchu भत्किएको थियो, र पुनर्निर्माणको कार्य अद्यावधि पनि चलिरहेको छ।

translations.source: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.reference: Ngokwesibonelo, indlela evamile kakhulu yohlobo lwesithombe emhlabeni ingu-35mm, ewubukhulu obufanayo nobefilimu ekupheleni kwesiqephu senkathi yamafilimu.
translations.hypothesis: उदाहरणको, सबैभन्दा सामान्य प्रकारको स्थिर इमेजरी फोटोग्राफी ज weltweit, हो 35मिमी, र यो ले एनालॉग फिल्म युगको अन्धमा मुख्य फिल्म आकार थियो।

translations.source: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.reference: Isenziwa nanamuhla, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ubudlelwane bayo bobude nobukhulu buthathwe izimo zokuthungatha isithombe zekhamera yedijithali.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि अद्यापि उत्पादन गरिन्छ, तर, सायद सबै भन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण, यसको आਕਾਰको अनुपातिकले डिजिटल क्यामेरा छवि संवेदकको ढाँचाहरू विरासत छोडेको छ।

translations.source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.reference: Ifomethi ka-35mm empeleni, ngodidayo ngokunye, ingu-36mm ububanzi kuphindwe ngo-24mm ubude.
translations.hypothesis: आकार 35mm वास्तवमा, थोडै भ्रमितक, वास्तवमा 36मिमी चौरु र 24मिमी उचाइ।

translations.source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.reference: Isilinganiso sobubanzi ebudeni salefomethi (ukudivayida ngeshumi nambili ukuze uthole isilinganiso senombolo ephelele elula) ngakho-ke kuthiwa singu-3:2.
translations.hypothesis: अनुपातमा (वा संख्यालाई 12 ले विभाजन गरेर, सादที่สุดको पूर्ण संख्या अनुपात प्राप्त), यो आद्यांश अनुपात भनिएको छ 3:2.

translations.source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.reference: Amafomethi amaningi avamile (iqoqo lamafomethi le-APS, ngokwesibonelo) ayalingana noma acishe alingane nalesi silinganiso sobubanzi ebudeni.
translations.hypothesis: अनेक सामान्य ढाँचाहरू (जस्तै APS परिवार), हुन् लगभग यो सान्दर्भित अनुपात।

translations.source: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.reference: Lomthetho wezingxenye ezintathu esetshenziswa kabi kakhulu nonganakwa ngokuvamile isiqondiso esilula sokwenza ubuhle ube ugcina izinga lokuhleleka esithombeni.
translations.hypothesis: नियम तीन, मार्मिक र धेरै आलोचना, ले एक साधारण मार्गदर्शक, जे गतिशीलता सिर्जना गर्छ, जबकि तसर्थ एक निश्चित क्रम कायम राख्छ।

translations.source: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.reference: Ithi indawo ephumelela kakhulu ngesihloko esikhulu ilapho imigqa ihlangana khona ukuze ihlukanise isithombe kathathu ngokuqondile nangokuvundlile (bheka isibonelo).

translations.source: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.reference: Ngo-1884 uTesla wathuthela eMelika ukwamukela umsebenzi neNkampani ka-Edison eDolobheni lase-New York.
translations.hypothesis: यस 1884, Teslarel गए अमेरिका, रय न्यूयोर्क शहरमा, इडसन कम्पनीमा काम गर्न।

translations.source: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: Ufike eMelika enamasenti angu-4 egameni lakhe, incwadi yezinkondlo, kanye nencwadi yokutusa evela ku-Charles Batchelor (umphathi wakhe wasemsebenzini wakhe wangaphambili) iya kuThomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: आउन्यो अमेरिकामा, रंगे 4 सेन्ट, एक पुस्तक कविता, र थॉमस एडिसन (उसको पूर्व-रोजगारमा व्यवस्थापक) बाट एक शिफारिस पत्र।

translations.source: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.reference: IShayina yamandulo yayinendlela ehlukile yokuveza izinkathi ezihlukile; isigaba ngasinye seShayina noma umndeni ngamunye owawubusa wawuwubukhosi obuhlukile.
translations.hypothesis: चीन प्राचीनको थियो एक विशिष्ट तरिका मा विभिन्न समय अवधिलाई दर्शाउने; प्रत्येक चरण मा चीन, वा प्रत्येक परिवार जो शक्तिमा थियो, थियो एक विशिष्ट राजवंश।

translations.source: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.reference: Futhi phakathi kobukhosi ngabunye kwakuyiminyaka engazinzile yezifundazwe ezihlukene. Inkathi eyaziwa kakhulu kulezi kwakuyinkathi yemibuso emithathu eyenzeka iminyaka engama-60 phakathi koMbusokaHan noJin.
translations.hypothesis: यसै, प्रत्येक राजवंश बिच, त्यहाँ थियो अवधि, जहाँ विभिन्न प्राविन्सीमा विभाजन भअको। यो अवधि, जे सबैभन्दा प्रसिद्ध, थियो "तीन राज्य" अवधी, जे 60 वर्ष लामो थियो, र यो Han र Jin राजवंश बिच घटित भअको।

translations.source: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.reference: Phakathi nalesi sikhathi kwakuba nezimpi ezinodlame phakathi kwababusi belwela ubukhosi.
translations.hypothesis: यसै समय, लडाँ कडा, जो लडाँको सिंहासन लर्ना, लडाँ कडा।

translations.source: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.reference: IMibuso Emithathu kwakungenye yenkathi yegazi eliningi kunazo zonke emlandweni waseShayina yakuDala, izinkulungwane zabantu zafa zilwela ukuhlala esihlalweni esiphakeme kakhulu esigodlweni esihle e-Xi’an.

translations.source: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.reference: Kunemiphumela eminingi yezenhlalo neyezepolitiki efana nokusetshenziswa kohlelo lokulinganisa ngamamitha, ukusuka ekukholelweni ezimisweni eziphelele kuya ekusekeleni izimiso zoburiphabhuliki, ubuzwe kanye nenkolelo yokuthi izwe elabantu hhayi umbusi oyedwa.
translations.hypothesis: थयerdapat धेरै प्रभावहरू, जस्तै प्रयोगको प्रणाली, परिवर्तनबाट पूर्णतामा, republicanism, राष्ट्रवाद, र विश्वास छ कि देशमा पर्छ, र यो एउटा मात्र शासकको होइन।

translations.source: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.reference: Futhi ngemva kweNguquko izikhundla zazivulekele bonke abesilisa abafake izicelo okwavumela ukuthi abafuna ukuvelela kakhulu nokubahambela kahle baphumelele.
translations.hypothesis: यसै, पछि क्रातिको, अवसरहरू खोल्ा भए, र सबै इच्छुक व्यक्त, विशेष गरी धेरै महत्वाकांक्षी र सफल व्यक्तिहरू, सफल हुन।

translations.source: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.reference: Lokhu kufana nalokhu okwenzeka kumabutho amasosha kunokuba babheke inhlanga yakho bona bakhetha ukubeka i-cailaber ukuze banike amasosha ama-ratings.
translations.hypothesis: समेले, यसले लागू हुन्छ, कारण कि सेनाको क्रम अब आधारित छन कति धर्मी, र कहिल्यै वर्गमा आधारित नभएन।

translations.source: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.reference: INguquko kwaseFulansi kugqugquzele abanye abantu abasebenzayo abacindezelwe bakwamanye abazwe ukuthi baqale ukuvukela kwabo.
translations.hypothesis: क्रांति во Францииले, धेरै अन्य कामदार वर्गका व्यक्तिहरू, जो अन्य देशहरूमा दबाउन, पनि प्रेरित भयो, ताकि तिनीहरूले आफ्नै क्राँटी सुरु गर्न।

translations.source: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.reference: UMuhammad wayenesithakazelo esijulile ezindabeni zokuphila ezingaphathelene nezinto zalomhlaba. Wayevame ukuya emhumeni owaziwa ngokuthi “iHira” eNtabeni “yeNoor” (ukukhanya) ukuze ayozindla.
translations.hypothesis: मुहम्मदले गहन रुचि राखेको थियो, न केवल यस साधारण जीवनमा। ऊ नियमित रूपमा "नोअर" (प्रकाश) पर्वतमा रहेको "हिरा'" नामको गुफामा जाउ, जतातमा उनले ध्यान केन्द्रित गर्ने।

translations.source: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.reference: Umhume ngokwawo, obekhona kuze kube manje, unikeza isithombe esicacile sokuthambekela okungokomoya kukaMuhammad.
translations.hypothesis: सिमे स्वयं, जे समयले पार भोगे, प्रदान गर्छ धेरै स्पष्ट र ज्वलन्त चित्र कय्यामको आध्यात्मिक झुकाव।

translations.source: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.reference: Umhume ohlezi phezu kwenye yezintaba zasenyakatho yase-Mecca, ukude kakhulu nomhlaba wonke.
translations.hypothesis: स्थान्यितमा माथिर, एका पहाड माथिर, जुन मेक्काको उत्तरमा छ, यो गुफा पूर्णतया अन्य भागान विश्वबाट अलग छ।

translations.source: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.reference: Eqinisweni, akulula ukuyithola ngisho noma wazi ukuthi ikhona. Uma isingaphakathi emhumeni isuke isihlukaniswe ngokuphelele.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, वास्तवमा, यो गाहरै भेटेको, सायन्सै जान पनि। पछि, पसेपछि, यो पूर्ण अलगाव।

translations.source: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.reference: Akukho okubonakalayo phezulu ngaphandle kwesibhakabhaka esibalele, esihle kanye nezintaba eziningi ezizungezile. Kuncane kakhulu okwalelizwe okubonakalayo noma okuzwakalayo uma uphakathi emgedeni.
translations.hypothesis: कुन सक न देख्न सक, सिवाय स्पष्ट, मनमोहक आकाश माथिर र धेरै आसपासका पहाड। धेरै कम कुन सक देख्न वा सुन्न देखिन्स् भित्र।

translations.source: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.reference: I-Great Pyramid yase-Giza iyokuphela kwizimangaliso eziyisikhombisa esamile nanamuhla.
translations.hypothesis: पिरामिड लार्जको मा गिजाह, हो यो एयूनिक मध्ये सात अद्भुत संरचना, जे अहिलेसम्म कायदेशीर छ

translations.source: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.reference: Yakhiwe ngabaseGibhithe ngekhulu lesithathu leminyaka BCE, I-Great Pyramide, ngelinye lezakhiwo zamaphiramidi ezakhelwe ukuhlonipha uFaro oshonile.
translations.hypothesis: Dibinaโดย मिस्रवासी во время века तेस, पिरामिड लार्ज एउटा संरचना जो बनाइएको हो, र यसको उद्देश्य हो सम्मान गर्न पूर्व-राजा।

translations.source: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.reference: I-Giza Plateau, noma "i-Giza Necropolis" eSigodini sabaFile saseGibhithe linemibhoshongo emingxa-ntathu eminingana (leyo umbhoshongo omkhulu kuyiwo omkhulu kakhulu), amathuna amaningana amancane, amathempeli amaningana, kanye ne-Sphinx enkulu.
translations.hypothesis: ल्या प्लाटो, अथवा "ल्या नेक्रोपोलिस" मा Egyptian Valley of the Dead, समावेशे विभिन्न पिरामिड (मध्ये, महान पिरामिड होय सबैभन्दा ठूलो), विभिन्न सानो मकबरे, विभिन्न मन्दिर, र महान Sphinx.

translations.source: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.reference: Umbhoshongo omkhulu ongunxa-ntathu wakhelwa ukuhlonipha uFaro uKhufu, futhi neminye imibhoshongo engunxa-ntathu emincanyana, amathuna, kanye namathempeli akhelwe ukuhlonipha inkosikazi kaKhufu kanye namalungu omndeni.
translations.hypothesis: ग्रेट पिरामिड बनायोयस मा honour Pharaoh Khufu, र धेरै सानो पिरामिड, मकबरे र मन्दिर बनायोयस मा honour Khufu's wives र परिवार सदस्य.

translations.source: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.reference: Uphawu "lomnsalo ophezulu" olubukeka njengo-V kanti "uphawu lomnsalo ophansi" lubukeka njengesigaxa noma isikwele esishoda ngohlangothi lwaso olungaphansi.
translations.hypothesis: चिह्न "अप बो" चिन्ह देखाहन्छ जस्तो छ, र "डाउन बो" चिन्ह देखाहन्छ जस्तो छ, जस्तै एक स्टैपिल वा एक वर्गबिना तटी।

translations.source: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
translations.reference: Phezulu kusho ukuthi kumelwe uqale ekugcineni bese uphusha umnsalo, kanti phansi kusho ukuthi kumelwe uqale exoxweni (okusho ukuthi lapho ubambe khona umnsalo) bese ugobisa umcibisholo.
translations.hypothesis: "Up" चिन्हित भन्नान हो, तिमाबाट थाग्नुन र धनुलाई धकेल्नु, र "down" चिन्हित भन्नान हो, तिमाबाट थाग्नुन (जहाँ हातले धनु पकडि राखेको छ) र धनुलाई कस्नु।

translations.source: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.reference: Umnsalo ophezulu ujwayele ukwenza umsindo opholile, kanti umnsalo ophansi wenza umsindo onamandla noqinile kakhudlwana.
translations.hypothesis: एक "अप-बौ" सामान्यतया उत्पादन गर्छ, जबकि "डाउन-बौ" छ, र थोर।

translations.source: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.reference: Zizwe ukhululekile ukubhala izimpawu zakho ngepensela, kepha khumbula izimpawu eziphrintiwe ezehlayo zikhona ngesizathu esingokomculo, ngakho-ke kufanele zihlonishwe.
translations.hypothesis: किनकिन् आफ्नो निशान, কিন্তু याद गर्नुहोस्, निशानहरू जुन मुद्रित छन्, हुन् ले कारण संगीत, र त्यसैले तिनीहरू सामान्यतया आदर गरिन्छ।

translations.source: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.reference: Inkosi uLouis XVI ethukile, iNdlovukazi uMarie Antoinette kanye nezingane zabo ezincane ezimbili (uMarie Therese oneminyaka engu-11 ubudala kanye noLouis-Charles eneminyaka emine ubudala) kanye nodadewabo weNkosi, iNkosazana u-Elizabeth, ngomhla ka-6 kuMfumfu 1789 baphoqelelwa ukubuyela eParis besuka eVersailles uquqaba lwabesifazane basemakethe.
translations.hypothesis: राजा लुई जोस छ, रानी म्यारी Antoinette, उनी दुई चुलुल (11-वर्षेको म्यारी Therese र चार-वर्षेको लुई-Charles) र राजाकी बहिने, श्रीमती Elizabeth, ले 6 октोबर 1789, भेल, भेल बाध्य भएर Versaille देखि पेरिस फर्कनु परे, किनकि एउटा समूह व्यापारी महिलाहरूले उनीहरूलाई नियन्त्रण कभर।

translations.source: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.reference: Besenkalishini, babuyela emuva ePherisi bezungezwe uquqaba lwabantu oluklabalasa kanye nokumemeza izinsongo ngokumelene neNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi.
translations.hypothesis: भेषणमा, उवासाएर फर्कन्, रंगेसँगै, जहाँ मानिसहरू चिल्लाएर र च्याताएर, तथा खतराहरू दिन्दोन्, माथत् राजा र रानी.

translations.source: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
translations.reference: Isixuku sabantu siphoqelele iNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi ukuba bavule kakhulu amafasitela esithuthi sabo.
translations.hypothesis: समूह मान्छेले, राजा र रानीलाई बाध्य पारे, ताकि उनीहरूका सवारी साधनका खिडियाँ पूर्ण रूपमा खोल्न।

translations.source: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
translations.reference: Kunesikhathi lapho ilungu loquqaba lalifuna ukunqathuzisa ikhanda lonogada wasebukhosini obulawe eVersailles phambi kweNdlovukazi ethukile.
translations.hypothesis: एउको समय, एउको सदस्य समूहले, राजाको रक्षक मार्लबे मा Versailles, अगाडि, डराका रानी।

translations.source: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
translations.reference: Izindleko zempi zobukhosi baseMelika lapho inqoba iPhilippines zakhokhelwa abantu basePhilippines ngokwabo.
translations.hypothesis: लागत युद्ध मा अमेरिकी साम्राज्यवादी आन्दोलन मा, जेला फिलिपिन आन्दोलन, भ pay गरिएको थियो, र यसको व्यय भ Filipinos स्वयं तिमले तिरे।

translations.source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
translations.reference: Baphoqelelwa ukukhokhela intela umbuso wobukoloni waseMelika ukukhokha ingxenye enkulu yezindleko futhi inzalo yamabhondi yabekwa egameni likahulumeni wasePhilippines ngezindlu zasebhange zeWall Street.
translations.hypothesis: तिनी बाध्य भए कि तिनी तिरी करहरू तिरी अमेरिकी औपनिवेशिक शासन, ताकि तिरी तिरी खर्च र ब्याजमा, जुन Philippine सरकारले Wall Street बैंकहरू मार्फत जारी गरेको, तिरी आंशिक भाग तिरी तिरी तिरी।

translations.source: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
translations.reference: Kusobala, izinzuzo ezinkulu ezitholwe ngokuxhaphazwa okungapheli kwabantu baseFilipino benza izinzuzo eziyisisekelo zobukhosi baseMelika.
translations.hypothesis: निश्चित रूपमा, सुपर-नफा जुन प्राप्त हुन्छबाट लम्बा शोषणको फिलिपिनो मानिस, हुनुपर्छ आधारभूत नफाको अमेरिकी साम्राज्यवादी।

translations.source: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
translations.reference: Ukuze uqonde amaTemplar umuntu kufanele aqonde umcabango owadala le nhlangano.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि तपाइँ चाहनु छ Templars, तपाइँ पर्छ बुझु परिस्थिति जो लेड्टो स्थापना।

translations.source: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
translations.reference: Inkathi lapho kube nesehlakalo khona ivame ukubhekiselwa ngokuthi Inkathi Ephakathi Ephezulu inkathi yomlando waseYurophu ngekhulu lama-11, lama-12, kanye nelama-13 leminyaka (AD 1000–1300).
translations.hypothesis: अवधीको ज्या घटनाहरू घटित भए, सामान्यतया चिन्य गरिन्छ "उच्च मध्यकालीन अवधी", यो युरोपाको इतिहासको अवधी, 11, 12, र 13औं शताब्दी (सन् 1000–1300)।

translations.source: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
translations.reference: IHigh Middle Ages yandulelwa i-Early Middle Ages futhi yase ilandelwa iLate Middle Ages, ngokwenjwayelo iphela ngabo ends around 1500.
translations.hypothesis: युग मध्यकालीन, preceded by युग मध्यकालीन, र followed by युग मध्यकालीन, जे अनुसार, समाप्त हुन्छ लगभग 1500।

translations.source: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.reference: Inkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe igama elihlanganisa imibono eminingi esebenzayo, kusukela ekusebenziseni ezobuchwepheshe ezikhona noma ekutheni ezobuchwepheshe ziyadingeka kuya emuzweni oqinile wokuthi ukumiselwa kwesintu kuholwa umcabango ojulile ohlobene nemithetho yesayensi nokubonakala kwayo kwezobuchwepheshe.
translations.hypothesis: "निर्धारणले" हुनु होय, एउटा शब्दले विभिन्न विचारहरू समावेश, जस्तै, "प्रौद्योगिकी-आधारित" वा "प्रौद्योगिकी आवश्यकता", सम्मत्, जेले मानिसको नियति संचालित हुन्छ, र यसले वैज्ञानिक नियमहरू र तिनीहरूको कार्यान्वयनसँग सम्बन्धित छ।

translations.source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.reference: Izincazelo eziningi zenkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe buhlanganyela imibono emibili evamile: ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ngokwakho kulandela indlela engaphezu kwethonya lesiko noma lepolotiki kakhulu, kanye nokuthi ezobuchwepheshe nazo "nemithelela" emiphakathini ezuzwayo ngokwemvelo, kunangezimo zenhlalo.
translations.hypothesis: लगभग सबै व्याख्याहरू, जुन "तकनोलोजिकल डिटरमिनिज्म" उल्लेख, साझा दुई सामान्य विचार: पहिलो, विकास स्वयं, र दोस्रो, समाजमा "प्रभाव" जुन स्वाभाविक छ, धेरै धेरै सांस्कृतिक वा राजनीतिक प्रभाव भन्दा।

translations.source: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.reference: Ngokwesibonelo, othile angathi imoto iholela ekwakhiweni kwemigwaqo.
translations.hypothesis: उदाहरणको, seseorangले भ सक्छ कि मोटरगाली निश्चित रूपमा लेडถूस विकास।

translations.source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
