translations.source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.reference: Ngokomlando abalimi abaningi babelimela ukuziphilisa futhi kusenjalo emazweni amaningi athuthukayo.
translations.hypothesis: ऐतिहासिक रूपमा, अधिकांश किसान संलग्न थिएनन्, र यसले आजै पनि धेरै विकासशील देशहरूमा लागू हुन्छ।

translations.source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.reference: Amaqembu ahlukile ahlanganisa abantu abazizwa benganakiwe yizimiso zomphakathi futhi abavumela ukwakha umuzwa wobuntu babo.
translations.hypothesis: सांस्कृतिक समूह भेजो व्यक्तिहरू, जेले महसूस ग्याँ कि समाजले तिनीहरूलाई उपेक्षा, र अनुमति दिन्छ तिनीहरूले पहिचानको भावना विकास गर्न।

translations.source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.reference: Amasiko angaba ahlukanisayo ngenxa yeminyaka, uhlanga, isizinda, indawo, kanye/noma ubulili bamalungu.
translations.hypothesis: सांस्कृतिक समूह हुनसनीले, सदस्यहरूले उम्र, जातीयता, वर्ग, स्थान, र/कि लिंगले फरक हुन सक्छन्।

translations.source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.reference: Izici eziveza iqembu elinyingxenye yesiko njengelihlukile kungaba ulimi, ubuhle, inkolo, ipolotiki, ubulili, indawo, noma inhlanganisela yezici.
translations.hypothesis: गुणहरू जुन निर्धारण गर्छन् कि एउटा उपसंस्कृति विशिष्ट हो, हुन्: भाषा, कला, धर्म, राजनीतिक, यौन, भौगोलिक, वा यी कारकहरूको संयोजन।

translations.source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.reference: Amalungu weqembu eliyingxenye yesiko avamise ukubonakalisa ubulungu bawo ngokusebenzisa isitayela esihlukile nesimelela okuthile, esihlanganisa imfashini, ukuziphatha, kanye nendlela yokukhuluma.
translations.hypothesis: सदस्याहरू, मार्मिक, धेरै सార్లు, आफ्नो सदस्यता मार्फतले, मार्मिक र प्रतीकात्मक उपयोग, जसमा फेशन, शिष्टाचार, र विशिष्ट भाषा समावेश, देखाउँछन्।

translations.source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.reference: Enye yezindlela eziningi kwezivamile ezisentshenziswa ukuchaza ukubaluleka kokuhlalisana nabanye ukusondelana nabambalwa ezinganeni, okwathi ngokunganakwa, ngeshwa, noma ngokuhlukunyezwa ngamabomu, bangajwayelaniswa nabantu abadala ngesikhathi besakhula.
translations.hypothesis: मध्ये धेरै सामान्य तरिका जुन प्रयोग गरिन्छ, भित्रले, हेर्नु गाह्रो, एउटा तरिका हो, यसले ध्यान गराइन्छ कति धेरै दुःखद घटनाहरू छन्, जसमा बच्चाहरू, मार्फत उपेक्षा, दुर्भाग्य, वा जानबूझ गरिएको दुर्व्यवहार, वयस्कहरूले सामाजिकीकरण नगरी, जब उनीहरू बढ़िरहेको थिए।

translations.source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.reference: Izingane ezinjalo zibizwa ngokuthi “zinobulwane” noma ezasendle. Ezinye izingane ezinobulwane zigcinwe abanye abantu (ngokuvamile abazali bazo); kwezinye izimo lokhu kulahlwa kwezingane kwakungenxa yokungamukeli komzali ukukhubazeka okukhulu ngokwengqondo noma ngokomzimba kwengane.
translations.hypothesis: यी बच्चाहरूले भनिन्छ "बिना अभिभावक" वा "जंगली"। केही बच्चाहरूले मानिसहरूले फन्दा (आमतौर पर, उनका आफ्नै आमाबाพา); कतिपय अवस्थामा, यो बच्चा abandonment भएन किनकि आमाबाพาले बच्चाको गम्भीर मानसिक वा शारीरिक अक्षमता अस्वीकार गरे।

translations.source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.reference: Izingane ezinobulwane kungenzeka ukuthi zihlangabezane nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane okubi noma ukucindezeleka ngaphambi kokulahlwa noma ukubaleka.
translations.hypothesis: बालनबिना अभिभावक, वा पन्छा, सायद अनुभव गरेका छन्।

translations.source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.reference: Ezinye kuthiwa zikhuliswe izilwane; ezinye kuthiwa zihlale endle zizodwa.
translations.hypothesis: अन्यका, कति मान्छे, भन्न गरिन्छ, भइन् ले प्राणी; केही, भन्न गरिन्छ, भइन् लेबिन्बिना, तन्नि।

translations.source: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.reference: Lapho ikhuliswe ngokuphelele isilwane ekungesona umuntu, ingane enobulwane iveza ukuziphatha (ngokulinganiselwa okungokoqobo) cishe okufana ngokuphele nokwesilwane ebesiyinakekela, njengokusaba noma ukungabi nandaba nabantu.
translations.hypothesis: जब पूर्ण रूपमा गैर-मानव प्राणी द्वारा воспитан, धर्मी बालबालकले (ल्याग्ल्या शारीरिक सीमा) लगभग पूर्णतया एउटै विशिष्ट स्याही प्राणीको व्यवहार देखाउँछ, जस्तै मानिसहरूमाथि तिनीहरूको डर वा उदासीनता।

translations.source: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.reference: Nakuba ukufunda okusekelwe kuyiphrojekthi kumelwe kwenze ukufunda kube lula futhi kuthakazelise kakhudlwana, izibhaxa zenza okwengeziwe.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि शिक्षा आधारित शिक्षा आनीले, शिक्षाले सजिलो र मनोरंजक हुनु पर्छ, तर "स्केफोल्डिंग" ले अझै पनि।

translations.source: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.reference: I-scaffolding akuyona indlela yokufunda kodwa kunalokho insiza enikeza usizo kubantu ngabanye abafunda okusha njengokusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lwekhompyutha noma ukuqala iphrojekthi entsha.
translations.hypothesis: "Scaffolding אינו विधि  เรียน, तर बर, तर एक मद्द जुन दिन्छ समर्थन व्यक्त व्यक्तिहरू जसले नयाँ अनुभव मार्ने, जस्तै नयाँ कम्प्युटर कार्यक्रम प्रयोग वा नयाँ परियोजना सुरु।

translations.source: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.reference: Ama-Scaffolds angaba wekhompyutha futhi abe ngokoqobo, ngamanye amagama, uthisha uwuhlobo lwe-scaffold kodwa kunjalo nangomuntu omncane wocingo lokuhlanganisa amaphepha kuyi-Microsoft Office.
translations.hypothesis: โครงสร้างสามารถ हुनु, न केवल आभासी, तर, शिक्षक हुनु, एउटा प्रकारको संरचना, तर एउटा सानो पेपरक्लिप मानि पनि, जस्तै म्याक्रोसफ्ट अफिसमा।

translations.source: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.reference: Izibhaxa zekhompyutha zifakwe phakathi kohlelo lokusebenza futhi zenzelwe ukubuza, ukushukumisa, kanye nokuchaza izinqubo okungenzeka ukuthi bekunzima ukuthi abafundi basebenze ngazo bebodwa.
translations.hypothesis: "ढा खा, हुन्डा समाविष्ट छन्, र हुन्डाका उद्देश्य हुन्, हे, उत्तेजित, र स्पष्टीकरण प्रक्रियाहरू, जे विद्यार्थीले एक्लै सम्हाल्न गाह्रो हुन्।"

translations.source: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.

translations.source: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.reference: Inqubo yethu yokuthola abantwana abangenabazali kumelwe ihlinzeke ngamakhaya aphephile, abanakekeli abanothando, imfundo ezinzile, kanye nezokwelapha ezinokwethenjelwa.
translations.hypothesis: सिस्टम हाम्रो, जुन हामी उपयोग गर्छ, अपेक्षा गरिएको छ, यसले सुरक्षित घरहरू, हेरफेर गर्ने, स्थिर शिक्षा, र विश्वासयोग्य स्वास्थ्य सेवा प्रदान गर्ला।

translations.source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.reference: Ikhaya lezintandane kumelwe lihlinzeke ngezidingo ezazingatholakali ekhaya abathathwe kulo ngaphambili.
translations.hypothesis: देखभाल हे, अपेक्षा गरिएको छ, प्रदान गर्न सबै आवश्यक कुरा जुन मूल घरमा अभाव थियो।

translations.source: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.reference: I-Inthanethi ihlanganisa izici zokukhulumisana kweningi nokokusebenzelana nabanye.
translations.hypothesis: इंटरनेट समावेशे दुई प्रकारका सञ्चार: सञ्चार र वैयक्तिक सञ्चार।

translations.source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.reference: Izici ezihlukile ze-Inthanethi zaholela ebubanzini obengeziwe uma kukhulunywa ngendlela yokusebenzisa nokwaneliseka.
translations.hypothesis: विशेष विशेषताहरूৰ इन्टरनेटले, जसमा उपयोग र आवश्यकताहरू समावेश छन्, थप आयामहरू निम्त्याउँछन्।

translations.source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.reference: Ngokwesibonelo, "ukufunda" kanye "nokuzihlanganisa nomphakathi" kusikiselwa njengezisusa ezibalulekile zokusebenzisa i-Inthanethi (James et al., 1995).
translations.hypothesis: उदाहरणको, "सीखने" र "सामाजिकीकरण" हुर्दास महत्वपूर्ण कारणहरू प्रयोग गर्न इन्टरनेट (जेम्स एट अल., 1995)।

translations.source: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
translations.reference: “Ukuzibandakanya komuntu siqu” kanye “nobudlelwano obuqhubekayo” kubuywe kwavezwa njengezici ezintsha zokugqugquzela ngu-Eighmey noMcCord (1998) lapho behlola indlela yokusabela yababukele amawebhusayithi.
translations.hypothesis: "सहभागिता व्यक्तिगत" र "थोरै सम्बन्ध"ले पनि पहिलीसन् जस्तो नयाँ प्रेरणा तत्वहरू, जसमा Eighmey र McCord (1998)ले वेबसाइटहरूमा दर्शक प्रतिक्रियाहरू अध्ययन गर्दा पहिलीसन्।

translations.source: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.reference: Ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwevidiyo kuholele kukwazisa okubalulekile ekuchazweni kokuziveza okuncane kakhulu, ukunyakaza kobuso okuthatha imizuzwana.
translations.hypothesis: उपयोगको भिडियो रेकर्डिंगले, सूक्ष्म अभिव्यक्ति, चेहरयाको गन्ध, जुन केही मिलीसेकन्डको अवधि, ले महत्त्वपूर्ण खोजहरू निम्त्याए।

translations.source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.reference: Ikakhulu, kuthiwa umuntu angabona ukuthi umuntu uqamba amanga ngokuchachisa izibonakaliso zobuso ezincane ngokunembile.
translations.hypothesis: विशेष रूपमा, दावी गरिएको छ कि एउटा व्यक्ति सत्य होयन् वा होइन, सकन सकनले सूक्ष्म अभिव्यक्तिहरू सही रूपमा व्याख्या गरेर।

translations.source: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.reference: U-Oliver Sack ephepheni lakhe lNkulumo kaMongameli, ubonise ukuthi abantu abangakwazi ukuqonda inkulumo ngenxa yokulimala engqondweni bayakwazi ukubona ubuqotho ngokunembile.
translations.hypothesis: Oliver Sacks, कति लेख "भाषण राष्ट्रपति", स्पष्ट्याले कति व्यक्ति, जेले मस्तिष्कको क्षतिले असमर्थता, तथापि, उनी अझै पनि सही तरिकाले सत्यता आकलन गर्न सक्षम।

translations.source: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.reference: Futhi usikisele nokuthi amakhono anjalo wokuchaza indlela yokuziphatha komuntu angahlanganyelwa nezilwane ezinjengezinja ezifuywayo.
translations.hypothesis: তেওन, उनले उल्लेखेय छय, छय क्षमताहरू, जस्तै मानव व्यवहारलाई बुझ्न, हुनसनी साझा गर्न सकेको छ, जस्तै, पालेको कुत्ते।

translations.source: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.reference: Ucwaningo lwangekhulu lamashumi amabili leminyaka libonise ukuthi kunezigaba ezimbili zokuhlukana kofuzo: okufihliwe nokuveziwe.
translations.hypothesis: अध्ययनको २०औं शताब्दीले देखाउन, छ के दुई प्रकारको आनुवंशिक विविधता: छिद्रित र व्यक्त।

translations.source: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.reference: Ukuguquka kwenza ukwahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okusha, futhi ukukhetha kuzisusa emehlukweni oveziwe.
translations.hypothesis: परिवर्तन थप्नु नया आनुवंशिक विविधता, र छनोट हटाउन यसबाट आनुवंशिक विविधता।

translations.source: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.reference: Ukwehluka kokuhlukaniswa nokuhlanganiswa kwehla kwenyuke phakathi kwezigaba ezimbli ngesizukulwane ngasinye.
translations.hypothesis: पृथककरण र पुनसंयोजन, ले भिन्नतालाई लगातार आदानप्रदान गरिरहेको छ, प्रत्येक पुस्तामा।

translations.source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.reference: Ngaphandle emahlathini, kunzima ngesilwane esinesimiso sokugaya ukudla esifana nesabantu ukwanelisa imfuneko yaso yama-amino-acid ngezitshalo ezikhona.
translations.hypothesis: बाहिरमा, कतै, यो कडा लागि, प्राणीले, जस्तै मानिस, पाचन प्रणाली, यो, कडा आवश्यकता, पूर्ति गर्न, उपलब्ध वन स्रोतहरू, कडा

translations.source: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.reference: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhluleka ukwenza kanjalo kunemiphumela emibi kakhulu: ukungakhuli kahle, ukungondleki, futhi ekugcineni ukufa.
translations.hypothesis: यस, यदि यो नहोस्, यसले गम्भीर परिणामहरू ल्याउँछ: कमी वृद्धि, कुपोषण, र अन्ततः मृत्यु।

translations.source: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.reference: Imithombo yezitshalo etholakala kalula ngabe ngamaprotheni atholakala emaqabungeni nasezindimeni, kepha lezi zilukhuni kohlobo lokuqala njengathi ukugaya ngaphandle kokuthi luphekwe.
translations.hypothesis: संसाधन वनस्पति जुन सजिलोसँग उपलब्ध हुनु, हुनुपर्छ हुनुले प्रोटिन जुन भेटेको अوراق र बीन्स, तर यी कडा लागि हामी,primates, बिना पकाने,

translations.source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.reference: Ngokuphambene, ukudla kwezilwane (izintuthwane, umuhlwa, amaqanda) akugayeki kalula nje kuphela, kodwa kunikeza amaphrotheni asezingeni eliphezulu anama-amino acid adingekayo.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, आहारयुक्त भोजन (मकुरोध, टर्माइट्स, अण्डा) אינם सजिलै पचाइन्छन्, तर तिनीहरूले उच्च मात्राको புரटीन प्रदान गर्छन्, जुन सबै आवश्यक अमिनो एसिड समावेश छन्।

translations.source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.reference: Lapho zonke izinto sezicatshangelwe, akumele simangale uma okhokho bethu bazixazululela bona “inkinga yamaphrotheni“ ngendlela ecishe ifane neyezimfene ethafeni namuhla.
translations.hypothesis: भर्बर विचार गर्दा, हामी न sepat, यदि हाम्रा पूर्वज समाधान गरे "प्रोटीन समस्या" मार्नु, लगभग जस्तै कीम्पोहरूले आज सवन्नामा समाधान गर्छन्।

translations.source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.reference: Ukuphazamiseka kokulala inqubo yokuvuka ngenhloso phakathi nesikhathi sakho sokulala esivamile nokuzumeka futhi ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho (imizuzu engu-10–60).
translations.hypothesis: विराम सुत्केको हो प्रक्रिया, जहाँ तिमी जानबूझकर सुत्केको समयमा ब्यूँडी, र केही समयपछि (10–60 मिनेट) फेरि सुत्के।

translations.source: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.reference: Lokhu kungenziwa kalula ngokusebenzisa iwashi elikhalayo elikhalela phansi uma kulinganiswa ukuze likusangulukise ngaphandle kokukuphaphamisa ngokugcwele.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यस सजिलोसँग गर्न सकिन्छ, प्रयोग गर्दै एक अपेक्षाकृत मौन अलार्म घडी, ताकि यसले तिमलाई पूर्णतया जगा नगरी, तिमलाई ब्यूँझोस।

translations.source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.reference: Uma uzithola usetha kabusha iwashi ube ulele lapho uphethwe ubuthongo, lingabekwa kolunye uhlangothi lwekamelo, okukuphoqa ukuba uphume embhedeni ukuze ulicime.
translations.hypothesis: यदि तिमी फेला, तिमी पुनः सेट घडी, तिमी सक्छौ तिमीले यसलाई अन्य भागको मेजमा राख, र तिमीलाई बिस्तारै उठ्नु पर्छ ताकि तिमी यसलाई बन्द गर्न सकू।

translations.source: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
translations.reference: Ezinye izindlela ezisekelwe emjikelezweni ongokwemvelo zihlanganisa ukuphuza uketshezi oluningi (ikakhulukazi amanzi noma itiye, umuthi ochamisayo owaziwayo) ngaphambi kokulala, okuphoqa umuntu ukuba avuke ayochama.
translations.hypothesis: अन्य विकल्प, जुन आधारित हुन् भित्र, समावेशुन् पिउन धेरै तरल पदार्थ (विशेष गरी पानी वा चहा, जो एक ज्ञात लघुरपि), तेशे, र बाध्य पार्नु, ताकि व्यक्ति उठ्नु र लघुरपि।

translations.source: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.reference: Inani lokuthula kwangaphakathi umuntu akutholayo lihlangana ngokuhlukene nenani lokucindezeleka emzimbeni womuntu kanye nasemoyeni.
translations.hypothesis: शीर्षकले, मात्रा של आंतरिक शान जुन एउपा व्यक्त छ, यसले विपरीत सम्बन्ध छ, र यसले शरीर र आत्मामा भएको तनाव।

translations.source: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.reference: Lapho ukucindezeleka kuphansi, kuyilapho amandla okuphila akhona eba mahle kakhulu. Wonke umuntu angakwazi ukuthola ukuthula okuphelele kanye nokwaneliseka.
translations.hypothesis: जित्ता तनाव, ताको धेरै सकारात्मक जीवन शक्ति छ। प्रत्येक व्यक्तिले पूर्ण शान र संतुष्टि भेट्टाउने क्षमता छ।

translations.source: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.reference: Wonke umuntu angazuza ukukhanyiselwa. Okuwukuphela kwento ema endleleni yokufinyelela lo mgomo isimo sethusenqondo kanye nokuzenyeza.
translations.hypothesis: प्रत्येक व्यक्तिสามารถ हासिल गर्न ज्ञान। एउटा मात्र कुरा जो रोकेको छ, हुन् हाम्रो आन्तरिक तनाव र नकारात्मकता।

translations.source: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.reference: I-Tibetan Buddhism isekelwe  ezimfundisweni zikaBhuda, kodwa zandiswa indlela yothando yobu-mahayana nayizinqubo eziningi ezisuka kuyiYoga yaseNdiya.
translations.hypothesis: धम्मले आधारित, तर तिब्बती बौद्ध धर्मले प्रेमको मार्ग र भारतीय योगबाट धेरै तरिकाहरूद्वारा विस्तारित भयो।

translations.source: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.reference: Ngokuyisisekelo ubuBuddha baseTibet bulula kakhulu. Buhlanganisa iKundalini Yoga, ukuzindla kanye nendlela yothando olwamukela konke.
translations.hypothesis: सामान्यतया, बौद्ध धर्म तिब्बतीले एकदम सरल। यसमध्ये समावेश छ: कुन्डलिनी योग, ध्यान, र सम्पूर्ण प्रेम मार्ग।

translations.source: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.reference: Nge-Kundali Yoga amandla e-Kundali (amandla okukhanyisa) avuselelwa ngokuzivocavoca ngohlobo lwe-yoga, ukuzivocavoca kokuphefumula, amazwi aphindwaphindwayo kanye nokubona ngeso lengqondo.
translations.hypothesis: यसय Kundalini, ऊर्जा (ऊर्जाले), सक्रिय भइन्छ मार्फत योग आसन, श్వसन व्यायाम, मंत्र र दृश्य।

translations.source: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.reference: Isikhungo sokuzindla kweTibet yi-Deity Yoga. Ngokubona ngeso lengqondo izithixo ezahlukahlukene imizila yamandla iba ehlanzekile, ama-chakra enziwa ukuthi asebenze futhi ukukhanya kokubakhona kuyakhiwa.
translations.hypothesis: यस मध्यबिन्दु हो "डेवि योग". मार्फत विभिन्न देवत्वहरूको दृश्य, ऊर्जा मार्ग साफ, चक्र सक्रिय, र ज्ञानचेतना निर्माण हुन्छ।

translations.source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.reference: Ijalimane bekuyisitha esivamile eMpini Yezwe 2, okwaholela ekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwe-USSR kanye neMelika. Ngokuphela kwempi ukungqubuzana kwezimiso, izinqubo kanye namasiko kwaholela ekubeni amazwe axabane.
translations.hypothesis: जर्मनी थियोे सामान्य शत्रु во Второй विश्वयुद्ध, लेजो नेतृत्वको सहयोग बीच СССР र अमेरिका। साथै, युद्धको समाप्ति, प्रणाली, प्रक्रिया र संस्कृतिको टकराव, ले देशहरू अलग भइन्।

translations.source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.

translations.reference: NgoMandulo 17, 1939, amabutho avikelayo wasePoland wayehlaselwe kakade, futhi ukuphela kwethemba kwakuwukuhlehla nokuhlela kabusha eceleni kwesihloko saseRomaniya.
translations.hypothesis: यस 17 सेप्टेम्बर, 1939, पोलिश रक्षाले पह Already, र एय един आशा रह्यो प退行 र पुनः व्यवस्थित भनु, साथै रोमानियाली पुल क्षेत्रमा।

translations.source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.reference: Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zaphelelwa yisikhathi cishe ngobusuku obubodwa, lapho amasosha angaphezu kuka-800,000 asuka eSoviet's Union Red Army angena futhi akha amabutho waseBelarussia kanye ne-Ukraine ngemva kokuhlasela izindawo ezingasempumalanga zasePoland ephula Isivumelwano Sokuthula seRiga, i-Soveiet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, kanye nezinye izivumelwane zamazwe onke zokuthula, kokubili zezizwe ezinxa-mbili kanye neziningi.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यी योजनाहरू लगभग फुक, जब धेरै 800,000 सैनिक, अर्थात् सोभियत युनियनको लाल सेना, प्रवेश गरे र बेलारुसियन र युक्रेनी मोर्चाहरू स्थापना पछि, पोल्यान्डको पूर्वी क्षेत्रहरूमा आक्रामक, उल्लिखित रिगा शान्त्या सम्झौता, सोभियत-पोलिश गैर-आक्रमण समझौ, र अन्य द्विपक्षीय र बहुपक्षीय सम्झौताहरू, यी योजनाहरू लगभग फुक।

translations.source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.reference: Ukusebenzisa imikhumbi ukuthutha impahla yindlela ephumelela kakhulu yokuthutha abantu abaningi kanye nempahla ngaphesheya kwezilwandle.
translations.hypothesis: प्रयोगे जहाजहरू ले सामानहरू ले, यसले निश्चित रूपमा सबैभन्दा कुशल तरिका हो, ले ठूला मात्रामा मानिसहरू र सामानहरू सँग पार समुद्र।

translations.source: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.reference: Umsebenzi wamatilosi ngokujwayelekile kwakungukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe lakho ligcina ikhono lokuhambisa abantu bakho nempahla, kuyilapho ngesikhathi esifanayo, ephazamisa ikhono lesitha sakho lokuhambisa abantu baso nempahla.
translations.hypothesis: कार्य भूमिकाको नौसेनाले, सुनिश्चित गर्न, जेसमा तपाईंको देशले, क्षमता राख्न, जेसमा तपाईंको मानिसहरू र सामानहरू, सर्न सक्छन्, जबकि, एकै समयमा, तपाईंको दुश्मन, क्षमता, सर्न, बाधा पुग्नु।

translations.source: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.reference: Esinye sezibonelo sakamuva esiphawuleka kakhulu salokhu bekuwumkhankaso waseNyakatho Atlantic weWWII. AmaMelika ayezama ukuyisa abantu nezimpahla ngaphesheya koLwandlekazi i-Atlanti ukusiza iBhrithani.
translations.hypothesis: मध्ये, एउटा उदाहरण थियो, थियो, अभियानको, सन् विश्वสงคราม। अमेरिकाहरूले प्रयास गरेका थिए, ले, मानिसहरू र सामग्रीहरू, पार, महासागर, अटलांटिक, मद्दत, ग्रेट ब्रिटन।

translations.source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.reference: Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ibutho lemikhumbi laseJalimane, lisebenzisa ama-U-boat ngokuyinhloko, belizama ukuvimbela lokhu kuhamba.
translations.hypothesis: Одновременно, बेलायका जर्मन, प्रयोग मुख्यतया сонено, ले प्रयासले था stopping यो यातायात.

translations.source: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.reference: Ukube ama-Allies ehlulekile, iJalimane cishe ibizokwazi ukunqoba iBhrithani njengoba lenze okufanayo ngeYurophu yonke.
translations.hypothesis: यदि मित्र राष्ट्र असफल भएन, सायद जर्मनी भएन सक्षम छएन जित Britain, किनभने उनी छएन बाकी युरोप।

translations.source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.reference: Izimbuzi kubonakala sengathi zenziwa izilwane ezifuywayo okokuqala ngokwesilinganiso eminyakeni engu-10,000 endlule eziNtabeni zase-Zagros e-Iran.
translations.hypothesis: ดูเหมือนว่า ভেลดिसले पहिलेถูก पाले लगभग 10,000 वर्षयययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययययय translations.source: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.reference: Amasiko nezizwana zasemandulo zaqala ukuzigcina njengendlela elula yokuthola ubisi, izinwele, inyama, kanye nesikhumba.

translations.source: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.reference: Izimbuzi ezifuywayo ngokuvamile zazigcinwa nomhlambi owawuhamba emagqumeni noma ezindaweni zamadlelo, ngokuphindaphindiwe zazeluswa abelusi ngokuvamile okwakuba izingane noma abasebasha, okungabelusi abafanayo nabaziwayo. Lezi zindlela sokwalusa sisasentshenziswa nanamuhla.
translations.hypothesis: बकरियाँ सामान्यतया राख, वा अन्य क्षेत्रहरूमा, जसमा तिनीहरू चरिरहे, राखिन्। तिनीहरूले सामान्यतया बकरिपाल, जे अक्सर बच्चाहरू वा किशोरहरू, राखिन्। यी बकरिपालका विधाहरू आज पनि प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

translations.source: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.reference: Imizila yezinqola yakhiwa eNgilandi kusukela ngeKhulu lama-16 leminyaka.
translations.hypothesis: ट्रकहरू निर्माण गरिए England मा, लगभग 16औं शताब्दी।

translations.source: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.reference: Nakuba imizila yezinqola beyenziwa izingodo ezugudlene, bezivumela amahhashi azidonsayo ukufinyelela izivinini ezinkulu nokudonsa umthwalo okhudlwana kunasemigwaqweni emibi kancane yangosuku.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि ट्र्याकहरूले केवल समান্তल लक प्लेटहरूले गठन गरिएको भए तापनि, तिनीहरूले घोडा जो तिनीहरू फसाउन, गति र भार क्षमता भन्दा धेरै, भन्दा धेरै वेग हासिल गर्न र फसाउन मद्दत गरे, भन्दा धेरै।

translations.source: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.reference: Amapulangi kajantshi cishe enzelwa ukuhlanganisa ujantshi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nokho, kwabonakala ukuthi ujantshi ungasebenza kangcono uma ungaba nommombo wensimbi ngaphezulu.
translations.hypothesis: Crossties आयातित धेरै छिटो ताकि रेलहरू सुरक्षित रहन्। तथापि, क्रमिक रूपमा, यो महसूस भयो कि रेलहरू अझै राम्रो हुनुपर्छ यदि तिनीहरूमा माथूनै लोहेको भाग छ।

translations.source: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.

translations.source: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.reference: Ekugcineni, amasondo okhuni athathelwa indawo amasondo ensimbi. Ngo-1767, ujantshi wokuqala wensimbi ophelele waqala ukusetshenziswa.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, लकले बनेको पहिए क्रमशः प्रतिस्थापन भए। मा 1767, पहिलो पूर्ण लोहेको रेल அறிமுகित भयो।

translations.source: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.reference: Indlela yokuqala yokuthatha uhambo eyaziwayo ukuhamba ngezinyawo, abantu baqala ukuhamba beqondile eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule ngokuvela kwe-Homo Erectus (okusho umuntu ome waqonda).
translations.hypothesis: पहला ज्ञात माध्यमको ले, चाल, मानिसले सुरुमा दुई मिलियन वर्षयसय, जब Homo Erectus (अर्थात, मानिस जो उभिन्छ) प्रकट भयो, उभिచి हिँदा।

translations.source: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.reference: Ababalandela esikhundleni, ama-Australopithecus bawangahambi ngendlela yokuma aqonde ngokujwayelekile.
translations.hypothesis: पूर्वज, iaitu Australopithecus, न्होन्टेन हिंसार जस्तो नियमित रूपमा।

translations.source: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
translations.reference: Okuchwepheshe ngokuba nyawo-mbili kutholakala emathanjeni aguquke itshe we-Australopithecus kusukela eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-4.2-3.9 edlule, nakuba ama-Sahelanthropus kungenzeka ayehamba ngezinyawo ezimbili ngaphambili kakhulu eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyisikhombisa edlule.
translations.hypothesis: विशेषताहरू जुन मानिसले दोले, भेट्टाउन सकिन्छ कडा अवशेषहरू, जो हुन् 4.2-3.9 मिलियन वर्षयस, तथापि, Sahelanthropus सायदले सात मिलियन वर्षयसयस, दोले।

translations.source: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
translations.reference: Singaqala ukuphila ngobungane kakhulu nemvelo, singajoyina inhlangano yezemvelo, futhi singaba ngisho izishoshovu ukuze sinciphise ukuhlupheka okuzayo ngezinga elithile.
translations.hypothesis: हामीสามารถ थाग्न जीवन मार्ने, हामीสามารถ सामेल भइन्छेयै, र हामी यहाँसम्म पनि सक्रिय सदस्य हुन सक्छौ ताकि भविष्यमा कतिपय दुःख कम हुन सक्छ.

translations.source: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
translations.reference: Kufana nekhambi nje lokwelapha izimpawu zokugula ezimweni eziningi. Nokho, uma singafuni isisombululo sesikhashana, kumele sithole umsuka wenkinga bese sinqanda wona.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यसले समान छ जस्तो कि उपचार सिम्प्टमहरू, तर यदि हामीले केवल अस्थायी समाधान चाहन्छौं, तर हामीले समस्याहरूको मूल कारण फेला पार्नु पर्छ, र तिनीहरूलाई निष्क्रिय पार्नु पर्छ।

translations.source: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
translations.reference: Kusobala ngokwanele ukuthi umhlaba ushintshe kakhulu ngenxa yokuthuthuka kwabantu kwezesayensi nezobuchwepheshe, futhi izinkinga zibe zinkulu ngenxa yokugcwala kwabantu kanye nempilo yesintu nokuphila kwesintu okuwubukhazikhazi.
translations.hypothesis: किनahanglan स्पष्ट छ कि दुन्यान, मुवा कारण वैज्ञानिक र प्रौद्योगिकी विकास, भित, र समस्याहरूले बढी, किनकि जनसंख्या बढी छ र मानिसहरूले शानदार जीवनशैली जीउन।

translations.source: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
translations.reference: Ngemva kokwamukelwa uKhongolose ngoNtulikazi 4, isiphakamiso esibhalwe ngesandla sasayinwa uMongameli kaKhongolose uJohn Hancock futhi noNobhala uCharles Thompson wathunyelwa esitolo esiseduzane sokuphrinta sikaJohn Dunlap.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि यो विधान पारित भयो, 4 जुलाई, एक मसौदा लेखिएको र दस्तखत गरिएको, राष्ट्रपति मन्त्री जोन हँकॉक र सचिव चार्ल्स थॉमसन, त्यसपछि पठाइयो, केही दूरी, कय जॉन डनलापको छापनेको।

translations.source: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
translations.reference: Phakathi nobusuku kwenziwa amakhophi aphakathi kuka-150 no-200, manje aziwa ngokuthi “iDunlap broadsides”.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, मध्यरात, 150 र 200 प्रतिलिपियाँ तयार गरिन, र अब "Dunlap broadsides" भन्ने नामले चिनिन।

translations.source: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
translations.reference: Ukufundwa kwedokhumenti kokuqala kwenziwa uJohn Nixon enkundleni ye-Independence Hall ngoNtulikazi 8.
translations.hypothesis: पहला सार्वजनिक वाचन, दस्तावेज, भாயको John Nixon, मा Independence Hall च्या मैदानमा, 8 जुलाई।

translations.source: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
translations.reference: Eyodwa yathunyelwa kuGeorge Washington ngoNtulikazi 6, owenza ukuba ifundwelwe amabutho akhe eNew York ngoNtulikazi 9. Ikhophi yafika eLondon ngoNcwaba 10.
translations.hypothesis: एक थियोถูก पठाउन क George Washington, जेले 6, र उनले यसलाई आफ्नो सैनिकहरूमा, म New York, 9 जुलाई, पढ्न निर्देशन. एक प्रति पुग्यो London, 10अगस्ट.

translations.source: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
translations.reference: Ububanzi be-Dunlap 25 okwaziwa ukuthi kukhona amakhophi wedokhumenti akhona amadala kunawo wonke. Ikhophi yasekuqaleni ebhalwe ngesandla ayisekho.
translations.hypothesis: 25 प्रति Dunlap, जुनको प्रति जुन अहिलेसै भेट्टाउन, हुन्। मूल प्रति, जे लेखिएको, अहिलेसै बाँдак।

translations.source: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
translations.reference: Izazi eziningi zesayensi yemivubukulo namuhla zikholelwa ukuthi iqembu elilodwa lama-dinosaur laqhubeka liphila futhi lisaphila namuhla. Siwabiza ngezinyoni.
translations.hypothesis: आज, धेरै वैज्ञानिक विश्वास छन् छ कि एक समूह डायनासोर जीवित रह्यो र आज पनि जीवित। हामी तिनीहरूलाई चिङ्गो भन्छौं।

translations.source: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
translations.reference: Abantu abaningi abazithathi njengama-dinosaur ngoba zinezimpaphe futhi ziyakwazi ukundiza.
translations.hypothesis: বহिले मानिसले तिनीहरूलाई डायनासोर नसोचे, कारण तिनीहरूले இறहरू र उडान गर्न सक्छन्।

translations.source: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
translations.reference: Kodwa kunezinto eziningi ngezinyoni ezisafana ne-dinosaur.
translations.hypothesis: तर, केही कुरा कें बारेमा, जसमाले पक्षी, लेला अझै पनि जताततै डायनासोर देखાए हुन्छ।

translations.source: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
translations.reference: Zinezinyawo ezinocwecwe nezinzipho, zibekela amaqanda, futhi zihamba ngezinyawo zazo ezimbili zasemuva njengeT-Rex.
translations.hypothesis: तिनमध्ये छिलपुट र नख, तिन्वे अण्डा, र तिन्वे दुई मागील टाले जस्तै, जस्तै कि T-Rex।

translations.source: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
translations.reference: Cishe wonke amakhompyutha asetshenziswayo namuhla asekelwe ekusebenziseni ukwaziswa okufakwayo endaweni ngezinombolo ezibhangqiwe.
translations.hypothesis: लगभग सबै कम्प्युटरहरू जुन आज उपयोग गरिन्छ, आधारित छन् मा जानकारीको हेरफेर, जे कोडित हुन्छ रूपमा बाइनरी संख्या।

translations.source: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.

translations.source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
translations.reference: Ukuhlolwa kuka-Hershey no-Chase bekungokunye kokusikisela okuhamba phampili kokuthi iDNA isakhi sofuzo.
translations.hypothesis: प्रयोगालेHershey र Chaseले, ले एक महत्त्वपूर्ण सुझाव थियो, जेले DNA ले आनुवंशिक सामग्री हो।

translations.source: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
translations.reference: UHershey noChase basebenzisa ama-phages, noma amagciwane, ukuze bafake i-DNA yabo ku-bacterium.
translations.hypothesis: Hershey र Chase ले, प्रयोग गरे, फ्याजे, जुन विषाणु, כדי आफ्नो आनुवंशिक सामग्री (DNA) लाई एउटा जीवाणुमा प्रत्यारोपण गर्न।

translations.source: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
translations.reference: Benze ukuhlola ezimbili ngokwenza i-DNA nge-phage besebenzisa iphosphorus ye-radioactive noma amaprotheni e-phage nge-sulfur ye-radioactive.
translations.hypothesis: तिनी गरेका दुई प्रयोग, जसमा एक प्रयोग समावेश थियो: मार्किंग डीएनए कें phage ले, प्रयोग radioactive phosphorus, अथवा मार्किंग phage ले, प्रयोग radioactive sulfur.

translations.source: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
translations.reference: Ukuguquka kungaba namathonya ahlukile angafani kuye ngohlobo lokuguquka, ukubaluleka kocezu lwesakhi sofuzo oluthintekile kanye nokuthi amangqamuzana athintekile amangqamuzana esidoda neqanda yini.
translations.hypothesis: परिवर्तनहरूสามารถมี विभिन्न प्रभावहरू, जसमा समावेश छन् प्रकार, महत्त्व, र आनुवंशिक सामग्री, साथै के केलहरू प्रभावित छन्।

translations.source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
translations.reference: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo emagqamuzaneni wamagciwane kuphela okungadluliselwa ezinganeni, nakuba ukuguquka kwenye indawo kungabangela ukufa kwamangqamuzana noma umdlavuza.
translations.hypothesis: केवल आनुवंशिक कोशिकामा परिवर्तनहरू मात्र हुर्कनहरूमा पुग्न सक्छ, जबकि अन्य स्थानाहरूमा परिवर्तनहरूले कोषको विनाश वा क्यान्सर निम्त्यान सक्छ।

translations.source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
translations.reference: Izindawo zokuvakasha ezingokwemvelo zikhanga abantu abathanda ukuvakashela izindawo ezingokwemvelo ngenhloso yokujabulela ukubuka indawo, kuhlanganise izitshalo nezilwane zasendle.
translations.hypothesis: पर्यटन मार्फत प्रकृति, जसमामध्ये वनस्पट र जनावर, आकर्षित गर्छ, र यसले लक्षित मानिसहरूलाई प्राकृतिक क्षेत्रहरूमा जाँदा आनन्द लिन।

translations.source: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
translations.reference: Izibonelo zemisebenzi eyenziwa endaweni zihlanganisa ukuzingela, ukudoba, ukuthatha izithombe, ukubuka izinyoni, kanye nokuvakashela amapaki nokufunda ukwaziswa okumayelana nezinto eziphilayo.
translations.hypothesis: उदाहरणहरू समावेश छन्: शिकार, माछा पक, फोटोग्राफी, अवलोकन पक्षी, र भेट्टा पार्का र अध्ययन जानकारी बारे इकोसिस्टम।

translations.source: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
translations.reference: Isibonelo ukuvakasha, ukuthatha izithombe, kanye nokufunda ngama-orangatan eBorneo.
translations.hypothesis: एक उदाहरण हो, जा, तस्बिरहरू लिन, र बोर्नियोमा "organgatuangs" बारे जान्न।

translations.source: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
translations.reference: Njalo ekuseni, abantu bashiya amadolobha amancane wasemaphandleni ngezimoto ukuze baye ezindaweni zabo zokusebenzela futhi badlulwa abanye indawo yabo yokusebenzela elapho basanda kusuka khona.
translations.hypothesis: प्रत्येक बिच, मानिसन्ले छोराछो गाउँमा, प्रयोगन्, जा आइ काम, र अन्य मानिसन्, जो कामको गन्तव्य हो, जहाँ उनी ठीक पहिले गए, ले उनीहरूलाई भेटन्।

translations.source: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
translations.reference: Kuloluhlobo lwesithuthi olunamandla wonke umuntu ngandlelathile uxhumene, futhi usekela uhlelo lokuthutha olusekelwe ezimotweni ezincane.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यस गतिशील प्रणाली, जहाँ सबैले नैतिक रूपमा जुम्ल्या, र समर्थन, आधारित छ, यसले वैयक्तिक गाड्याहरू।

translations.source: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
translations.reference: Isayensi manje ikhomba ukuthi lokhu kubakhona kwe-carbon kucekele phansi imvelo kusuka kwesinye sezimo sayo esizinzile kakhulu esisekele ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwabantu eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule.
translations.hypothesis: विज्ञानले अद्यावुक्याले, कि यो विशाल कार्बन अर्थव्यवस्थाले, वातावरणलाई एक स्थिर अवस्थाबाट हटाएको, जो विगत दोस्रै मिलियन वर्षयसयस समर्थन गरेको मानव विकास।

translations.source: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
translations.reference: Wonke umuntu uyahlanganyela emphakathini futhi usebenzisa uhlelo lokuthutha. Cishe wonke umuntu uyakhalaza ngohlelo lokuthutha.
translations.hypothesis: सबको सहभागी मा समाजिक जीवन र उपयोग सार्वजनिक यातायात प्रणाली। लगभग सबैले सार्वजनिक यातायात प्रणालीको बारेमा शिकायत।

translations.source: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
translations.reference: Emazweni athuthukile uyethukela uzwa amazinga afanayo okukhalaza ngekhwalithi yamanzi noma amabhuloho awayo.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि कति, धेरै देश, तपाईं نادرै सुन्छे समान स्तरको गुनासोको बारे, जस्तो कि कडा पानीको איכות वा पुलहरू पतन।

translations.source: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
translations.reference: Kungani izinhlelo zokuthutha zibanga ukukhalaza okunjalo, kungani zihluleka zinsuku zonke? Ingabe onjiniyela bezinto zokuthutha abafaneleki? Noma kunokuthile okubaluleke kakhudlwana okwenzekayo yini?
translations.hypothesis: किन प्रणालीले केलें गुनासो, किनले दैनिक असफल? के इन्जिनियरहरू वास्तवमे अक्षम? एवा के केलें मूलभूत समस्या?

translations.source: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
translations.reference: Ukugeleza Kwethrafikhi kuwucwaningo lokuhamba komshayeli ngamunye nezimoto phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili kanye nokusebenzisana abakwenzayo komunye nomunye.
translations.hypothesis: "प्रवाह ट्राफिक होय अध्ययनको गतिशीलता, जहाँ व्यक्तिगत चालक र सवारी सञ्चारित हुन्छन्, र अन्तरक्रियाहरूसँग।

translations.source: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
translations.reference: Ngeshwa, ukufunda ukuhamba kwethrafikhi kunzima ngoba ukuziphatha komshayeli akukwazi ukubikezelwa ngokuqiniseka kwaphesenti ayikhulu.
translations.hypothesis: दुर्भाग्यवश, अध्ययनको यातायातको मार्ग कति छ कति गाहर, कारण चालकको आचरण पूर्ण रूपमा भविष्यवाणी गर्न सकँदैन।

translations.source: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
translations.reference: Ngenhlanhla, abashayeli bathambekele ekuziphatheni ngendlela ecishe ifane; ngakho ukuminyana kwezimoto kuthambekele ekufaneni futhi cishe kungafanekiswa ngokuqiniseka kwephesenti.
translations.hypothesis: लातूर, चालक धेरैले व्यवहार मार्गा, रमाइशको; र त्यसैले, यातायातको धारा धेरै हदसम्म सुसंगत छ र गणितीय रूपमा लगभग प्रतिनिधित्व गर्न सक्छ।

translations.source: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
translations.reference: Ukufanisa kangcono ukuhamba kwezimoto, ubudlelwane bumisiwe phakathi kwezici ezintathu eziyinhloko: (1) ukuhamba, (2) ukuminyana, kanye (3) nesivinini.
translations.hypothesis: यस ताकि यातायातको सञ्चालन राम्रो दर्शाई सकू, तीन मुख्य विशेषताहरू बीच सम्बन्ध स्थापित भयो: (1) सञ्चालन, (2) घनत्व, र (3) गति।

translations.source: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
translations.reference: Lobu budlelwane buyasiza ekuhleleni, ekuklameni, kanye nasekusebenziseni izakhiwo zasemgwaqweni.
translations.hypothesis: यी नालेजमे मदतपूर्ण मा योजना, डिजाइन, र सञ्चालनको पूर्वाधारहरू।

translations.source: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
translations.reference: Izinambuzane kwakuyizilwane zokuqala zokundiza. Ikhono lazo lokundiza lazisiza zigweme izitha kalula ngokwengeziwe futhi zithole ukudla kanye nomana ngokuphumelelayo kakhudlwane.
translations.hypothesis: कीटहरू हुन् पहिलो प्राणीहरूले उफ्रान। क्षमता שלה उफ्रान, मद्दत שלה ته ته избегать врагове, र पाउन भोजन र साथीहरू अधिक कुशलता।

translations.source: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
translations.reference: Izinambuzane eziningi zisizakala ngokukwazi ukugoqa amaphiko wazo emva komzimba wazo.
translations.hypothesis: ज्यादातर कीड़ोंले फाइदा छ, iaitu क्षमता प्रयोग गर्न, उनीहरूले उनीहरूको पंखहरू शरीरमा फर्काउन सक्छन्।

translations.source: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
translations.reference: Lokhu kubanika indawo enkudlwana yezindawo ezincane zokucashela izilwane ezizingelayo.
translations.hypothesis: यसले, उला दिन्छन् विस्तृत क्षेत्र सानो, जसमा उสามารถ छुपించుयसले।

translations.source: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
translations.reference: Namuhla, ukuphela kwezinambuzane ezingakwazi ukugoqa amaphiko wazo izinzekamanzi nosathamanzi.
translations.hypothesis: आज, единствените कीटहरू जुन नสามารถ फर्काउन पालहरू छन् हुन् डाकूहरू र माईफलाई।

translations.source: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
translations.reference: Eminyakeni eyizinkulungwane eyedlule, indoda ebizwa ngo-Aristarchus yathi Isimiso sikaNozungezilanga sasizungeza iLanga.
