translations.source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.reference: Ngokuvamile njalo lapha umsindo izivakashi kanye nabathengisi. Indaba yomsindo nokukhanya ifana nencwadi yezindaba.
translations.hypothesis: आमतौरमा, तपाईं सधैं पर्यटकहरू र व्यापारीहरूको आवाज सुन्नुहुन्छ। कथाको आवाज र प्रकाश जस्तो एउटा कथा पुस्तक जस्तै।

translations.source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.reference: ISphinx isethwe njengesigcawu nomlandisi wendaba ende.
translations.hypothesis: स्फिंक्सले राखिएको, र यसले लामो कथाको कथाकार।

translations.source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.reference: Izigcawu zikhonjiswa kumaphiramidi kanti amaphiramidi ahlukahlukene akhanyisiwe.
translations.hypothesis: दृश्यहरू प्रदर्शित भएयसय पिरामिडहरू, र विभिन्न पिरामिडहरू प्रकाशित भएयसय।

translations.source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.reference: Iziqhingi zaseSouth Shetland, ezitholwe ngo-1819, zinezizwe eziningi ezithi ziwela kuzo futhi zinezikhungo eziningi, eziyishumi nesishiyagalolunye ezisebenzayo ngo-2020.
translations.hypothesis: पुत दक्षिण शेटलेंड टापु, जुन भेट्टाउन भयो во 1819, छिटो विभिन्न राष्ट्रहरूले दावी गरेका छन्, र यसमा धेरै आधारहरू छन्, जसमा 16 सक्रिय थिए во 2020.

translations.source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.reference: I-archipelago isendaweni eqhele ngamakhilomitha angu-120 enyakatho yeNhlonhlo. Enkulu kuwo i-King George enendawo e-Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: श्रृङ्खला त terletak 120 किलोमिटर उत्तर भन्दा Peninsula. एउटा लामो, King George Island, र Villa Las Estrellas बस्ती।

translations.source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.reference: Okunye kuhlanganisa isiqhingi seLivingston, kanye neDeception lapho imbobo enkulu egcwele udaka lwentabamlilo esaphuquka umlilo yenza itheku elimangalisayo elingokwemvelo.
translations.hypothesis: अन्यमध्ये समावेश छन् Livingston Island, र Deception, जसमा सक्रिय ज्वालामुखीको जलमग्न क्रेटरले एक शानदार प्राकृतिक मuelle प्रदान गर्दछ।

translations.source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.reference: IZwe lase-Ellsworth liyindawo eseningizimu neNhlonhlo, likhawuliswe uLwandle iBellingshausen.
translations.hypothesis: Ellsworth Land होय क्षेत्र जुन Peninsula मा दक्षिण, र Bellingshausen समुद्री क्षेत्र द्वारा सीमाबद्ध।

translations.source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.reference: Izintaba zeNhlonhlo lapha zihlangana ethafeni, bese ziphinde ziqhamuke ukuze zenze uchungechunge lwe-360 km lwezintaba zase-Ellsworth, ezihlukaniswe kabili yi-Minnesota Glacier.
translations.hypothesis: पहाडहरू अन्तर्गत, तिनीहरू मर्ज भएरमा, त्यसपछि पुनः प्रकट भएर, 360 किलोमिटर लामो श्रृंखला, Ellsworth, तयार पार्न, र यसले Minnesota Glacier ले विभाजित।

translations.source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.reference: Ingxenye engasenyakatho noma iSentinel Range inezintaba eziphakeme kunazo zonke zase-Antarctica, iVinson Massif, ephakeme yaba ngu-4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: भाग उत्तर, वा Sentinel Range, ले एन्टिकटिकाका अग्ोगो पहाड, Mount Vinson, जे 4892 मिटर, ले।

translations.source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.reference: Ezindaweni ezikude, ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi yefoni esebenzayo, ucingo lwesathelayithi lungaba yiyo kuphela into ongayisebenzisa.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि אין कभ, मा दूर, प्रयोगकर्ता, उपग्रह फोन, हुन सक्छ, यो होय विकल्प।

translations.source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.reference: Ucingo lwesathelayithi ngokuvamile ayithatheli ifoni ephathwayo indawo, njengoba kudingeka ube ngaphandle uqondene nesiphuphutheki ukuze ushaye ucingo.
translations.hypothesis: एक उपग्रह फोन सामान्यतया मोबाइल फोनको स्थानापन्न, किनकि, כדיโทร, तपाईंले उपग्रहसँग स्पष्ट दृश्य लिनुपरेला।

translations.source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.reference: Isevisi isetshenziswa kaningi yimikhumbi, kubandakanya umsebenzi wobungcweti, kanye nohambo olunezidingo zedatha nezwi elikude.
translations.hypothesis: यी सेवा धेरै प्रयोग गरिन्छ, विशेष गरी मा नौका, साथै अभियान, जसमध्ये केहीले दूरस्थ डेटा र आवाज आवश्यकताहरू।

translations.source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.reference: Inkampani yezingcingo yangakini kumelwe ikwazi ukukunikeza imininingwane engeziwe mayelana nokuxhuma kulolu hlelo.
translations.hypothesis: प्रदाता सेवा तपाईंको स्थानीय टेलिफोन, आउनुपर्छ, थप जानकारी प्रदान गर्न।

translations.source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.reference: Indlela ethandwayo ekhulayo yalabo abahlela ukuthatha unyaka wokuphumula ekufundeni ukuthatha uhambo nokufunda.
translations.hypothesis: एक विकल्प जुन धेरै लोकप्रिय भइरहेको छ, र यसले उनुलाई छ, हो यात्रा र अध्ययन गर्ने।

translations.source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.reference: Lokhu kuthandwa kakhulu abaqeda isikole, okubavumela ukuthi bathathe unyaka ngaphambi kwenyuvesi, ngaphandle kokuyekethisa imfundo yabo.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यस विशेषतः लोकप्रिय, र अनुमति दिन्छ माध्यमिक विद्यालयनले, ले विश्वविद्यालयमा पुगेयंका,बिना आफ्नो शिक्षामा कमी।

translations.source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.reference: Ezimweni eziningi, ukubhalisa esifundweni sonyaka wokuphumula ngemva kwesikole kwelinye izwe empeleni kuthuthukisa amathuba akho okuya emfundweni ephakeme emuva ezweni lakini.
translations.hypothesis: मा पनि, दर्नामाको कोर्स बिदेश, वास्तवमा, सक्छ सुधार अवसरितोसु प्रवेश गनु कलेज मा, तвое घर देश।

translations.source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.reference: Ngokujwayelekile kuzoba nemali yokukhokhela izifundo yokubhalisa kulezi zinhelo zemfundo.
translations.hypothesis: सामान्यतया, त्यहाँ सशुल्क पर्छ जब चाहन्छौ ​​हाइ, सिर् यस शैक्षिक कार्यक्रमहरू।

translations.source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.reference: IFinland indawo ekahle yokuhamba ngesikebhe. "iLake of a thousand lakes" ineziqhingi eziyizinkulungwane futhi, emachibini kanye nasemaqoqweni eziqhingi ezingasogwini.
translations.hypothesis: Finland हुवा उत्कृष्ट गलबोट गन्तव्य। "हजार तालौको भूमि" ले, तेशै तालौ र तेशै तटीय समूहहरूमा, हजारौं टापुहरू पनि छन्।

translations.source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.reference: Edlanzaneni leziqhingi nasemachibini awudingi isikebhe.
translations.hypothesis: यacht आवश्यक न हो, विशेष रूप से फलाकान रिन र ताल।

translations.source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.reference: Yize iziqhingi ezingasogwini kanye namachibi amakhulu kunawo wonke emakhulu ngokwanele ukuthwala noma imuphi umkhumbi kanokusho, izikebhe ezincane noma ngisho ne-kayak inikeza okwenzekayo okuhlukile.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि समूह टापुहरू र लामो तालहरू वास्तवमा पर्याप्त, सिर्को, तथा अन्य नौका, तर सानसान नौका, वा यहाँसम्म चढा, प्रदायक अनुभव।

translations.source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.reference: Ukuhamba ngezikebhe indlela yokuzilibazisa yezwe eFinland, ngesikebhe kubantu abayisikhombisa noma abayisishiyagalombili.
translations.hypothesis: नौलेging हो एक लोकप्रिय गतिविधि फरम्पै, फरम्पै, फरम्पै।

translations.source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.reference: Lokhu kufana ne-Norway, i-Sweden kanye neNyuzilandi, kodwa ngaphandle kwalokho kuhlukile ngempela (isib. eNetherlands isibalo okukodwa kuya kwezingamashumi amane).
translations.hypothesis: यसले समान छ Norway, Sweden र New Zealand, तर अन्य हिसाबले यो एकदम विशिष्ट (जस्तै, डच देशमा यो संख्या एक देखि चालीस)।

translations.source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.reference: Iningi lweMikhumbi yokuVakasha yase-Baltic ehlukile ihlanganisa ukuhlala isikhathi eside e-St. Petersburg, e-Russia.
translations.hypothesis: ज्यादातर विशिष्ट "Baltic Cruises" समावेश्‌न लामो अवधिको ब्याक मा Санкт-पेटर्सबर्ग, रूस।

translations.source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.reference: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungavakashela idolobha elingokomlando izinsuku ezimbalwa ezigcwele ube ubuyela futhi ulala emkhumbini ebusuku.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यस अर्थ्याले, तपाईंสามารถ जान् भ्रमण गर्न ऐतिहासिक शहरको लागि केही दिन, तथापि, फर्कन र रातमा जहाजमा瞓।

translations.source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.reference: Uma uya ogwini kuphela usebenzisa uhambo lomkhumbi olufishane angeke udinge i-visa ehlukile (kusukela ngo-2009).
translations.hypothesis: यदि तिमी सिर्का मात्र प्रयोग नगरी, तर सिर्का भ्रमणहरू, तिमीले छुट्टै भिसा (यस 2009) आवश्यक पर्ने छैन।

translations.source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.reference: Eminye imikhumbi yokuvakasha iveza i-Berlin, eseJalimane ezincwajaneni zayo. Njengoba ubona ebalazweni ngenhla i-Berlin ikude kakhulu nolwandle futhi ukuvakashela idolobha akuhlanganisiwe enanini lomkhumbi wokuvakasha.
translations.hypothesis: यसें, केही क्रूज समावेश्‌ छन्‌ बर्लिन, जर्मनी। जस्तै तिमीले नक्शामा हेर्न सक्छ, बर्लिनले समुद्र नजिक छ, र शहरमा जाँदा, यो क्रूजको मूल्यमा समावेश छैन।

translations.source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.reference: Ukuhamba ngendiza kungaba isenzakalo esithusayo kubantu beminyaka yonke nezizinda zonke, ikakhulukazi uma bengakahambi ngendiza ngaphambili noma uma behlangabezane nesenzakalo esishaqisayo.
translations.hypothesis: यात्रा विमानले, विशेष रूपमा यदि व्यक्तिले पहिले उडान नजिको अनुभव गरेको छैन, वा यदि उनी आघातजनक घटना भोगेको छ, सक हुनुलाई एक डरावना अनुभव हो, चाहे उनी धेरै उमेर समूह वा पृष्ठभूमि।

translations.source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.reference: Akuyona into yokuba namahloni ngayo: ayihlukile ekwesabeni komuntu siqu nokungathandwa kwezinye izinto abantu abaningi abanakho
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि यो एउटा कुरा हो जुनले शर्मित हुनु पर्दा, यो एउटा सामान्य कुरा हो, जस्तै अन्य धेरै मानिसहरूले अनुभव गरेका व्यक्तिगत डर र नापस।

translations.source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.reference: Kwabanye, ukuzwisisa okuthile kokuthi indiza isebenza kanjani nokuthi kwenzekani phakathi nokundiza kungabasiza ukuthi banqobe ukwesaba okusekelwe ezintweni ezingaziwa noma ukungaphathi izintambo.
translations.hypothesis: สำหรับบาง व्यक्त, बुझनु कस विमान काम, र कति हुन्छ, र उडानको अनुभव, रमाइल हुन मद्दत गर्न सक्छ. यसले, डर जो आधारित छ मा अज्ञात, वा नियन्त्रण नहुनु, लाई हराउन मद्दत गराउन सक्छ.

translations.source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.reference: Izinkampani ezithutha impahla zikhokhelwa kahle ngokuthumela impahla ngokushehsa. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sibalulekile ngamaphepha ebhizinisi, impahla ethengwayo ukuze idayiswe noma enye impahla edingekayo ukuze kwenziwe ukulungisa okusheshayo.
translations.hypothesis: कम्पनीहरूले छिटपुट रूपमा सामानहरू वितरण गर्दा, तिमले राम्रो पारिश्रमिक प्राप्त। प्रायः, समयले महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका बजाउँछ, विशेष गरी व्यावसायिक कागजात, सामान वा तत्काल मर्मेटको लागि प्रतिस्थापन भागहरू।

translations.source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.reference: Kwezinye izindlela, izinkampani ezinkudlwana zinezindiza zazo, kodwa kwezinye izindlela nezinkampani ezincane bekunezinkinga.
translations.hypothesis: Во многих маршрутах, लामो कम्पनीहरूले आफ्नै विमानहरू, तर барои अन्य मार्गहरू र सानसान कम्पनीहरू, भित्राले समस्या।

translations.source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.reference: Uma bebathumele zonke izinto ngebhanoyi, kwezinye izindlela bekuzothatha izinsuku ukwehlisa imithwalo nokudlula kwabahlola amaphepha.
translations.hypothesis: यदि तिनीले सामानहरू पठाउन, तВоз, कतिने त, यसले दिनहरू लगान, विशेष रूपमा अनलोडिंग र सीमा शुल्क प्रक्रिया।

translations.source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.reference: Indlela elula yokuyingenisa ngokushesha ukuthi uyithumele njengomthwalo ohloliwe. Imithetho yezinkampani zezindiza angeke ibavumele ukuthumela umthwalo ngaphandle komgibeli, okuyilapho ungena khona.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि एउटा मात्र तरिका छ, iaitu पठाउन, तर यो सिर् fastest तरिका छ। नियम एयरोलाइनले अनुमति छैन पठाउन सामान बिना, र त्यसले तपाईं आउनु आवश्यक छ।

translations.source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.reference: Indlela esobala yokugibela egumbini lendiza elibizayo noma labebhizinisi ukukhipha imali eningi yalelo lungelo (noma, okugcono, wenze inkampani yakho ikwenzele lokho).
translations.hypothesis: यस स्पष्ट तरिका हो उडान्दा मा फर्स्ट वा बिजिनेस क्लास हो, हो धेरै रकम तिरी, ताकि तिमीले यो विशेषाधिकार (वा, यदि सम्भव हो, आफ्नो कम्पनीलाई यसको हेरफेर गर्न)।

translations.source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.reference: Noma kunjalo, lokhu akufiki kalula: njengomthetho obekiwe, ungalindela ukukhokha izikhathi eziphindwe kane kunenani elivamile lomnotho webhizinisi, kanye nezikhathi eziyishumi nanye ezingeni lokuqala!
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यसले निकै महला: जस्तो कि अनुमान, तपाईंสามารถ अपेक्षा गर्न कि तपसमेले व्यावसायिक यात्राको सामान्य मूल्यको चार गुणा, र फर्स्ट क्लासको ११ गुणा तिरे।

translations.source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.reference: Ngokuvamile, akusizi ngisho nokufuna izaphulelo ezihlalweni zabebhizinisi noma ezinethezekile ohabweni lwendiza oluqondile olusuka ku-A luye ku-B.
translations.hypothesis: सामान्यतया, नerdapat आवश्यकता, אפילו לחפษ लागि छुटहरू барои सिटहरू व्यावसायिक वा प्रथम- తర, मा प्रत्यक्ष उडानहरू देखि A ते B.

translations.source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.reference: Izinkampani zezindiza zazi kahle ukuthi kuneqembu elithile eliyisisekelo labagibeli bezindiza abazimisele ukukhokha ama-dollar aphezulu ukuze bathole ilungelo lofika endaweni ethile ngokushesha futhi ngokunethezeka, futhi babakhokhisa ngokufanele.
translations.hypothesis: कम्पनियां जान्छ дека त्यहाँ केही नियमित यात्रीहरू छन्, जे इच्छुक तिमीले छिटो र आरामदायी तरण, र तिनीहरूले तदनुसार शुल्क।

translations.source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.reference: Inhlokodolobha yaseMoldova yiChișinău. Ulimi lwendawo isiRomaniya, kodwa isiRashiya sisetshenziswa kabanzi.
translations.hypothesis: राजधानीको मोल्डावा हो चिसीनाउ। भाषा स्थानीयको हो रोमानिया, तर रशियन भाषा व्यापक रूपमा प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

translations.source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.reference: I-Moldova iriphabhuliki yezinhlanga eziningi ehlushwe imibango yobuhlanga.
translations.hypothesis: मोल्डावा हो मुल-सांस्कृतिक राष्ट्रबि, र ले अनुभव गरेको जातीय संघर्ष।

translations.source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.reference: Ngo-1994, lombango waholela ekumenyezelweni kweRiphabhuliki yokuzimisa yaseTransnistria empumalanga Moldova, enohulumeni wayo nohlobo lwemali kodwa engaqashelwa yinoma yiliphi izwe eliyilungu le-UN.
translations.hypothesis: यस 1994, यस संघर्षले लेडको पूर्वभागमा, ट्रान्सनिस्ट्रिया नामक स्वत प्रोklamierte राष्ट्रको स्थापना, मार्, मार्ले आ eigen सरकार र मुद्रा, কিন্তু यो कुनै पनि संयुक्त राष्ट्र सदस्य राष्ट्रले मान्यता दिएको छैन।

translations.source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.reference: Izixhumanisi zezomnotho zenziwe kabusha phakathi kwalezi zingxenye ezimbili zaseMoldova yize behlulekile ezinxoxweni zepolitiki.
translations.hypothesis: थिए सम्बन्धहरू पुनः स्थापित भइन्, यद्यपि राजनीतिक वार्तामा असफलतापनि,बिचMoldova ले

translations.source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.reference: Inkolo enkulu eMoldova ngamaKristu angama-Orthodox.
translations.hypothesis: धार्मिक मान्यता मुख्य रूपमा हो क्रिसन।

translations.source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.reference: I-İzmir iyidolobha lesithathu ngobukhulu e-Turkey elinabantu abangaba izigidi ezingu-3.7, isikhungo esikhulu sesibili ngemva kwe-Istanbul, okuyindawo enezokuthutha ezikahle.
translations.hypothesis: Izmir ले तुर्कीको तेस्रो ठूलो शहर, जसमा लगभग 3.7 मिलियन मानिस, दोस्रो ठूलो मuelle (पोर्ट) बढी selepas Istanbul, र उत्कृष्ट यातायात केन्द्र।

translations.source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.reference: Kuqala okwakuyidolobha laseSmirna, manje kuyisikhungo sokuhweba sesimanje, esithuthukile, kanye nesiphithizelayo, esisethekwini elikhulu futhi nesizungezwe izintaba.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि एतत् प्राचीन शहर, स्मर्ना, अब यस एक आधुनिक, विकसित, र व्यस्त व्यावसायिक केन्द्र, रerdapat round एक ठूलो खाडी, र घेराइएको पहाडाहरू।

translations.source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.reference: Umgwaqo obanzi okakwe izihlahla, izakhiwe ezinezingilazi ezinkulu kanye nendawo nezikhungo zezitolo zinophahla olungokwesiko olubomvu, imakethe yangekhulu lama-18 leminyaka, kanye namathempeli namasonto, nakuba idolobha linomoya omningi weYurophu yaseMedithera kunaseTheki engokwesiko.
translations.hypothesis: सडकहरू, भवनहरूले आवरण, र आधुनिक किनमेल केन्द्रहरू, साथै परम्परागत लाल-टाइल छतहरू, 18औं शताब्दीको बाซारी, र पुराना मसेत र चर्चहरू, यद्यपि शहरले धेरै Mediterranean युरोपियन वातावरण, धन्दा परम्परागत तुर्की।

translations.source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.reference: Umuzi waseHaldarsvík unezindlela zokubona isiqhingi esiseduze sase-Eysturoy futhi unesonto elingavamile elinezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalombili.
translations.hypothesis: गाउँ Haldarsvíkले नजिकको टापु Eysturoy देख्न सकन्छ, र यसमा एक असाधारण आठ-भुजा चर्च छ।

translations.source: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.reference: Egcekeni lesonto, kunemifanekiso yemabula ethakazelisayo yamajuba phezu kwamathuna amanye.
translations.hypothesis: ल्या, त्यहाँ, थियerdapat मूर्ति कला मन्यन्, विशेषतः च्यान्, माथै केही कबरहरू।

translations.source: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.reference: Kuyifanele ingxenye yehora ukuhambahamba emzaneni othakazelisayo.
translations.hypothesis: लाग्लो, भ्रमण गर्नको लागि यो एक घण्टा मूल्यवान।

translations.source: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.reference: Ngasenyakatho futhi efinyeleleka kalula idolobha elinezabathandanayo nelithakazelisayo laseSintra elenziwa laduma ebantwini bakwamanye amazwe ngemva komlando walo okuhle wobukhazikhazi balo obhalwe iNkosi uByron.

translations.source: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.reference: Futhi ngasenyakatho vakashela Indawo Engcwele enkulu yeNkosazane Yethu uFatima (indawo yokukhulekela), indawo yemifanekiso kaMariya edumile emhlabeni jikelele.

translations.source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.reference: Siza ukhumbule ukuthi empeleni uvakashela ithuna okungcwatshwe kulo abantu abaningi, kanye nendawo ebaluleke kakhulu kubantu abaningi basemhlabeni.
translations.hypothesis: कृपया हेमा, कि तपाइँ अनिवार्य रूपमा भेटिरहुन्छ एउटा सामूहिक दफन स्थल, साथै एउटा स्थल जुन विश्व जनसंख्याको महत्त्वपूर्ण भागलाई लगभग हिसाब गर्न नसकिने महत्त्व छ।

translations.source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.

translations.source: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.reference: Lapho bevakashela amamonasteli, abesifazane kudingeka bagqoke iziketi ezemboza amadolo futhi bamboze namahlombe wabo.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि महिलाहरू भेट्न मठ, उनीहरूrequired वाल प्रयोग गर्न, र तिनीहरूले आफ्नो घोटे र膊हरू पनि छोप्नु आवश्यक छ.

translations.source: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.reference: Amamonasteli amaningi anezembozo zabesifazane abeza bangalungile, kodwa uma uza nesakho, ikakhulukazi esinemibala ekhanyayo, ungamomothekelwa indela lowesilisa noma elesifazane esangeweni.
translations.hypothesis: ज्यादातर भिक्षुालयले दिन्छन कप keperluanका लागि, तर यदि तिमी आफैंले ल्याउँ, विशेषतः एक जो धर्मी रङ्स, तिमीले पाएला स्माइल देखबाट भिक्षु वा भिक्षुणी।

translations.source: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.reference: Ngokufanayo, abesilisa kumelwe bagqoke amabhulukwe azombhoza amadolo abo.
translations.hypothesis: यसै, मानिसहरूले अनिवार्य पहिरन ट्राउजर, जुन घोटेปกคลุม।

translations.source: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.reference: Lokhu futhi kungabolekwa ezimpahleni ezisendaweni yokungena kodwa leyo mpahla ayihlanzwa ngemva komsebenzisi ngamunye ngakho kungenzeka ungazizwa ukhululekile ukugqoka lesi siketi. Usayizi owodwa olingana amadoda onke!
translations.hypothesis: यी पनिสามารถ लिनबाट स्टक जुन छ, तर यो कपडाले सफाई गरिँदैन र प्रत्येक प्रयोगकर्ता, त्यसैले सायद तिनीहरूले पहिरन महसूस नहुन सक्छ। एउटा आकार सबैका लागि!

translations.source: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.reference: I-Majorcan cuisine, njengaleyo yezindawo ezifanayo eMedithera, isekelwe esinkwa, imifino kanye nenyama(ingulube ikakhulukazi), futhi isebenzisa amafutha omnqumo kuyo yonke indawo.
translations.hypothesis: भोजनको शैली, जस्तै ती जो समान क्षेत्रहरूमा, आधारित छ मा ब्रेड, तरकारी र माट (विशेष गरी पोर्क), र सम्पूर्ण रूपमा जैतून तेल प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

translations.source: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.reference: Lena indlela enhle yokuhlukanisa phakathi kwezenzo ezinye kanye nezinto.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, यो एक महत्त्वपूर्ण तरिका हो, मार्के कति क्रिया र वस्तुहरू।

translations.source: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.reference: Ngokobufakazi obukhona kwenza ukufunda kube lula, nakuba ukubhala ngandlelathile kwenziwa inkimbinkimbi ngenxa yesidingo sokuthola ukuthi isenzo noma isiphawulo sisetshenziswa ngohlobo oluphathelene nosobizo.
translations.hypothesis: मेलाले, यसले शायद वाचनलाई सजिलोसँग, तथापि लेखनले जटिलता, किनकि आवश्यक छ जान्न के भित्र क्रिया वा विशेषण प्रयोग गरिन्छ।

translations.source: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.reference: Ukuphimisela cishe kulula ngesiNtaliyane njengoba amagama amaningi aphinyiselwa ngedlela efanayo nabhalwe ngayo
translations.hypothesis: उच्चारण अपेक्षाकृत सजिलो, रयल्या, कारण अधिकांश शब्द उच्चारण गरिन्छ ठीक जस्तै जसमा लेखिएको छ।

translations.source: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.reference: Izinhlamvu eziyinhloko okumelwe uziqaphele u-c no-g, njengoba ukuziphimisela kuhluka ngokusekelwe kunkamisa olandelayo.
translations.hypothesis: असा मुख्य अक्षरहरू जुन ध्यान दिने आवश्यक छ हुन् "c" र "g", किनकि उनका उच्चारण परिवर्तन हुन्छ, र यसमा निर्भर गर्दछ कति यो स्वर।

translations.source: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.reference: Qiniseka ukuthi ubiza uhlamvu u-r kanye nezinhlamvu u-rr ngokuhlukile: u-caro usho ukuthi othandekayo, kuyilapho u-carro esho inqola.
translations.hypothesis: यसै, ध्यारोस र र र भिन्न उच्चारण: "caro" चिन्ह "प्रिय", जबकि "carro" चिन्ह "चार्ट"।

translations.source: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.reference: IsiPheresiya sinohlelo lolimi olulula futhi oluvamile kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Persian има अपेक्षाकृत सजिलो र मुख्यतया नियमित व्याकरण.

translations.source: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.reference: Ngakho-ke, ukufunda lencwadi yokusiza ukufunda uhlelo lolimi kungakusiza ufunde okuningi ngohlelo lolimi lwesiPheresiya futhi uqonde imisho kangcono.
translations.hypothesis: त्यसैले, पढ्न यस व्याकरणको मार्गदर्शक, ले मद्दत गर्नेछ, ताकि तिमी जान्न सकस, धेरै कुरा बारे पर्शियन व्याकरण, र वाक्यांशहरू रामिकै बुझोस।

translations.source: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.reference: Akungabazeki ukuthi, uma wazi ulimi loThando, kuyoba lula ngawe ukufunda isiPutukezi.
translations.hypothesis: बिना शंका, यदि तिमी जान्नु एक रोमांस भाषा, तर्हे, योले सजिलोस रूपमा पुर्तगाली भाषा सिक्नु।

translations.source: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.reference: Nokho, abantu abasazi kancane iSpanishi bangase baphethe ngokushesha ngokuthi isiPutukezi siseduze kakhulu kangangokuthi akudingeki ukusifunda ngokuhlukile.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, व्यक्तिहरू जसले केही स्पेनिश भाषामा परिचित, सायद निष्कर्ष्यान् सक्छन् कि पुर्तगाली भाषा पुरै, र यसलाई अलग-अलग अध्ययन गर्न आवश्यक छैन।

translations.source: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.reference: Izinto zangaphambi kwenkathi yamanje ngokuvamile azisasetshenziswa namuhla, futhi zihlala kumamyuziyamu, noma izindawo zokufundisa.
translations.hypothesis: असाधारण घोड, सामान्यतया, चिन्ह आज, र र संग्रहालय, वा शैक्षिक स्थल।

translations.source: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.reference: Njengoba ukuphazamisa kokukhanya ngesikhathi sokudlondlobala kwazo kwakungeyona inkinga okuyiyona namuhla, ngokuvamile zitholakala emadolobheni noma ezikoleni, zitholakala kalula kunalezo ezakhiwe ngezikhathi zanamuhla.
translations.hypothesis: भर्खरै, प्रदूषण प्रकाशले नहुँ, यो समस्या भन्दा भिन्न, त्यसैले तिनी सामान्यतया भेट्टाउन सकिन्छ, चाहे तिनीहरू शहरहरूमा, चाहे विश्वविद्यालय परिसरहरूमा, र तिनीहरूले आधुनिक समयमा निर्माण गरिएका भन्दा सजिलै पुग्या सकिन्छ।

translations.source: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Izindawo eziningo ezaziwayo zesibonakude ziyizindawo ezingaziwa ezindaweni ezinesimo esithandekayo.
translations.hypothesis: धेरै आधुनिक अनुसन्धान टेलिस्कोप हुन् विशाल संरचनाहरू, जुन दूरस्थ क्षेत्रहरूमा, र वातावरणले अनुकूल परिस्थितिजन्यमा भेट्टाउन सकिन्छ।

translations.source: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.reference: Ukubuka ama-cherry eqhakaza, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-hanami, kube ingxenye yesiko laseJapani kusukela ngekhulu lama-8 leminyaka.
translations.hypothesis: समारोह अवलोकन, मार्म्भ, लेला एक हिस्सा होय ले जापानी संस्कृति तन् 8औं शताब्दी।

translations.source: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.reference: Umcabango uvela eShayina lapho izimbali zepulamu kwakuyimbali ethandwayo.
translations.hypothesis: यस अवधारणा आมาจาก चीन, जतातै कि फलफूल (plum blossoms) हुन्।

translations.source: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.reference: EJapani, imicimbi yokuqala yokuqhakaza kwama-cherry yabungazwa umbusi eyibungazela yena kuphela kanye namanye amalungu ohlobo lobukhosi lwasezweni Esigodlweni saseBukhosini.
translations.hypothesis: यابان, पहिलो उत्सवहरूले आयोजना भए सङ्के, केवल सराय र अन्य उच्चपद वाले व्यक्तिहरू, र शाही अदालतका सदस्यहरू।

translations.source: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.reference: Izitshalo zibukeka kahle kakhulu lapho zisendaweni yazo engokwemvelo, ngakho gwema isilingo sokususa nesifanekiso “esisodwa nje”.
translations.hypothesis: वनस्पतिहरू देखिन्छन् कति राम्रो जब तिनीहरूमा प्राकृतिक वातावरण, కాబला, व्यञ्छन नहोस्, सायद "एकमात्र" उदाहरण हटाउन।

translations.source: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.reference: Uma ukuvakashela ingadi ehlelwe ngokomthetho, ukuqoqa "izifanekiso" kuzobuye kukwenze ukhishwe, ngaphandle kwengxoxo.
translations.hypothesis: यदि तपाइँ भेट्टाउनको लागि औपचारिक रूपमा व्यवस्थित गरिएको बगान, "नमूना" सङ्कलनले पनि, बिना छलफल, तपाइँलाई निष्कासन हुन सक्छ.

translations.source: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.reference: I-Singapore ngokuvamile iyindawo ephephile kakhulu ukuba kuyo kanye nokulula ukuhamba kuyo, futhi ungakwazi ukuthenga cishe noma yini ngemva kokufika.
translations.hypothesis: सिन्गापुर सामान्यतया एक सुरक्षित स्थान, र सजिलै नेविगेट गर्न, र तपाईं लगभग केही किन्न можете पछि पुगेपछि।

translations.source: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.reference: Uma ubekwe “emazweni aphezulu anokushisa okukhulu” amadigiliyi ambalwa nje enyakatho nenkabazwe kuzodingeka ubhekane nokushisa (njalo) kanye nelanga elishisa kakhulu (lapho libalele, okungavamisanga ukwenzeka).
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, थप्नुको "उच्च उष्णकटिबंधीय क्षेत्र", जे लगभग केही डिग्री उत्तर देखि रेखांश, तिमी पर्छ सामना गर्न तापन (लगातार) र शक्तिशाली सूर्य (जब आकाश छल्लो, धेरै दुर्लभ)।

translations.source: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.

translations.hypothesis: उदाहरणको, जाँ उदाहरणको, भ्रमण गर्ने किलो, जस्तै लोयर भेली, राइन भेली, वा डान्यूब नदीमा रमाइला शहरहरूमा क्रूज, वा एरी नहरमा नौलगा।

translations.source: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.reference: Babuye basho nezindlela zemizila yokuqwala izintaba nokuhamba ngamabhisikili.
translations.hypothesis: तिसमे पनि परिभाषित मार्गहरूका लागि लोकप्रिय पैदल र साइकलिंग मार्गहरू।

translations.source: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.reference: UKhisimusi elinye lamaholide abalulekile ebuKristwini, futhi ligujwa njengosuku lokuzalwa kukaJesu.
translations.hypothesis: क्रिसमस होय एउटा महत्त्वपूर्ण पर्व मधील क्राइस्टियन धर्म, र यसले यीससको जन्मदिन मनाइन्छ।

translations.source: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.reference: Amasiko amaningi ahlobene namaholide amukelwe abantu abangewona amakholwa emazweni obuKristu nabangewona amaKristu emhlabeni jikelele.
translations.hypothesis: বহिलेका ला, परम्पराहरू जुन पर्वसँग सम्बन्धित छन्, पनि ले नविश्वासन्त मानिसहरू, न केवल क्राइस्टियन देशहरू, तर सम्पूर्ण विश्वमा, ले अपनाउनुका छन्।

translations.source: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.reference: Kukhona isiko lokuhlala ungalali kuze kuhlwe ngobusuku bePhasika endaweni ethile ukuze ubone ukuphuma kwelanga.
translations.hypothesis: थिएल एक परम्परा छ, iaitu बिताउन ईस्टर रात्र जागिर, कतिन स्थान, כדי हेर्न सूर्योदय।

translations.source: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.reference: Ngokuqinisekile kunezincazelo ezingokwenkolo yobuKrestu zaleli siko, kodwa kungenzeka kube isiko langaphambi kobuKrestu laseNtwasahlobo nesiko Lokuzala..
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, अवश्यই, त्यहाँ केही धार्मिक स्पष्टीकरणहरू, र यी परम्परा, तर यो सायद एक पूर्व-क्रिसतीय वसन्त र फलता र फructा अनुष्ठान हो।

translations.source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.reference: Amaningi amasonto akudala asazibamba Izinkonzo zePhasika njalo ngoMgqibelo ebusuku ngesikhathi sempelasonto yePhasika, nebandla nalo libungaze ngokuhlanganyela ezinzulwini zobusuku kubungazwa ukuvuka kukaKrestu.
translations.hypothesis: चर्चहरू, विशेष गरी ती जुन परम्परागत, अक्सर आयूको नातामा, शनिबार बेलुका, आयूको सप्ताहांत, "ईस्टर विग" (Easter Vigil) आयोजित गर्छन्। सदस्यहरू प्रायः मध्यरातिमा, रिल्युसन (resurrection) को उत्सवको लागि, उत्सवमा संलग्न हुन्छन्।

translations.source: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.reference: Izilwane ezafika eziqhingini ekuqaleni zafika lapha ngokubhukuda, ngokundiza noma ngokuntanta.
translations.hypothesis: सब प्राणी जुन मूलतः पुगेमा, आउन यहाँ, चाहे मार्गी, उडान, नदवा,

translations.source: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.reference: Ngenxa yebanga elide kusuka ezwekazini izilwane ezincelisayo bezingakwazi ukuthatha uhambo okwenza ukuba izimfudu ezinkulu kakhulu zibe yizilwane eziklabayo eziyinhloko kumaGalapagos.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि, दूरी लामो, प्राणीहरूले यात्रा गर्न सकेनन्, र यसले विशाल कछuga भन्दा, कछuga मुख्य रूपमा खाद्यान्नमा, यसले गैलापासको मुख्य खाद्यान्न प्राणी बनेको।

translations.source: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.reference: Kusukela ekufikeni komuntu eGalapagos, izilwane ezincelisayo eziningi zalethwa kuhlanganise nezimbuzi, amahhashi, izinkomo, amagundane, amakati kanye nezinja.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि मानिस पुग्लस आगमन, धेरै स्तनधारी जनावरहरू आए, जसमा भेल, घोडा, ज्या, चूह, बिल्ली र कुकुर समावेश छन्।

translations.source: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.reference: Uma uvakashela izindawo zase-Arctic noma e-Aantarctic ebusika ungabona ubusuku obuthatha amahora angaphezu kuka-24, okusho ukuthi ilanga alisi ngaphezu komkhathizwe.
translations.hypothesis: यदि तिमी जान्छArctic वा Antarctic क्षेत्रहरू मा हिवा季節, तिमी अनुभव गर्नेछ ध्रुवीय राति, जे अर्थ छ कि सूर्यले क्षितिज माथि नजान्छ।

translations.source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.reference: Lokhu kunikeza ithuba elihle lokubona i-Aurora borealis, njengoba isibhakabhaka sizoba mnyama kakhulu noma ngaphansi phakathi newashi.
translations.hypothesis: यसलेले, योले एक राम्रो अवसर छ हेर्न Aurora borealis, किनकि आकाले लगभग दिनभर धमिल हुनेछ.

translations.source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.reference: Njengoba izindawo zingahlali abantu abaningi, nokuphazamisa kokukhanya kungavamanga ukuba inkinga, uzokwazi futhi ukujabulela izinkanyezi.
translations.hypothesis: यद्यपि क्षेत्रहरूमा जनसंख्या छ, र प्रकाश प्रदूषण अक्सर समस्याको कारण हुँदैन, तपाईंले पनि न्युजलाई हेर्नुका फाइदाहरू।

translations.source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.reference: Isiko lokusebenza laseJapani lilandelana kakhulu futhi lihlelekile kunalokho labo abahlala emazweni aseNtshonalanga okungenzeka ukuthi bakujwayele.
translations.hypothesis: संस्कृति काममा जपानीय अधिक पदानुक्रमित र औपचारिक, भन्दा जे कसैले अपेक्षा गर्न सक्छ।

translations.source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.reference: Amasudi ayindlela yokugqoka evamile ebhizinisini, futhi abasebenza ndawonye babizana ngezibongo zabo noma ngohlobo lomsebenzi.
translations.hypothesis: सुट्स हुन् स्ट्यान्डर्ड व्यावसायिक कपडा, र सहकर्मीहरूले एक-अर्कालाई आफ्नो पारिवारिक नाम वा पदनामले सम्बोधन गर्ने।

translations.source: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.reference: Ukusebenza ngokubambisana endaweni yokusebenzela kubalulekile, ukugcizelela ukusebenza njengeqembu kunokutusa umuntu ofeze okuthile.
translations.hypothesis: सुसंगत वातावरण कार्यस्थलमा महत्त्वपूर्ण, र समूहको प्रयासलाई प्राथमिकता दिनु, धेरै व्यक्तिगत उपलब्धिलाई।

translations.source: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.reference: Abasebenzi kumele kaningi bathole imvume yabaphathi babo nganoma yiziphi izinqumo ebazenzayo, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi balalele imiyalo yabaphathi babo ngale kokuthini.
translations.hypothesis: श्रमरले, तिनी आफैले लिने निर्णयहरूले, तिनी आफैले आकालीको अनुमति लिनुपर्छ, र तिनी आकालीले दिने निर्देशनहरू बिना शंका पालना गर्न अपेक्षा गरिन्छ।
